{"author":{"id":"MDQ6VXNlcjU1NjEwNTc3","is_bot":false,"login":"u2giants","name":""},"body":"Closes #3437\n\n## Summary\r\n\r\n- Closes the remaining regression-test gap on #3437: preview-preparation claim coverage now tests all four required behaviors — an over-declared claim (superset) passes, an unclaimed write refuses, an empty set refuses, and a duplicate set refuses.\r\n- The behavior fix itself landed earlier in #3436 (`structuralWritesCovered` in `scripts/orchestrator-flow/admission.mjs`, used at preview preparation in `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs`); this PR adds only tests, no logic change.\r\n\r\n## Changes\r\n\r\n- `scripts/orchestrator-flow/legacy-relation-alias.test.mjs`: new unit test for `structuralWritesCovered` covering exact, over-declared, unclaimed, empty claim, empty inspection, duplicate (either side), and unreadable inputs.\r\n- `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs`: preview-preparation test now also asserts an empty claim refuses with the existing `at least one exact object to write` error.\r\n\r\n## Verification (offline, no DB, no production)\r\n\r\n- `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs scripts/orchestrator-flow/legacy-relation-alias.test.mjs` — 724 pass, 0 fail.\r\n- `node scripts/check-throughput-truth-audit.mjs` — truth audit OK: call_sites=317 sources=72 derived_digest=623c3a6c3f85.\r\n- `git diff --check` — clean.\r\n\r\nRefs #3437 (non-orchestrator, reviewer-tooling; {"author":{"id":"MDQ6VXNlcjU1NjEwNTc3","is_bot":false,"login":"u2giants","name":""},"body":"## Summary\r\n\r\nIssue #3458 (claim #3483, version `20260925171844` (superseded from `20260924174251`)). PopSG nightly `public.refresh_style_guide_matviews` still times out on change nights because one RPC statement runs both `REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY` calls plus the search-document sync under the unchanged 8s authenticator ceiling. #3023 fixed the search scan with a queue but left the work in a single statement.\r\n\r\nThis migration adds a **separately-steppable overload** so each unit is its own RPC statement. No statement timeout is raised. The claimed object is only `function public.refresh_style_guide_matviews`.\r\n\r\n## New caller contract for popdam3 (`complete-style-guide-crawl`)\r\n\r\n```\r\npublic.refresh_style_guide_matviews(\r\n  p_run_id uuid,\r\n  p_search_batch_size integer,\r\n  p_step text   -- required: 'file_groups' | 'folders' | 'search' | 'all'\r\n) returns table (refreshed_at timestamptz, search_documents_synced integer)\r\n```\r\n\r\n| p_step | Does | Stamps `refresh_completed_at` |\r\n|---|---|---|\r\n| `file_groups` | CONCURRENT refresh of `style_guide_file_groups` only | no |\r\n| `folders` | CONCURRENT refresh of `style_guide_folders` only | no |\r\n| `search` | one bounded queue drain + queue retire | yes |\r\n| `all` | all three in one statement (convenience) | yes |\r\n\r\nCall sequence (change nights and normal nights):\r\n\r\n```ts\r\nawait db.rpc('refresh_style_guide_matviews', { p_run_id, p_search_batch_size: 5000, p_step: 'file_groups' })\r\nawait db.rpc('refresh_style_guide_matviews', { p_run_id, p_search_batch_size: 5000, p_step: 'folders' })\r\nlet synced = 0\r\ndo {\r\n  const [{ search_documents_synced }] = await db.rpc('refresh_style_guide_matviews', {\r\n    p_run_id, p_search_batch_size: 5000, p_step: 'search',\r\n  })\r\n  synced = search_documents_synced ?? 0\r\n} while (synced >= 5000)\r\n```\r\n\r\nThe legacy2-arg form `refresh_style_guide_matviews(p_run_id, p_search_batch_size)` is **byte-identical** (all-in-one) so existing callers and the pinned production catalog contract `popsg_refresh_search_sync_queue_v1` (`md5(prosrc)` of the2-arg) stay green. Full text: `.agent/work/3458/1/caller_contract.md`. Blocks u2giants/popdam3#107.\r\n\r\n## Evidence pair (updated 2026-09-25)\n\nClaim #3483's reserved version was superseded `20260924174251` -> `20260925171844` (`refs/db-claim-supersessions/3483-20260924174251`). Generation 1's contract could not name the renamed migration, so this PR now carries **generation 2** (`refs/db-contracts/3458/2`) at `.agent/work/3458/2/`. Generation 1 remains immutable and untouched. Scope, claimed object, required checks and prohibitions are unchanged.\n## What changed\r\n\r\n- `supabase/migrations/20260925171844_popsg_refresh_steps_under_ceiling.sql` — new3-arg overload, grants (`service_role` only), catalog self-check. `-- derived-from: 20260917005221`.\r\n- `.agent/work/3458/1/behavior_tests.sql` — 6 checks: catalog objects, step isolation, legacy body intact, unknown `p_step` refused, change-night search batches (25 new files / batches of 10) drain the queue and accumulate `search_documents_synced`, matview steps do not close the run, legacy grants/definer posture.\r\n- `.agent/work/3458/1/caller_contract.md`, `contract.json`, `completion.json`.\r\n\r\n## Acceptance path\r\n\r\nA production crawl with >0 deactivations or new files reaches `completed` once popdam3 issues the three steps above. Preview rehearsal + production apply follow the normal guarded lane after merge.\r\n\r\n## Deliberately not done\r\n\r\n- Did **not** rewrite the legacy2-arg body (catalog md5 pin).\r\n- Did **not** touch `scripts/production_catalog_verification.py`, `supabase/tests/popsg_bounded_crawl_and_search_contracts.sql`, or `types/database.types.ts` (outside claim write scope). Follow-ups once popdam3 adapts: add a catalog contract for the3-arg, regenerate types.\r\n- No production writes. No timeout increase.\r\n\r\n## Checks\r\n\r\n- `python scripts/test_migration_derivation.py` — 44 tests OK.\r\n- `git diff --check` — clean.\r\n- `bash scripts/check-sql.sh` — not run locally (Windows Git Bash hangs on Guard B `origin/main` fetch); must run in PR CI.\r\n\r\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\r\n\r\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\r\n---\r\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3487?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792867733&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3487&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3487&signature=33a3dcc4632ed2ab6b7006cadae1066775cc8813917ec8f3592f0224183676bc\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\r\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"author":{"id":"MDQ6VXNlcjU1NjEwNTc3","is_bot":false,"login":"u2giants","name":""},"body":"Closes the gap behind #3234: nothing stopped us asserting a ColdLion identity that ColdLion never confirmed.\n\nA landing table records what a vendor sent. `unique (…)` there is a claim about **their** data, so only they can make it true. The 2026-09-15 constraint on `coldlion.prod_detail` came from a 166-row sample; the population falsified it on 2026-09-17 and nine orders stopped landing. The register of ColdLion answers was never opened — and the one `prodLineSeq` answer on record is about a different endpoint, where the line number alone was never a row identity either.\n\n**What the guard does.** For any migration newer than its activation stamp that touches a configured vendor landing schema and asserts or drops an identity constraint, it requires a `-- source-authority:` line, and fails if the cited register entry is still open. Both directions matter: it would have refused the original assertion, and it refuses dropping the constraint today while question 2.36 is open.\n\n- `scripts/check-vendor-identity-authority.mjs` — the guard, offline and deterministic.\n- `scripts/check-vendor-identity-authority.test.mjs` — 8 negative-path tests; every one proves a refusal.\n- `config/vendor-landing-authority.json` — schemas, registers and the activation stamp, out of the code.\n- `.github/workflows/vendor-identity-authority.yml` — unique check name, no `paths:` filter, tests run first.\n\nShould be made a required context once green.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude The guarded workflow now runs both authority-token reads from a clean protected-main checkout before any pull-request-head script. The second read follows protected-main lock acquisition. The authority token does not reach PR-head code, and the token-bearing steps use a pinned executable path and protected modules. Generation 12 contract and completion evidence pass exact Git verification. {"author":{"id":"MDQ6VXNlcjU1NjEwNTc3","is_bot":false,"login":"u2giants","name":""},"body":"Closes #2986.\r\n\r\nThe governed reviewer lane binds a pull request to **exactly one** work issue, so only #2986 is\r\ndeclared here. This pull request also carries the fix for issue #2492 (the grok turn budget);\r\nthat issue is closed by hand against this merge commit rather than by a closing keyword.\r\n\r\nTwo independent, non-orchestrator repo-maintenance fixes. No migration, no database write of any kind, no production or sandbox mutation.\r\n\r\n## #2986 — sandbox migration-ledger drift is now watched like production\r\n\r\nThe migrations themselves were already applied to the sandbox on 2026-09-15 by the owner's explicit instruction; nothing here re-applies anything. The issue's remaining ask was the SOP so it cannot drift again silently.\r\n\r\n- `scripts/check-migration-ledger-drift.mjs` gains `--target sandbox` — the DesignFlow consolidated non-production database that `sandbox-albert` reads.\r\n- `.github/workflows/migration-ledger-drift.yml` now compares **production and sandbox** on the same push and daily schedule legs, each with its own independently throttled alarm issue. Production keeps its original alarm title so the existing throttle still matches. `preview` stays on-demand only: it is rebuilt, so a scheduled comparison against it would report the rebuild rather than a mistake.\r\n\r\n**Scope, because the sandbox is a different database.** It was seeded from a structure dump and stamped only with the DesignFlow contract migrations applied afterwards, so it is owed a subset of the merged tree. Comparing all 703 merged versions against its 8-row ledger would report ~695 false gaps on the first run — a check that is red on day one is trained away within a week. A merged version is in scope when it is **already in the sandbox ledger**, or when it **touches the `dflow` schema and is not older than the baseline derived from the ledger's earliest row**. Keeping applied versions in scope is what stops the rule turning legitimately applied migrations into phantom orphan ledger rows. The baseline, the rule and the excluded count are printed on **every** run, so the scope claim is visible and challengeable rather than silent.\r\n\r\n**Read-only, and no new secret.** It runs the same one constant `select version from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` over the Supabase Management API that production already uses, with the existing `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`. This is a deliberate deviation from the issue's literal wording (\"reading the `DB_*_SANDBOX` secrets\"): the Management API reaches the same database with the credential CI already holds, so it adds **no new secret surface**. No value of any `DB_*_SANDBOX` secret appears in this repository, this PR, or any log.\r\n\r\n**Live read-only run on this branch, against the real sandbox:** exit 1, drift found — 3 merged-but-not-applied (`20260905072856`, `20260909084253`, `20260911210709`) and 2 orphan ledger rows (`20260904183000`, `20260904183100`, which have no file on `main`). That is the drift this check exists to surface; it is pre-existing and is not created or resolved by this PR. The scheduled sandbox leg will file one throttled alarm naming it.\r\n\r\n## #2492 — grok produced no verdict on large migrations\r\n\r\n**Diagnosis.** Not an input-size or token ceiling: the whole brief already goes through `--prompt-file`, so nothing is truncated. The limit is a **turn** budget — `ai-grok-review` (in `popcre/ai-devops`) defaults to 20 agent turns, and a reviewer reading a 1798-line migration spends them opening files before it writes a verdict line. The two observed occurrences bracket the threshold between 914 changed lines (PR #2490, succeeded) and 1798 (PR #2409, failed three times).\r\n\r\n**Why the fix lands here and not cross-repo.** `--max-turns` is documented in that wrapper as overridable per call — a runtime bound, not part of the cached prompt prefix. The caller that knows how big the review is can size it. Raising the wrapper's global default in `popcre/ai-devops` would be a blind change that charges every small review for the largest one; that repository is also on `feature-branch-pr` with a merge queue, so it would be a separate governed PR. No cross-repo change was made.\r\n\r\n**Why raise the budget rather than skip grok on big migrations.** Skipping a reviewer on exactly the changes that carry the most risk is the wrong half of the choice the issue offered.\r\n\r\n- New `scripts/lib/reviewer-turn-budget.mjs`: the budget rises with changed migration lines, is capped, and **can never fall below today's default**. An unmeasurable size is treated as large, not small. The measurement never throws and can never block or fail a review — a measurement that could veto one would be a new way to lose a reviewer slot.\r\n- A round that still ends without a verdict now **names the budget it was given** (\"was launched with 60 turn(s): 1798 changed migration line(s) were granted 60 turns\"), so the failure is diagnosable from the refusal alone instead of costing a hand investigation each time. It stays a loud `REFUSED`, and the existing `turn_limit_cancelled` reroute path is unchanged.\r\n- Reviewers with no `--max-turns` contract are launched exactly as before.\r\n\r\n## Regression tests — verified to FAIL first\r\n\r\nEach was run against pristine `origin/main` in a throwaway worktree before the fix:\r\n\r\n- `scripts/lib/reviewer-turn-budget.test.mjs` (11 tests) — on `origin/main` the suite cannot even load: `Cannot find module '…/scripts/lib/reviewer-turn-budget.mjs'`.\r\n- `scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs` — 3 of the 4 new `#2492` tests fail on `origin/main` (82 tests, 79 pass, 3 fail). The fourth asserts non-grok wrappers are untouched and correctly passes on both sides; it is a no-regression guard.\r\n- `scripts/check-migration-ledger-drift.test.mjs` (9 new tests) — on `origin/main` the suite fails to load: `does not provide an export named 'sandboxInScopeVersions'`. Behaviourally, `runDriftCheck({target:'sandbox'})` there fails with `unknown --target \"sandbox\"; expected one of: production, preview`.\r\n\r\nAfter the fix: ledger-drift 44/44, governed review 82/82, turn budget 11/11, orchestrator-flow 332/332, `check-sql.sh` clean, GitHub transport conformance clean (297 files). `scripts/lib/reviewer-turn-budget.test.mjs` was added to the `migration-author-lease` CI step so it is actually executed.\r\n\r\nDeclared to `ai-task-gates` as class `code`; re-checked before review.\r\n\r\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\r\n\r\nPosted by Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on {"body":"## Outcome\nComplete the structural prerequisites before DesignFlow writes its first row into the new final plm homes introduced by structural issue #3498 / PR #3510. This is shared-db orchestrator work because it changes database shape. It is a successor, not part of the additive table-creation PR.\n\n## Scope to design and claim before authoring\n- The four deferred source lookup indexes: item_user_assignment_active_lookup, item_workflow_action_item_time, item_workflow_action_open_handoff_lookup, item_workflow_action_admin_review. Confirm exact schema-qualified identities, definitions, and live parent usage before claiming.\n- Append-only enforcement on plm.item_workflow_action, with the same permitted correction route as the DesignFlow source, if any. Prove unauthorized UPDATE/DELETE are refused.\n- Referential integrity for user IDs currently left out of the first migration: decide the safe target of user references and prove existing rows/target identity before adding any foreign key. Do not couple final plm homes back to a temporary dflow landing schema without an approved design.\n- Narrow backend-role privileges and RLS needed for authenticated application insert/read. No anon or broad role access. Verify the exact service identity and database target immediately before any write.\n- Reconcile any notification linkage needed by the final table home; do not invent a data move or broaden this issue to application rows.\n\n## Gate and handoff\nDepend on #3498 merged and production structure verified. Publish immutable contract and claim exact objects under a new author worktree and PR. Obtain governed exact-head independent review, Guarded Merge, and automatic production proof. Then the DesignFlow backend child of issue #81 may move rows and switch its service, with its own review and proof. Application row data stays with DesignFlow.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: needs-scoping\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\nservice_class: standard-application\nchange_type: index\npriority: 40\napplication_return_to: popcre/designflow-backend#81\ngenerated_types: not-applicable\nlive_assertion: Before DesignFlow writes the first final-home row, exact lookup indexes, append-only action enforcement, approved user referential integrity, and narrow backend access exist and pass read-only production proof.\ndepends_on: 3498\nwrites:\nreads:\n  - table plm.item_user_assignment\n  - table plm.item_workflow_action\n```\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0e56c-2e17-78a2-ad57-cd154b990979 on edge-dev3\n","closedAt":"2026-09-28T02:22:06Z","createdAt":"2026-09-28T02:21:26Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2YAgzg","name":"orchestrator","description":"Changes shared-database structure (or curated Master Data load): orchestrator work","color":"B60205"}],"number":3596,"title":"Complete final-home item ownership structure before DesignFlow row cutover","updatedAt":"2026-09-28T02:22:06Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3596"},

{"body":"## Symptom (verbatim from CI on PR #2835, runs 36177421012 and 36181829922)\n\n```\nERROR: cross-PR object collision guard could not gather complete inputs -- Compare and commit-graph fallback disagree (...huge file list...)\nNo collision checking was performed. This is deliberate: a guard that cannot gather its inputs must fail closed. See B6 in HANDOFF.md.\n```\n\nSame failure on PR #2835 at heads 57520a96e and 1a7a7ce58. Not a real object collision.\n\n## Root cause (diagnosed 2026-09-25)\n\nGitHub's Compare REST API silently truncates the files array at 300 entries (and commits at 250) with no truncation flag. Pagination does not recover the rest.\n\nLive proof for 1a7a7ce58...main:\n- Compare API .files length: 300 (exactly the cap)\n- git diff --name-only <merge-base> origin/main: 386\n- Compare total_commits 418 vs .commits length 250 (same silent cap)\n\nvalidateBaseFileAgreement required identical file sets, so every PR whose base has moved past 300 files failed closed and performed no collision checking.\n\n## Status\n\nFixed by PR #3558 (non-orchestrator tooling). The guard now treats a Compare list that is at its file cap and a strict subset of the proven-complete commit-graph fallback as truncated, and uses the complete fallback. Any other mismatch still fails closed.\n\n## This blocks structural merges\n\nUntil #3558 lands and Cross-PR Object Collision is re-run, stale PRs (including #2835) get no collision checking at all. Merging origin/main into a blocked PR clears that one PR (base-side file count drops to ~0) but does not fix the guard. Re-running after other PRs land does not clear it.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T21:20:16Z","createdAt":"2026-09-25T20:20:20Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACoQNUrw","name":"bug","description":"Something isn't working","color":"d73a4a"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3559,"title":"Cross-PR object collision: Compare and commit-graph fallback disagree","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T21:20:16Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3559"},

That is\nNOT the same as \"no orchestrator\" — do not start a second one, and do not take a\nrouting target from a handoff or from conversation history.\n\n**Two orchestrators dispatching at once is how this repo produced four competing\nmigrations on one function.** Stop dispatching until this is resolved.\n\nRun: https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/actions/runs/36174982618\n\nCheck by hand:\n\n    gh api \"repos/popcre/shared-db/issues?state=open&per_page=100\" --paginate \\\n      --jq '.[] | select(.pull_request == null) | select(.labels[].name==\"orchestrator-marker\") | .number'\n\n⚠️ This detects a MARKED collision only. {"body":"## Problem\n\nPR #3311 (`fix: order post-apply catalog row counts by composite field (#2876)`) touched **code** and merged with **no** `Migration guarded merge authorization` status and **zero** `refs/db-review-verdicts/*`. That is a required-status / merge-gate enforcement hole.\n\nThe documents-only classifier did **not** misclassify the `.py` files. The green `Documents-only merge authorization` status on that head was the #2838 **advisory** message (`Not applicable: code change; guarded code checks required`), which is published under the **same status context name** as a real documents-only grant. Workflow run 36032274467 is that advisory.\n\n### Shared context-name collision\n\nTwo different outcomes share one status context, `Documents-only merge authorization`:\n\n1. **Real grant** — authorizes merge of a true docs-only PR.\n2. **#2838 advisory** — `Not applicable: code change; guarded code checks required`, reported green / `success` on a code PR so the check is no longer permanently red.\n\nBecause both share one context name, a green advisory is indistinguishable from a genuine documents-only grant. A code PR can therefore present a green same-named status, skip `Migration guarded merge authorization`, carry no verdict refs, and still merge.\n\n### Evidence\n\n- PR #3311 merged at 2026-09-24T17:43:58Z (merge commit `6288c639735c4fe2bc431ace69e4596327d10611`).\n- PR head `3e5eaa42b311577f3f455fb9dae7d8b0d2bf03e7` combined commit status has **exactly one** entry:\n  - context: `Documents-only merge authorization`\n  - description: `Not applicable: code change; guarded code checks required`\n  - state: `success`\n- **No** `Migration guarded merge authorization` status on that head (it is absent from the PR checks entirely).\n- **Zero** `refs/db-review-verdicts/*` for the merge.\n- Workflow run 36032274467 (`Documents-only merge authorization`, event `pull_request_target`, conclusion `success`) is the advisory, not a grant.\n- Files changed by the PR include `scripts/production_catalog_verification.py` and `scripts/test_production_catalog_verification.py` (code, not prose).\n\n### Required outcome\n\nA **code** PR must **never** merge without:\n\n1. a real `Migration guarded merge authorization` status, and\n2. the applicable exact-head verdict refs (`refs/db-review-verdicts/*`).\n\nA #2838 advisory `Documents-only merge authorization` must not be able to satisfy or stand in for either requirement. Fix the merge-gate / required-status enforcement hole; do not weaken or delete any other check.\n\nRelated diagnosis corrected on #3488.\n\nThis is non-orchestrator repository maintenance. It changes no database structure.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 50\nci: true\n```\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\nAdmission fields (change_type, priority) completed by orchestrator queue triage so the issue can be classified.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev","closedAt":"2026-09-25T22:18:49Z","createdAt":"2026-09-25T04:55:50Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3505,"title":"Merge gate: code PR can merge without Migration guarded merge authorization when only the #2838 advisory Documents-only status is present","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T22:24:07Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3505"},

Recovery is a dead-end:\n\n1. `--replace-failed-reviewer --failure-code silent_worker_observed` refuses and says to run `--release-failed-reviewer` first.\n2. `--release-failed-reviewer --failure-code silent_worker_observed` refuses: not a recognized terminal failure code (only insufficient_quota / provider_unavailable / local_dependency_unavailable / wrapper_terminal_failure / turn_limit_cancelled / reviewer_cannot_read_repository / reviewer_cannot_emit_governed_verdict / review_target_superseded).\n3. `--release-failed-reviewer --failure-code provider_unavailable` on the same sequence refuses: active lease does not match terminal failure evidence.\n4. `--replace-failed-reviewer` without freeing capacity refuses: 3 of 5 already failed on the exact head; gemini holds the other slot; qwen quarantined.\n\nResult: a check-green PR with one durable exact-head APPROVE cannot obtain the second, so it cannot merge.\n\n## Required outcome\n\nA supported recovery path that either:\n- releases a silent-worker assignment with immutable evidence and draws a replacement at the same head, or\n- documents and enforces the correct ordered commands so an operator can unstick the slot without weakening exact-head approval.\n\nDo not invent verdicts. Do not weaken the two-reviewer rule.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 20\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T05:06:06Z","createdAt":"2026-09-25T02:18:46Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## Process gap\n\nMerged PR #3311 (`fix: order post-apply catalog row counts by composite field (#2876)`) touched **code**, not prose, yet it merged through the **documents-only** lane with no database reviewer verdict.\n\n### What the PR actually changed\n\nFiles (from the merged PR):\n- `scripts/production_catalog_verification.py` — **one-line `ORDER BY` fix** (`jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'name')` → `jsonb_agg(x order by x.name)`)\n- `scripts/test_production_catalog_verification.py` — tests for the fix\n- `docs/verification/throughput-guard-truth-baseline-20260828.json` — baseline hash re-pin\n- `.agent/work/2876/11/completion.json`, `.agent/work/2876/11/contract.json` — work evidence\n\nThe code change itself is **correct and narrowly scoped** (independently verified: the one-line SQL expression fix; 228 tests pass including the new regression test). This issue is **not** a defect against the code.\n\n### Observed merge path (live evidence)\n\n| Observation | Result |\n|---|---|\n| `Documents-only merge authorization` | **SUCCESS** |\n| `Migration guarded merge authorization` | **absent — never ran** |\n| `refs/db-review-verdicts/*` for the PR | **none** (0 matching refs) |\n| `refs/db-review-assignments/*` for the PR | **none** (0 matching refs) |\n| `GOVERNED REVIEW FINDINGS` comments | **3**, each claiming APPROVE but each marked `NON-AUTHORIZING UNLESS THE MATCHING CREATE-ONLY VERDICT ARTIFACT EXISTS` |\n| Matching create-only verdict artifact | **none exists** |\n\nSo the merge authorization skipped both the guarded merge path and every required verdict artifact, while the only review evidence present is explicitly non-authorizing.\n\n### Rule that says this must not happen\n\n`AGENTS.md` rules **17 / 18** (documents-only exemption, issue #2102 / lightweight status path #2715): a documents-only pull request is one whose changed files are **all** prose documents. **One non-document file of any kind — a `.py`, a `.sql`, a script, a workflow, a test, a config — removes the exemption from the whole pull request.** Rulebook files (`AGENTS.md`, `plan_*.md`, skills) are also excluded from \"documents\".\n\nPR #3311 carries `scripts/production_catalog_verification.py` and its test file. Under rule 18 it must **not** have received `Documents-only merge authorization`, and it should have taken the full guarded-merge / database-reviewer path.\n\n## Investigation requested (repo-maintenance)\n\nDo **not** treat this as a database-structure change. This is repository maintenance of the merge-authorization machinery.\n\n1. **Why did the documents-only classifier accept this PR?**\n   - Re-run / inspect `scripts/lib/documents-only-change.mjs` and `scripts/check-documents-only-merge-authorization.mjs` against the exact file list of PR #3311.\n   - Determine whether the classifier was fed an incomplete file list, whether `.agent/work/**` / `docs/verification/**` interaction short-circuited the verdict, whether an earlier generation of the PR was classified and the status was carried forward, or whether a live-PR recheck accepted a stale comparison.\n   - AGENTS.md §12.1 rule 18 says the classifier must **fail closed** on empty/unreadable/absent changed-file lists — check that path too.\n\n2. **Can merge authorization skip required verdict artifacts?**\n   - Confirm whether the lightweight documents-only status path and the guarded merge path both refuse when no `refs/db-review-verdicts/*` and no `refs/db-review-assignments/*` exist for a non-document PR.\n   - Determine whether three `GOVERNED REVIEW FINDINGS — NON-AUTHORIZING` comments can be mistaken for approval (AGENTS.md rule: *silence is never approval*; an `APPROVE` with no create-only verdict artifact is `verdict=none`).\n   - Check whether the required-status adapter can write `Migration guarded merge authorization` (or its documents-only twin) without a real verdict artifact for a code-touching PR.\n\n3. **Containment / fix-forward** (only after the root cause is identified):\n   - Tighten the classifier or the status adapter so a `.py`/code-touching PR can never receive the documents-only exemption.\n   - Ensure a code PR cannot merge without either a create-only verdict artifact pinned to the exact head, or a recorded transport-failure/replace path.\n   - Consider a one-shot audit of other recently merged PRs that received `Documents-only merge authorization` while touching code files.\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- No database, schema, migration, RLS, or production change is requested or authorized.\n- Do not revert or re-review PR #3311 itself — the code fix is correct and already merged.\n- Do not weaken any guard; preserve every existing refusal.\n\nowner: MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev (repo-maintenance intake writer)\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 5\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T05:40:41Z","createdAt":"2026-09-24T18:49:17Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3488,"title":"Documents-only merge path accepted a .py-touching PR (merged PR #3311) — classifier / verdict-artifact gap","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T05:40:41Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3488"},

{"body":"Non-orchestrator repository maintenance (scripts only; no database structure).\n\n## Problem\n\nEvery governed DeepSeek review started through `scripts/run-governed-review.mjs` fails before reaching the model, so a DeepSeek draw always burns a replacement.\n\n- `promptHeadContract` refuses any wrapper argument list that carries neither `--prompt` nor `--prompt-file` (only `ai-codex-review` is exempt): \"the outbound reviewer prompt carries no terminal VERDICT instruction, because the wrapper arguments contain neither --prompt nor --prompt-file\".\n- `ai-deepseek-agent send` accepts neither flag. Its usage is `send \"<message>\" [--file FILE]... [--review] [--governed-verdict SHA]`, and the runner's own DeepSeek usage text says `-- send \"<prompt>\" --review`.\n- So `send \"<brief>\" --review` is refused by the runner, and `send --prompt-file <file> --review` passes the runner but the wrapper exits 1 about 1.7 s after start, with no model call, and the runner reports \"wrapper stderr was present but its reason was not recognized\".\n\nEvidence (reviewer events on EDGE-DEV):\n- PR #3478, sequence 3772, run `6eea639dc93945509759c4eac1296a4b`: started 16:34:02 UTC, finished 16:34:03 UTC, `wrapper_exit_code: 1`.\n- Another session's shared-db DeepSeek run `fdd898e6ee814ef2ad1617fae13e866c` at 15:05:57 UTC ended the same way in 1.6 s.\n\n## Fix direction\n\nLet `promptHeadContract` bind the verdict instruction to the DeepSeek positional message (the argument after `send`, or after `reply <session-id>`), the same way it binds `--prompt`, or translate `--prompt-file` into the positional message for `ai-deepseek-agent`. Keep the stale-head check. Add a test that a governed DeepSeek `send` passes the runner and reaches the wrapper with the instruction attached.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 70\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by Claude chat 43dbc077-5edc-41f8-b56d-aa871c86ef96 on EDGE-DEV\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T06:31:40Z","createdAt":"2026-09-24T16:46:33Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3479,"title":"Governed runner cannot start a DeepSeek review (prompt contract vs positional message)","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T06:31:40Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3479"},
{"body":"Non-orchestrator repository maintenance (scripts and docs only; no database structure).\n\n## Problem\n\nOn 2026-09-24 Grok reviews on PR #3466 failed and `scripts/run-governed-review.mjs` refused with \"wrapper stderr was present but its reason was not recognized\". The real cause was an xAI billing 403: the account was out of credits. The session that hit it could not tell, so Albert had to open a separate session to find out.\n\nOwner requirement (Albert, verbatim from his chat message): \"Going forward i don't want to have to open a separate session to find out we're out of credit. the session that hit that error should A) know that that's why it failed, and B) tell me in that same session.\"\n\n## Fix\n\nThe ai-devops rotation wrappers (grok, muse, qwen, gemini, deepseek) are being changed to exit 92 and print, on stderr:\n\n- `AI_REVIEWER_OUT_OF_CREDIT provider=<grok|muse|qwen|gemini|deepseek> code=insufficient_quota`\n- `OUT OF CREDIT: <plain-English sentence naming the provider and where to add credit>`\n\nIn this repository:\n\n1. `run-governed-review.mjs` recognizes the anchored machine line and carries the strictly validated `OUT OF CREDIT:` line (one line, printable ASCII, 10-300 chars) verbatim into the REFUSED text as `insufficient_quota: ...`; fixed text when the sentence is absent or invalid. Raw provider billing text from an older wrapper is recognized but never echoed.\n2. `insufficient_quota` becomes a terminal non-verdict, so the assignment is eligible for same-head replacement with `--failure-code insufficient_quota`.\n3. The governed-review runbook tells the session to tell Albert in the same reply, then replace the reviewer.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 80\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by Claude chat 43dbc077-5edc-41f8-b56d-aa871c86ef96 on EDGE-DEV\n","closedAt":"2026-09-24T16:52:45Z","createdAt":"2026-09-24T16:19:28Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3477,"title":"Governed review: name out-of-credit reviewer failures and tell Albert in the same session","updatedAt":"2026-09-24T16:52:45Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3477"},

{"body":"```db-work-scope\r\nstatus: ready\r\nwork_type: structural\r\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\r\npriority: 2\r\nservice_class: standard-application\r\nchange_type: function\r\napplication_return_to: u2giants/popdam3\r\ngenerated_types: not-applicable\r\nlive_assertion: On production, reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease accepts reason not_submitted with NULL http status and a fixed provider_error category, and widens provider_definitive_rejection to HTTP 400/401/402/403/422/429, while every other guard remains unchanged.\r\ndepends_on: 3418\r\nwrites:\r\n  - function public.reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease\r\nreads:\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Request (follow-up to #3418 / PR #3426; consumer u2giants/popdam3#92)\r\n\r\nThe merged `reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease` accepts only `p_reason = 'provider_definitive_rejection'` with `p_http_status` 400 or 422. Two provably no-duplicate cases still have no governed release:\r\n\r\n1. **Never sent:** the worker fails before any provider POST. Add reason `not_submitted`, with `p_http_status` NULL and `p_provider_error` carrying a fixed reason category.\r\n2. **Definitive provider refusal:** the provider answers the POST with 401, 402, 403 or 429 and a parsed error body. Widen the allowed statuses for `provider_definitive_rejection` to 400/401/402/403/422/429.\r\n\r\nKeep every other guard unchanged: current receipt holder only, matching revision, no bound provider job ID, lease still live, no ambiguity markers, and never after a timeout, disconnect or 5xx.\r\n\r\nBehavior tests: each new status/reason resets once; 5xx, timeout and NULL-status with the wrong reason refuse; a bound ID refuses; an expired lease refuses; a wrong owner or revision refuses; no receipt remint to another caller.\r\n\r\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\r\n\r\n\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T14:29:25Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T23:31:18Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"The required check `supabase/tests against an ephemeral database` fails on every run because `supabase db start` pulls `ghcr.io/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.132` anonymously and ghcr refuses it:\n\n`failed to display json stream: error pulling image configuration: download failed after attempts=1: toomanyrequests: retry-after: 253.379µs, allowed: 44000/minute` (run 35900944065, 2026-09-23T19:16:38Z; also run 35898309317).\n\nThis blocks every migration PR. Fix: give the job `packages: read` and log in to ghcr.io with the job's own short-lived `GITHUB_TOKEN` before `supabase db start`, so pulls are authenticated. No repository secret is referenced, so the job's confinement guard still holds. The check is not weakened or skipped.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 1\n```\n\nowner: Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 (this session)\n\nPosted by Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 on edge-dev\n","closedAt":"2026-09-23T21:03:04Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T19:22:11Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## Problem\nThe legacy (v1) lease ref `refs/db-review-active/grok-4.6` still holds issue #2506 / PR #2726 (merged 2026-09-14). Its commit is `reviewer-failure-replacement sequence=2503 reviewer=grok-4.6 ... head=537dd660e1d97308e4e0d07b699ba87c416508d7`.\n\nBecause of it, `--replace-failed-reviewer` counts Grok as \"holding other live leases\" and refuses to draw it. That contradicts the no-per-reviewer-concurrency ruling (#3130). Every recovery path is refused:\n- `--reap-abandoned-review-leases` does not list v1 refs at all (7 candidates, all v2).\n- `--release-failed-reviewer --failure-code review_target_superseded` refuses with: `an existing verdict for the exact head forbids reviewer release`.\n\nThe review was completed and the PR merged, but the lease was never released, and no sanctioned command can release it. Hand-deleting the ref is forbidden.\n\n## Impact\nPR #3438 (#2374) slot 1 cannot replace a failed Muse draw. Muse is down upstream (popcre/ai-devops#683), and the owner restricted reviewers to Muse and Grok.\n\n## Fix wanted\nEither make the reaper retire v1 leases whose PR is merged or closed and whose exact head has a durable verdict, or stop counting a completed-verdict lease as busy in the replacement path.\n\nowner: u2giants (Claude chat 92a42be3-3e86-48d4-976d-a33d0bdc6679)\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 80\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nPosted by Claude chat 92a42be3-3e86-48d4-976d-a33d0bdc6679 on edge-dev\n","closedAt":"2026-09-24T10:24:18Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T19:17:15Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3449,"title":"Stale legacy Grok review lease (PR #2726) cannot be released and blocks replacement draws","updatedAt":"2026-09-24T10:24:18Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3449"},
{"body":"The production owner-decision gate (`scripts/production_owner_decision_evidence.py` `parse_comment`) requires `author_association == OWNER`. Since the repository moved to the `popcre` organization (2026-09-18) the owner's comments carry `MEMBER`, so no owner decision can pass. This blocks #2995 from production.\r\n\r\nFix: bind the check to the owner's exact login **and** immutable numeric user id (config file `config/production-owner-identity.json`), accepting association OWNER or MEMBER only for that identity. An arbitrary MEMBER, an impostor login, a right login with wrong id, and COLLABORATOR/NONE stay refused. Tests added.\r\n\r\n```db-work-scope\r\nstatus: ready\r\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\r\nroute: repo-maintenance\r\nservice_class: maintenance\r\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\r\npriority: 80\r\ndepends_on:\r\nwrites:\r\nreads:\r\n```\r\n\r\nowner: Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 (this session)\r\n\r\nPosted by Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 on edge-dev\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-23T23:06:30Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T18:27:44Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3443,"title":"Owner-decision gate: bind to owner login+id, not OWNER association (blocks #2995)","updatedAt":"2026-09-23T23:06:30Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3443"},

{"body":"## Failure and consequence\n\nPR #3426 (issue #3418) merged as 0a086c31. Its merged-main preview preparation refused: \"pull request #3426 structural objects do not exactly match claim #3425 writes; preview preparation refused\". Claim #3425 conservatively locks two functions; the migration writes only one. No sanctioned command narrows a claim (only expand), so the structural outcome is stranded before preview.\n\nFix: preview preparation accepts a claim that over-declares (a superset of the SQL's writes), because broader locks only excluded other writers. Any unclaimed write, empty set or duplicate still refuses. Repository maintenance only; no database or production action.\n\nowner: Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 on edge-dev\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 1\nlive_assertion: A merged structural PR whose claim over-declares its writes can be prepared for merged-main preview, while an unclaimed write still refuses.\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\nPosted by Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 on edge-dev\n","closedAt":"2026-09-28T00:34:44Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T18:03:25Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3437,"title":"Preview preparation refuses a claim that over-declares its writes (#3418 stranded)","updatedAt":"2026-09-28T00:34:44Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3437"},

{"body":"## Outcome\n\nFix the queue interlock race named in the workflow-refactor closeout (section 5):\n\n> PR3279 releases its merge lock after queue admission. Its merge-group workflow reads authorization once, can wait25 minutes, then posts synthetic success without re-acquiring/rechecking the production interlock. Test admission -> production freeze/revocation -> queue authorization/actual merge. Asynchronous merge requires ownership through the actual mutation, not merely through status posting. Do not activate as-is.\n\nPR3279's merge-group path could carry a pre-wait authorization success through a25-minute preview hold and post group-SHA success without re-checking the production interlock. A production freeze in that window revokes the PR-head status and takes the production lane; the stale success would still let GitHub merge.\n\nAsynchronous merge must own the mutation: acquire the exclusive merge lane, re-read PR-head authorization and the production interlock under that lane, post group-SHA success only when both are live and clear, and hold the lane until GitHub lands the merge. Failure after posting revokes the group-SHA status.\n\nThis is non-orchestrator repository maintenance. It changes no database structure. It does not activate the merge queue.\n\nowner: Claude chat ses_ffe5f3502886afferuQXFHy584 on al8960ofc\n\nAlbert authorized this takeover: \"spin up a subagent to takeover PR 3279.\"\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: workflow\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T07:56:41Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T03:16:39Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3421,"title":"Queue interlock must re-check authorization under the merge lock through the mutation","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T07:56:41Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3421"},
{"body":"```db-work-scope\r\nstatus: ready\r\nwork_type: structural\r\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\r\nservice_class: standard-application\r\nchange_type: function\r\npriority: 2\r\ndepends_on:\r\napplication_return_to: u2giants/popdam3\r\ngenerated_types: not-applicable\r\nlive_assertion: In production, only the current unexpired submission-lease holder presenting its exact receipt and current revision can reset an unbound provider submission after PopDAM verifies provider origin and parses a nonempty JSON validation error with HTTP 400 or 422; timeout, disconnect, unreadable or plain-text error, other 4xx, 5xx, expired or ambiguous lease, bound provider ID, wrong holder, wrong receipt, or wrong revision cannot reset or remint a receipt for another caller. PopDAM owns the later no-duplicate-POST live retry proof.\r\nwrites:\r\n  - function public.reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease\r\nreads:\r\n  - table public.admin_config\r\n```\r\n\r\n## Request (from u2giants/popdam3#92, umbrella #143)\r\n\r\nOwner authorization: Albert explicitly authorized this narrow structural request in the PopDAM #143 session on 2026-09-23 (\"authorized.\").\r\n\r\nPopDAM's restart-safe batch tagging mints exactly one submission receipt (lease) before a provider batch ID is bound (migrations 20260819011639, 20260820142402, 20260824004025). When the provider **definitively rejects** the submission POST with a verified provider-origin HTTP 400 or 422 and a parsed nonempty JSON validation error, the receipt is already consumed and no safe path resets it, so the operation cannot retry. Other 4xx statuses have no established provider-specific finality contract here and remain unresolved, alongside timeout, disconnect, unreadable or plain-text error, and 5xx ambiguity.\r\n\r\nAdd a narrow reset contract. PR #3426 implements a new public.reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease function; the existing public.update_bulk_operation function remains unchanged. Protected claim #3425 still conservatively locks both functions:\r\n\r\n- Only the **current receipt holder** may reset, with the current receipt + current revision.\r\n- Only when **no provider job ID is bound** and the lease is **still live** (not expired).\r\n- Requires a narrow reason enum, e.g. `provider_definitive_rejection`.\r\n- Never allowed after timeout/disconnect ambiguity, by a new owner, or after expiry.\r\n\r\nBehavior tests required: no duplicate POST path, no receipt remint to another caller, expired-lease ambiguity preserved, bound-ID refusal, wrong-revision refusal.\r\n\r\nConsumer: PopDAM branch `codex/issue-92-direct-gemini-batch` (WIP 653cb150) will adopt the contract after merge. It must verify provider origin and parse the nonempty JSON error before calling this RPC; its current WIP path treats unreadable non-2xx responses as definitive and must be corrected. Statuses beyond 400/422 require a separately evidenced provider contract. No PopDAM migration will be written. PopDAM owns the later live no-duplicate-POST retry proof.\r\n\r\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cc62-9aa9-79f2-88b6-e3aa64970e8c on EDGE-DEV\r\n\r\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cc62-9aa9-79f2-88b6-e3aa64970e8c on EDGE-DEV\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cc6b-070f-7c32-b31a-827428e36332 on EDGE-DEV\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T04:14:26Z","createdAt":"2026-09-23T01:14:27Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2YAgzg","name":"orchestrator","description":"Changes shared-database structure (or curated Master Data load): orchestrator work","color":"B60205"}],"number":3418,"title":"HANDOVER: PopDAM bulk-operation definitive-rejection submission-lease reset (popdam3#92)","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T04:14:26Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3418"},

{"body":"## Failure and consequence\n\nStructural PR #3391 (work issue #2110) is repaired at exact head `97fa9467fda9f40a7159d783a3ac012ceecdb73c`; SQL migration guards and Agent work contract pass. The only failing check is `Migration author lease`: claim #3378 is expired. Guarded renewal refuses `claim carries objects unsupported by its issue or pull request: table app.rolepermissions`.\n\nThe historical claim contains an extra lower-case, unquoted `table app.rolepermissions` lock. The issue scope and PR refer to quoted `table app.\"RolePermissions\"`, which is a different PostgreSQL object. Deleting the extra lock loses protection; adding it to structural issue #2110 would falsely state an intended write. Read-only diagnosis found no supported path: renewal rejects the extra lock; recovery-from-PR only appends missing locks; resumption requires a relinquished lease, while this one remains active/expired. Reviewer locks, migration and backup remain untouched; no preview/production/merge is authorized.\n\nRepair the claim manager's guarded renewal or governed recovery so an already-held historical superset can be retained without representing unsupported objects as current writes. Require exact claim identity, actual PR/issue object validation, no narrowing of existing locks, and regression coverage for case-sensitive PostgreSQL identifiers and collision protection. Then renew claim #3378, rerun the lease check, and obtain fresh independent reviews for PR #3391's repaired head before any guarded merge. Repository-maintenance work only.\n\nowner: popcre/shared-db repository-maintenance queue (@u2giants). The orchestrator tracks this blocker without altering the claim.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 1\nlive_assertion: A protected historical claim can be safely renewed with every existing lock retained while current issue and PR writes remain accurately validated.\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T07:00:38Z","createdAt":"2026-09-22T22:16:37Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## Failure and current production consequence\n\nAfter guarded merge of structural PR #3382 at `c384c26cc7865419c37f6b1520028e1053f65c23`, the required merged-main preview preparation for orchestrator work #2995 refuses `the exact head has no durable reviewer assignment`. The PR head is `d204df7a4b2d878829e2591a39d9b2d43b680234`; two durable approvals exist at content-equivalent prior head `1c3501e9798fd51d3d9878288a9f96b7a68c3d91`. `PR_NUMBER=3382 REQUESTED_SHA=d204... node scripts/check-exact-head-approval.mjs` passes with two carried approvals and implementation digest `3cd1946a15c76c3e4d2aaa443346e5eaf6738c01e217918f68154b7471e89975`.\n\nThe preview gate calls `assertDurableReviewApproval` with the current main tip. `isContentPreservingRefresh` explicitly rejects an already-merged head when compared with current main (source comment #3146), instructing comparison against main before the merge. Direct read-only reproduction: `{ok:false, reason:'d204... is already contained in c384c26...; compare against main before the merge'}`. Consequently the existing approved head is never carried by preview preparation even though the exact-head CI gate passed and the guarded merge succeeded. No preview or production workflow was dispatched.\n\nRepair the merged-preview approval check so it uses the guarded merge's verified first parent as the comparison base, while preserving exact PR/head, durable assignment and verdict, implementation-digest, merge ancestry, claim, ledger, and preview-manifest checks. Add a regression for a merged PR with content-equivalent prior-head approval and for a changed implementation/refusal. Then verify `--prepare-preview-dispatch 2995 --admit-issue 2995 --pr 3382` succeeds only with the correct live marker and immutable evidence. This is repository-maintenance work; do not route it to the structure orchestrator.\n\nowner: popcre/shared-db repository-maintenance queue (@u2giants). The current orchestrator tracks this as a production blocker.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 0\nlive_assertion: A merged structural PR whose current head has two valid durable content-equivalent approvals can prepare a bounded merged-main preview without relaxing any review or production guard.\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on EDGE-DEV\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T06:30:29Z","createdAt":"2026-09-22T22:14:50Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"owner: popcre/shared-db repository-maintenance queue (@u2giants)\n\nThe direct guarded merge lane refuses a pull request when its recorded base SHA is not exactly the latest `main`, even when `check-main-tip-freshness --contains` has proved that intervening main commits do not change the pull request's files or migration versions. This creates a repeated refresh/evidence/CI loop while documentation merges advance main.\n\nLive reproductions on 2026-09-22:\n- PR #3345 guarded run https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/actions/runs/35788176124 refused: `REFUSED: pull request is not based on the current main tip`.\n- PR #3382 guarded run https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/actions/runs/35788518295 refused with the same line after its local content freshness, lease, reviews, and checks passed.\n- The exact equality refusal is in `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs` at exclusive merge acquisition (`pr.base?.sha !== io.mainSha?.()`). Branch refresh then causes the Agent work contract to require a fresh evidence base; #3382 and #3385 have each had to repair that evidence while unrelated documentation continued landing.\n\nRepair the direct lane so its exclusive lock re-proves current main and the same content/version overlap and admission/refusal conditions as its documented freshness policy. Preserve exact-head reviews, object/version locks, required checks, serialized merge, and production freeze. Add a regression for unrelated main movement and a refusal for an actual overlapping change. Do not use admin merge or disable checks. Coordinate with #3280's merge-queue work; this direct-lane defect exists before queue activation.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 1000\n```\n\nThis is repository-maintenance work outside the structural orchestrator. The current orchestrator retains the affected production outcomes; its structural authors do not edit the merge guard.\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cb03-daa2-79d2-85fd-6a8904abfc53 on edge-dev\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-23T00:42:21Z","createdAt":"2026-09-22T22:01:13Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## What this is\n\nTen open pull requests all edit `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs`. `Cross-PR object collision` serialises them by design, and `pr-content-equivalence.mjs` correctly voids every other PR's approval each time that file changes on `main`. Landing them singly costs a fresh review and a fresh check round per merge — quadratic, against a GitHub rate limit this account tripped twice on 2026-09-20.\n\nThis issue owns the consolidation: one combined branch that MERGES all ten contributing branches (never rebases, never force-pushes), preserving every author's commits, reviewed once and merged once.\n\n## Absorbed pull requests and the issues they close\n\n| PR | branch | closes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| #3314 | `claude/2678-reviewer-caller-env` | #2678 |\n| #3316 | `claude/reviewer-release-readback-2457-2844` | #2457 |\n| #3334 | `claude/2549-2781-evidence-identity` | #2549 |\n| #3317 | `codex/outcome-timestamp-recovery-20260920` | #3313 |\n| #3322 | `claude/lane-quad-2448-3125-2491-3117-2e3c24d5` | #2448 |\n| #3325 | `codex/claim-alias-01a0bf00` | #3319 |\n| #3338 | `claude/reviewer-trio-2915-2998-2923-2e3c24d5` | #2998 |\n| #3344 | `codex/maintenance-completion-3291-916` | #3343 |\n| #3315 | `claude/2836-return-loop` | #2836 |\n| #3326 | `claude/2824-3050-queue-governance-refusals` | #2824, #3050 |\n\n## Deliberately excluded\n\n- **#3308** — actively worked by another session (last activity 17:06Z on 2026-09-20). Not absorbed, not touched.\n- **#3330** — merged to `main` on its own at 17:10:58Z while this work was in progress. Its content is already in the base; issue #2832 is not this issue's to close.\n\n## Scope\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 100\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\nreturn_to: popcre/shared-db\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\n\nNot orchestrator work under AGENTS.md §0.0-C: it changes no database object, ships no migration, and touches no schema.\n\nowner: Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n\nPosted by Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T07:14:28Z","createdAt":"2026-09-20T17:26:28Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3353,"title":"Consolidate the ten serialised manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs pull requests into one reviewed merge","updatedAt":"2026-09-25T07:14:28Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3353"},
{"body":"```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nservice_class: maintenance\nchange_type: reviewer-tooling\npriority: 50\ndepends_on:\n```\n\nowner: Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n\n## Where this came from\n\nThe governed review of PR #3338 (issues #2998, #2923) by `muse-spark-1.3-contributor` returned **APPROVE** at `4d1980e041252a2eaabe486c48a120756c2c1af3` and left one advisory LOW finding, quoted verbatim:\n\n> **LOW — closed-but-unmerged PRs remain drawable (the invited challenge).** The `DELIBERATELY NOT CHECKED` reasoning at `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs:1776-1782` is overbroad: it conflates merged with merely closed. `getPr` returns the full pulls payload including `merged`/`merged_at` (`:2367`; fixtures throughout use `merged_at`), so a narrow refusal — `state==='closed' && merged!==true && !merged_at`, fail-open when merge fields are absent — would preserve `#2915` exactly (merged PRs always carry `merged_at`, which the binding itself requires) while stopping draws on abandoned PRs whose verdicts can never be acted on. That is the same waste class `#2998` targets, left open. Efficiency only; no safety violation, hence advisory.\n\nThe reviewer is right, and its predicate is more precise than the one I declined. I declined a *broad* non-open refusal during #3338 because it would have silently undone #2915 (a merged PR bound by the verified merged-PR issue binding must stay drawable). The narrow form above does not have that problem.\n\nIt was not folded into #3338 because it is outside the five readiness pre-conditions #2998 actually lists (branch current, no conflicts, evidence pair valid, not a draft, no cross-PR object collision), and folding it in would have invalidated the exact-head APPROVE and cost another review round for an explicitly advisory efficiency item.\n\n## Outcome needed\n\nIn `assertReviewerDrawReadiness`, refuse a pull request that is **closed and not merged**, using exactly the reviewer's predicate:\n\n- refuse when `state === 'closed' && merged !== true && !merged_at`\n- **fail open when the merge fields are absent**, so an unreadable or partial payload never becomes a refusal\n- a **merged** pull request must stay drawable — #2915 depends on it\n\nReplace the `DELIBERATELY NOT CHECKED` comment block with the narrower reasoning.\n\n## Required proof\n\nA regression test that **fails against the unfixed code first** (say so explicitly), covering all four shapes: closed-and-unmerged refuses; merged stays drawable; open stays drawable; absent merge fields fail open. The existing test `#3338 review: readiness does not refuse a merged pull request (#2915 stays delivered)` must keep passing — it is the guard against re-breaking #2915.\n\nNon-orchestrator work: this does not change database structure.\n\nPosted by Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n","closedAt":"2026-09-24T12:17:46Z","createdAt":"2026-09-20T16:24:32Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3348,"title":"Reviewer readiness: refuse a closed-but-unmerged PR without breaking the merged-PR binding","updatedAt":"2026-09-24T12:17:46Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3348"},
{"body":"owner: Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n\n**No session can draw a governed reviewer right now.** Every reviewer command in `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs` refuses on the same root condition, and both of its own documented recoveries refuse on it too. Found on 2026-09-20 while trying to draw slot 1 for PR #3326 (issues #2824 and #3050).\n\n## Verbatim refusals\n\n```\nREFUSED: active reviewer leases are unreadable; reviewer assignment refused before mutex acquisition\nREFUSED: active reviewer leases are unreadable; reviewer capacity is unknown\nREFUSED: active reviewer leases are unreadable; nothing was reaped\nREFUSED: active reviewer lease snapshot is unreadable\n```\n\nCommands, in order: `--assign-reviewer --issue 2824 --pr 3326 --head-sha 916509335cf4235ad9bc73764f20192909bd98e9`, `--reviewer-capacity`, `--reap-abandoned-review-leases`, `--archive-old-review-verdicts`.\n\n## The deadlock\n\n`AGENTS.md` states the sanctioned response to an unreadable lease listing is `--reap-abandoned-review-leases --apply-recovery`, \"never a cap\". That command is itself refused by the same condition (`manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs:5027`), as is the verdict archiver. **The documented recovery cannot run, so the refusal cannot be cleared by the sanctioned route.** No cap was applied and no ceiling was raised.\n\n## Probable cause — a ref namespace past its ceiling\n\n`REVIEW_REF_ROW_LIMIT` is 1000 (`manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs:230`), and the listing refuses \"a possibly truncated reviewer audit\" at or past it (`:2474`). Live ref counts read read-only through `gh api .../git/matching-refs`:\n\n| prefix | refs |\n| --- | ---: |\n| `refs/db-review-assignments` | **2286** |\n| `refs/db-review-verdicts` | **592** |\n| `refs/db-review-active` | 42 |\n\n`refs/db-review-assignments` is more than twice the ceiling. The active leases themselves are only 42, so **\"active reviewer leases are unreadable\" is misreporting the cause**: nothing is wrong with the active leases.\n\n## Second defect — the real cause is swallowed\n\nThe specific refusal (`ceiling`, `paginated`, or `command-size`, each of which carries its prefix and row count at `:2473`, `:2474`, `:2065`) is collapsed into the generic `active reviewer leases are unreadable` before it reaches the caller. The code already comments on this hazard at `:239`, `:2472` and `:4832`. A caller is told the wrong thing and pointed at a recovery that cannot help. Whoever fixes the ceiling should also let the underlying refusal through, or the next occurrence costs another session the same hour.\n\n## What is needed\n\n1. A retirement path for `refs/db-review-assignments` that works when the namespace is already past the ceiling — the current recoveries all read the whole listing first, which is the thing that fails.\n2. Surface the true refusal (prefix, row count, reason) instead of the generic message.\n3. Retire refs rather than raising the ceiling, per the standing rule at `:2474` and issue #2152.\n\n**No ceiling was raised, no cap applied, no ref deleted, and no synthetic verdict posted.** All reads above were read-only.\n\n## Impact\n\nPR #3326 (issues #2824, #3050) is otherwise green — every required check passes except `Cross-PR object collision`, which is waiting on seven earlier open PRs that edit the same coordination source. It cannot reach a governed review while this is down. Any other session needing a reviewer is equally blocked.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 150\ndepends_on:\n```\n\nThis is **non-orchestrator work**: it changes no database structure.\n\nPosted by Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n","closedAt":"2026-09-20T16:31:37Z","createdAt":"2026-09-20T16:18:30Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3346,"title":"Governed reviewer draw is down repo-wide: refs/db-review-assignments is past the 1000-ref ceiling and both sanctioned recoveries refuse on the same condition","updatedAt":"2026-09-20T20:46:07Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3346"},

{"body":"Five tests in `scripts/orchestrator-snapshot.test.mjs` fail on clean `origin/main` (`b1d4be2e`). Found while verifying #3081 and #3048.\n\n**Verbatim evidence line:**\n\n```\n✖ only trusted, well-formed outcome events are read (0.3973ms)\n```\n\nFull list of failures on clean `origin/main`:\n\n```\n✖ issue 3148 only a request the queue audit itself would admit alarms after 30 minutes\n✖ only trusted, well-formed outcome events are read\n✖ successor reconstructs the exact active map from the live snapshot and verifies it fresh\n✖ unchanged state produces zero output and no report; each transition wakes exactly once\n✖ events on a claim thread about an unowned issue are dropped\n```\n\n**Cause.** `scripts/orchestrator-snapshot.test.mjs:12` builds its trusted fixture comment with a hardcoded association:\n\n```js\nconst ownerComment = (event) => ({ author_association: 'OWNER', author: 'u2giants', body: formatEventComment(event) })\n```\n\nSince the `popcre` transfer (#2530, commit `bf0744f6`), `expectedOperatorAssociation()` correctly returns `MEMBER` for any repository whose owner is not `u2giants`, so `isTrustedOperatorComment` discards every fixture event and each assertion sees an empty list. The failure is deterministic and environment-independent: `trustedOutcomeComments` defaults to `currentRepository()`, which resolves to `popcre/shared-db`.\n\n**Production behaviour is correct, not broken.** A live read of `repos/popcre/shared-db/issues/3081/comments` returns `{\"assoc\":\"MEMBER\",\"user\":\"u2giants\"}`, which is exactly what the production check now expects. Only the test fixtures are stale — this is a red test file, not a trust failure.\n\n**Fix.** Derive the fixture association from `expectedOperatorAssociation()` instead of hardcoding it, so the test stops asserting a pre-transfer fact and keeps proving that the *login* check is what rejects an untrusted author.\n\nScope: one test file. No production code, no database, no migration, no schema change.\n\nowner: Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\nchange_type: repo-maintenance\npriority: 80\n```\n\nPosted by Claude chat 2e3c24d5-f6b8-44f8-b49f-3c67c1647d13 on 916-alien\n","closedAt":"2026-09-20T20:03:08Z","createdAt":"2026-09-20T15:40:19Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":3331,"title":"orchestrator-snapshot tests are red on main: fixtures hardcode the pre-transfer OWNER association (#2530 fallout)","updatedAt":"2026-09-20T20:25:54Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/3331"},
