{"body":"## Outcome\n\nGive PopDAM a durable, application-owned item-dismissal state and preserve its existing AI category-review history before `public.erp_items_current` can be retired. This is the structural dependency discovered while implementing u2giants/popdam3#118 and must not be worked around in application code.\n\n## Why application code cannot finish this safely\n\nThe pending canonical view in #2466 keeps the 21-column contract, but its `dismissed` value is still `coalesce(legacy.dismissed, false)` from `public.erp_items_current`. The joined view is not an update target, so PopDAM cannot persist dismiss/restore without continuing to write the retired table.\n\n`public.product_category_predictions.erp_item_id` also still references `public.erp_items_current(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`. Existing review decisions would therefore be deleted when #2482 drops that table, and canonical-only ColdLion items cannot safely use that FK. Item numbers are not globally unique across divisions, so a bare text key is insufficient for new state.\n\n## Required contract\n\n1. Add a PopDAM-owned state table keyed to the canonical `plm.item` identity, with at least `dismissed`, actor, and timestamps. Do not add application state to source-owned `plm.item`.\n2. Before switching reads, migrate every currently dismissed legacy decision by an exact canonical match. Re-measure live at execution time; unresolved or ambiguous matches must fail closed and be reported, never guessed.\n3. Replace #2466's legacy `dismissed` join with the app-owned state while preserving the existing `api.plm_item_list.dismissed` output.\n4. Provide an admin/service-role-only batch function for PopDAM to set and clear dismissed state using a stable canonical identity. It must reject missing or ambiguous identities and support a verified dismiss -> fresh read -> restore round trip.\n5. Preserve every `product_category_predictions` row before removing its legacy FK. Add or repoint a canonical item identity without deleting review history; backfill exact matches and leave ambiguous history visible and explicitly unresolved.\n6. Add contract tests for authorization, migration completeness, ambiguous/missing identity refusal, history preservation, and the dismissal round trip.\n\nPopDAM can derive its historical `raw_mg_fields` display/classification context from the canonical MG columns, so no extra raw-payload exposure is requested here.\n\n## Sequencing\n\n- Depends on / must coordinate with #2466 because both touch `api.plm_item_list`.\n- Blocks u2giants/popdam3#118 completion and this repo's #2482 retirement.\n- No production apply is authorized by this issue; use the normal preview, review, merge, and promotion gates.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 1000\ndepends_on:\nblocks: 2482\nwrites:\n  - table public.popdam_item_state\n  - function public.set_popdam_item_dismissed\n  - view api.plm_item_list\n  - table public.product_category_predictions\n  - column public.product_category_predictions.plm_item_id\n  - column public.product_category_predictions.item_identity_status\n  - function public.resolve_product_category_prediction_item_identity\n  - trigger product_category_predictions_resolve_item_identity on public.product_category_predictions\n  - index public.idx_product_category_predictions_plm_item_id\nreads:\n  - table plm.item\n  - table public.erp_items_current\n```","closedAt":"2026-09-10T00:26:02Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T18:01:57Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2644,"title":"PopDAM: preserve item dismissals and AI review identity before ERP table retirement","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:16:44Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2644"},

{"body":"`scripts/reap-merged-worktrees.mjs` decides RETIRE from two facts: the worktree is clean, and its branch has a merged pull request. It does not check whether the worktree's branch has commits that were never pushed.\n\nMeasured 2026-09-09 on EDGE-DEV-2, dry run, 16 RETIRE candidates. Three of them had unpushed commits, counted with `git -C <wt> log --oneline '@{upstream}..HEAD'`:\n\n- `C:/repos/shared-db/.claude/worktrees/issue-2449-single-resolution-ledger` (`claude/issue-2449-single-resolution-ledger`) — 3 commits\n- `C:/repos/shared-db-worktrees/coldlion-to-comment` (`codex/coldlion-to-comment`) — 2 commits\n- `C:/repos/shared-db-worktrees/issue-2285-muse-1-3` (`codex/issue-2285-muse-1-3`) — 2 commits\n\nA merged pull request on the branch is exactly what makes these look safe: the earlier work landed, then someone committed more locally and stopped. `--apply` would have destroyed all seven commits, and because the worktrees are clean the \"UNCOMMITTED CHANGES\" guard never fires. Deleting a worktree drops the only checkout of those commits; nothing else references them.\n\nThis session did not run `--apply`. The 13 candidates with zero unpushed commits were removed by hand instead; 2 of those refused with `Permission denied` because a live process holds the directory, which is normal and is not this bug.\n\n**Fix:** treat a non-zero `@{upstream}..HEAD` count as KEEP, with a reason line naming the count, exactly as the uncommitted-changes guard does. A branch with no upstream at all should also be KEEP rather than RETIRE. Add a fixture that goes red on a clean worktree whose merged branch has one unpushed commit.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\r\npriority: 0\ndepends_on:\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\nFiled by the EDGE-DEV-2 orchestrator closeout (marker #2597).","closedAt":"2026-09-11T12:41:34Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T06:38:38Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2624,"title":"reap-merged-worktrees.mjs would delete worktrees holding unpushed commits","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:16:57Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2624"},
{"body":"## Proven structural blocker\n\nThe 2026-09-09 live read-only `/merchGroupDetails` probe returned 1,384 current rows across explicit `active=Y` and `active=N` requests. The applied four-part table key `(company_code, division_code, mg_type_code, mg_code)` produces only 1,038 distinct identities: 346 rows collide. The colliding rows differ in `mg_category`, `mg_desc`, and source audit fields, so selecting one would silently retain the wrong description.\n\nAdding `mg_category` to the identity produces 1,384 distinct keys with zero collisions. No payload values were retained or published.\n\n## Required outcome\n\nCreate a forward migration that makes `coldlion.merch_group_detail` identity `(company_code, division_code, mg_type_code, mg_category, mg_code)` while preserving existing data and the header relationship. Update structural contracts and confirm no dependent object assumes the obsolete four-part key.\n\nThis issue does not authorize a production data load. It unblocks source-data issue #2621, whose no-schema-change contract correctly refuses to collapse these rows.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 20\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - table coldlion.merch_group_detail\nreads: []\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-10T14:38:23Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T02:47:51Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2622,"title":"ColdLion merch-group detail key omits category and collapses 346 live rows","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:16:59Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2622"},
{"body":"## What is missing\n\nThe ColdLion master landing tables have structural destinations but no current-state loader. Seven master tables are empty, while the three item tables contain an earlier partial sync that must be reconciled without truncation.\n\n## Scope\n\nBuild `sync-masters.mjs` for customers, vendors, divisions, salespeople, seasons, merchandise-group headers/details, items, item details, and item merchandise-group rows. Masters are full current-state upserts, never history windows and never sealed in the history ledger.\n\n## Safety\n\n- No schema change and no live database write from an authoring session.\n- The GitHub workflow is the only real-database path and must prove `COLDLION_EXPECTED_PROJECT_REF` before writing.\n- No real ColdLion business value may enter this public repository.\n- `/seasons` is fetched per division; EP001 is excluded.\n- Existing item rows are reconciled transactionally and never truncated.\n\n## Done when\n\nDeclared API parameter evidence and an operational `/merchGroupDetails` probe are retained without payload values; offline tests pass; an independent governed review approves the exact head; the PR merges; and the merged workflow produces a read-only proof report.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: source-data\nroute: source-data-session\nreturn_to: u2giants/shared-db\npriority: 60\ndepends_on:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-10T20:32:50Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T02:27:30Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2621,"title":"ColdLion Step 7: fill and reconcile master landing tables","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:00Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2621"},
{"body":"```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: source-data\nroute: source-data-session\r\npriority: 0\nreturn_to: u2giants/shared-db\ndepends_on:\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\n## What is needed\n\nRun the merged ColdLion history backfill all the way back to the 2019-01-01 grid\nanchor, so the order and production history landing tables hold the full vendor\nhistory rather than only the recent weeks the nightly sync covers.\n\nThe loader and its workflow are already merged and proven end to end:\n\n- PR #2589, merge commit `7c32df1419db423e1310593ee9a748eb2c3d7409` (issue #2588).\n- The backfill workflow is `.github/workflows/coldlion-history-backfill.yml`. It is\n  the only sanctioned way to run against the real database.\n- The production connection secret `SUPABASE_DB_URL_PRODUCTION` exists (created\n  2026-09-09) and a `dry_run=true` dispatch succeeded: the target check passed and\n  the run reported the outstanding window/scope pairs.\n- The nightly sync is scheduled at 05:20 UTC and covers the trailing weeks.\n\n## What makes this delicate\n\n- **A loaded window is sealed forever.** Ledger triggers make the page evidence and\n  the loaded state immutable, so a window loaded on incomplete evidence cannot be\n  corrected by re-running. Never widen the batch to \"save time\".\n- The run is resumable by design: it reads the ledger and loads only outstanding\n  window/scope pairs. Run it in bounded batches with `--limit`, check the ledger\n  between batches, and stop on the first refusal rather than retrying blind.\n- The vendor caps page size silently at 200 and reports a refused history request as\n  HTTP 400 on the wire while its body claims 500. Permanence is decided by the wire\n  status, except 408 and 429 which mean \"later\".\n- ~350 weekly windows times the scope list is a long walk. Expect it to take days of\n  wall clock, not one run, and expect vendor-side rate limiting.\n\n## Suggested prompt for the session that picks this up\n\nDo not modify the loader to make the backfill go faster. Dispatch the existing\nbackfill workflow in bounded batches, oldest first, and after each batch read the\nledger to confirm every window it claims to have loaded carries complete page\nevidence. If a window refuses permanently, record which window and which scope and\nwhy, and move on rather than forcing it. Report progress as \"windows loaded of\nwindows outstanding\", from the ledger, never from the run log.\n\n## Where the detail lives\n\n`tools/coldlion-landing/README.md` on `main`, and issue #2588.\n","closedAt":"2026-09-10T20:32:53Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T02:16:25Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2620,"title":"ColdLion history: backfill the landing tables to the 2019 grid anchor","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:02Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2620"},
{"body":"```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: source-data\nroute: source-data-session\r\npriority: 0\nreturn_to: u2giants/shared-db\ndepends_on:\nwrites: []\nreads: []\n```\n\n## What is needed\n\nThe ColdLion landing loader (merged as PR #2589, issue #2588) fills the order and\nproduction history landing tables. It does not yet fill the master-data landing\ntables that those history rows point at. Add the remaining master-data units to the\nsame loader so a history row can be resolved to a named customer, factory, division,\nsalesperson, season and merchandise group.\n\nOutstanding units, all landing-only (`coldlion.*`, never `core.*` directly):\n\n- customer master\n- vendor / factory master\n- division\n- salesperson\n- season\n- merch_group_header and merch_group_detail\n\n`item_*` is already partly populated by the merged loader; check what it actually\nholds before touching it.\n\nKnown vendor facts that constrain this work (all previously verified, all recorded\nas memories in this repo's session memory):\n\n- `/merchGroupDetails` returns 200 with zero rows for every query attempted.\n- `/divisions` contradicts `/items` on at least one division code (SPRUCE).\n- Division codes do NOT determine company: CW001 exists under three companies.\n- Out-of-enum parameter values return an empty success envelope, not an error, so a\n  typo reads as \"no data\".\n- Undeclared parameters are ignored rather than rejected; read the declared parameter\n  list before concluding a filter is broken.\n- A page size above the vendor's cap is silently reduced to 200.\n\n## Suggested prompt for the session that picks this up\n\nUse the loader that already exists rather than writing a second one: the HTTP paging,\nvalue normalisation, target proof, page-evidence ledger and per-window transaction in\n`tools/coldlion-landing/lib/` are all reusable. Master data is not windowed the way\nhistory is — decide deliberately whether each unit is a full snapshot replace or an\nincremental upsert, and write that decision down where the next reader will find it.\nEvery entry point must prove its target database before writing, exactly as the\nhistory loader does. No real payload value may be committed to this public repository.\n\n## Where the detail lives\n\n`tools/coldlion-landing/README.md` on `main`, and issue #2588.\n","closedAt":"2026-09-10T20:32:57Z","createdAt":"2026-09-09T02:16:09Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2619,"title":"ColdLion loader: add customer, vendor/factory, division, salesperson, season and merch-group master data","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:03Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2619"},

{"body":"## The gap\n\nOwner ruling, `docs/business-rules/product-items-and-identifiers.md:23`:\n\n> **Settled — Albert Hazan, 2026-09-06.** A prepack is not an Item. ... Prepacks must be excluded from any population being assessed for missing Licensor or Property, not chased for attribution.\n\n> `:25` — \"Reporting an assortment head as an Item with missing Licensor data is a false defect.\"\n\n**It exists only as prose.** Verified 2026-09-08 across every migration, every function body (`pg_proc` scan for \"prepack\" returned empty), and every script: nothing filters on prepack. `scripts/popsg-property-psg1-inventory.cjs` and `scripts/popsg-property-psg2-proposals.cjs` contain no prepack or assortment reference at all and do not read `erp_items_current` or `api.plm_item_list`. The exclusion is being applied by hand, if at all — so every missing-Licensor count we have produced since 2026-09-06 may carry false defects.\n\n## Outcome\n\nImplement the exclusion in code so the ruling holds without anyone remembering it, and so a count cannot silently regress.\n\n- Decide and document the single authoritative \"is this an assortment head\" test. Today `public.erp_items_current.prepack_code` marks HEADS; `plm.\"itemDetail\".prepack_code_fk` marks MEMBERS. They are not interchangeable and have been confused before.\n- Apply it in the missing-Licensor / missing-Property population scripts and in whatever view or function serves those populations.\n- Add a test that fails if a known assortment head reappears in a missing-attribution population.\n\n## Depends on\n\n`#2610` — the head flag is currently only in a frozen 2026-05-21 DesignFlow snapshot. Implementing the filter against a source that is about to be repointed hard-codes the wrong column. Settle the live source first, or write the filter behind one function so the source swap is a one-line change.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\napplication_return_to: popcre/shared-db\nlive_assertion: .github/live-proofs/2611.sql passes on production (no recorded licensed-division prepack head appears in plm.item_missing_attribution)\npriority: 35\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - function plm.prepack_role\n  - view plm.item_missing_attribution\n  - table plm.item_missing_attribution\nservice_class: standard-application\nchange_type: migration\ngenerated_types: not-applicable\n```\n\n\n\n## Correction — premise re-scoped (2026-09-11, during delivery)\n\n**The head marker named in \"Outcome\" above is wrong, and the issue's framing overstates heads.** Recorded here rather than in a comment because the queue reads issue bodies only.\n\n1. **`public.erp_items_current.prepack_code` does not mark heads.** It is a frozen DesignFlow snapshot (synced 2026-05-21). Of its 1,454 prepack rows, 1,437 are live *members* and exactly 1 is a live head. Implementing the filter against it would have excluded the wrong population. The live head test is `coldlion.prod_history_component.prepack_item_no`, which is **self-referencing** — a flag on the head row itself, not a head-to-member explosion. Members come from `coldlion.item_detail.pre_pack_code`.\n\n2. **Heads are nearly inert in this population.** In licensed divisions the exclusion removes 1,770 rows: **7 heads and 1,763 members.** 954 of 961 apparent heads sit in EH001/EP001, which the existing non-licensed-division rule already removes. An issue framed entirely around assortment heads therefore describes ~0.4% of what the rule actually does. Both roles are excluded behind one function (`plm.prepack_role`) so the source swap in \"Depends on\" stays a one-line change.\n\n3. The re-derivation reproduced the settled document's 2,016 licensed-division figure exactly; 246 rows remain after the prepack exclusion.\n\nQueries backing each figure are recorded in `docs/verification/prepack-exclusion-20260911.md` (per §4.3, the query is recorded, not the measured count). `docs/business-rules/product-items-and-identifiers.md` has been corrected where it repeated the head/member mix-up.\n\n\n\nMetadata recovery note: Complete missing admission fields while preserving the exact existing live_assertion, return address and original structural outcome. Existing probe repair PR #3293 does not change the original outcome route or claim success.\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0bf01-b3d7-7d62-b7ed-5c7bad7af40a on 916-ALIEN\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0bf00-fa7b-73d1-b447-fc4c89c50b96 on 916-ALIEN\n","closedAt":"2026-09-20T21:12:10Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T20:56:25Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2YAgzg","name":"orchestrator","description":"Changes shared-database structure (or curated Master Data load): orchestrator work","color":"B60205"}],"number":2611,"title":"Prepack exclusion from missing-Licensor/Property populations is prose only, never implemented","updatedAt":"2026-09-20T21:12:10Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2611"},
{"body":"## Why now\n\nRaised while answering the #2466 item-master repoint question. Owner ruling 2026-09-08: **ColdLion is authoritative over DesignFlow.** That settles the repoint direction, but it exposes a gap that must close first.\n\n## What we proved\n\n`public.erp_items_current.prepack_code` is populated on **1,454 of 17,703 items (8.2%)**. It did NOT come from ColdLion directly. It came from the PopDAM `erp-sync` edge function calling the **DesignFlow** item-master API:\n\n- `popdam3/supabase/functions/erp-sync/index.ts:7` — `const DEFAULT_ERP_ENDPOINT = \"https://api.designflow.app/api/item_master/lib/getApiAllItems\";`\n- `popdam3/supabase/functions/erp-sync/index.ts:228-229` — `prepack_code: item.prepackCode || null,`\n- `select max(synced_at), min(source_system) from public.erp_items_current` -> `2026-05-21 10:19:12-04`, `designflow`\n\nDesignFlow gets it from ColdLion itself, via its own nightly `syncPrepackAssociations` job (`docs/coldlion-erp-api-reference.md:240`), then re-serves it on the item header. So the data is genuinely ColdLion's; we have simply never fetched it ourselves. That is exactly why ColdLion `/items` looks like it has no prepack.\n\nThe snapshot is frozen at 2026-05-21. `plm.\"itemDetail\"` is not a live alternative either: `prepack_code_fk` is 100% non-null but empty-string on 19,778 of 21,841 rows (only 2,063 real, 1,639 distinct codes), `max(mod_timedate) = 2023-12-12`, `coldlion_synced_at` null on every row. Only 1,100 of those 1,639 codes overlap the 1,452 in `erp_items_current` — **the two frozen sources already disagree**, so neither is the authority.\n\n## Outcome\n\nFetch prepack from ColdLion ourselves so the repoint does not drop it.\n\n1. Loader for `/itemDetails` -> `coldlion.item_detail` (currently **0 rows**; landing structure already exists, `supabase/migrations/20260905014719_coldlion_item_landing_structures.sql`). Field `prePackCode`, marked `ingest` at 11.5% sample fill in `docs/coldlion-field-decisions-20260819.csv:144`.\n2. Loader for `/prepackDetail`, fanned out over the prepack codes we already hold (1,452 distinct in `erp_items_current`, 1,639 in `plm.\"itemDetail\"`). Per `docs/coldlion-erp-to-supabase-field-mapping.md:65-66`, `prepack_codes` derives from this route.\n3. Record a real row-count probe for both routes. **The 11.5% figure is a sample fill rate, not an enumeration** — we have never counted the rows. Log it per `record-the-probe-or-it-is-fabricated`.\n4. Reconcile the live result against the 1,454 frozen heads and report the delta before anything switches over.\n\nNote `#2179` lists `/prepackDetail` and `/proddetails` as \"not enumerable\"; that was later refuted — the keys are present in `prodHistory` and `inventory` rows. Do not inherit that blocker without re-testing it.\n\n## Blocks\n\n`#2466` (item-master repoint). Until this lands, repointing `api.plm_item_list` off the frozen snapshot takes prepack from 1,454 items to 0.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: source-data\nroute: source-data-session\nreturn_to: u2giants/popdam3\npriority: 30\nblocks: 2466\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-08T22:12:13Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T20:56:11Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2610,"title":"Load prepack from ColdLion directly (/itemDetails + /prepackDetail) before the item-master repoint","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:08Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2610"},

{"body":"PR #2585 was a single handoff document. The documents-only lane (#2102) should have exempted it from the external reviewer pool entirely.\n\nIt did not, because the two gates interact:\n\n1. `Agent work contract` runs in enforced mode and refuses any non-grandfathered pull request that does not change BOTH `.agent/contract.json` and `.agent/completion.json`. A prose-only pull request fails it.\n2. Adding those two JSON files to satisfy gate 1 makes `classifyChangedPaths` return `documentsOnly: false`, because `.json` is not a document extension. The pull request then draws from the reviewer pool after all.\n\nSo a prose-only change can satisfy either gate but never both, and every handoff pays a full two-reviewer round. On 2026-09-08 that cost roughly one hour of wall clock for #2585: one reviewer out of quota (twice), one whose doctor times out and whose run hangs for over ten minutes, and one that returned a confident REJECT because its packet resolved the base from a local `main` 68 commits behind `origin/main`.\n\nFix: teach the `Agent work contract` workflow the same `classifyChangedPaths` rule the reviewer draw already uses. When the pull request's changed-file list is documents-only, pass without requiring the evidence pair. Rulebook files -- AGENTS.md, skills, plan_*.md -- stay non-exempt, exactly as they are for the reviewer draw. Every other automated check and the guarded merge lane are unchanged.\n\nOwner approved the exemption on 2026-09-08.","closedAt":"2026-09-08T18:57:37Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T18:24:42Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2591,"title":"Agent work contract gate cancels the documents-only exemption for prose pull requests","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:45:49Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2591"},

{"body":"## What is missing\n\nThe ColdLion history landing tables shipped on 2026-09-05 and every one of them\nis still empty. Plan Step 7 defines the load; nothing implements it. About\n207,000 rows were captured to private disk on EDGE-DEV on 2026-09-07, but\nnothing has ever been written into `coldlion.order_history_*` or\n`coldlion.prod_history_*`.\n\n## Scope\n\nSales-order history and production-order history only. The masters half of\nStep 7 (`sync-masters.mjs`) is explicitly NOT in this item and remains open.\n\n## What the loader must honour\n\n- The fixed 7-day grid anchored 2019-01-01, enforced by a database CHECK.\n- The silent page-size cap: a request for 2000 returns 200 with no error, so\n  the requested and returned sizes are stored separately and completion is\n  proven page by page against the vendor's own totals.\n- The malformed error contract: a refused history request is HTTP 400 on the\n  wire while the body claims 500. The wire status decides; both are stored.\n  Treating it as a 500 means retrying a permanent input error forever.\n- Stage scoping: `/prodHistory` is fetched once per stage (ISS, INTRAN, REC)\n  because a stage-less request silently returns only ISS, and a returned stage\n  that disagrees with the requested one aborts the window.\n- Versioning by source hash: a changed row is a new version, never an edit.\n- Parent totals repeat verbatim on exploded rows and are never summed.\n- The EP001 division is excluded, and the exclusion is counted rather than\n  silent.\n\n## Done when\n\nBoth a resumable backfill and a scheduled ongoing sync exist, each loading a\nwindow atomically or not at all, resuming from ledger evidence rather than from\na kept note, and covered by offline contract tests in the tools suite.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: source-data\nroute: source-data-session\nreturn_to: u2giants/shared-db\npriority: 60\ndepends_on:\n```\n\n","closedAt":"2026-09-09T02:17:00Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T17:42:53Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2588,"title":"ColdLion Step 7: load sales-order and production-order history into the landing tables","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:28Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2588"},

{"body":"## Business requirement\n\nWhen New York staff ship stock samples to a customer, DesignFlow must automatically send the selected Sales and Design users a durable sample list and carrier tracking notice. The sample keeps its original Flow 1-4 identity; this is a cross-flow NYO inventory dispatch action, not a new origin flow.\n\n## Structural dependency\n\nAdd an idempotent shipment-notice outbox owned by Sample Tracking:\n\n- `dflow.sample_shipment_notice`: one notice per canonical `dflow.sample_shipment`, with immutable subject/body snapshots, immutable `provider_idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()`, lifecycle state (`pending`, `sending`, `sent`, `failed`), attempt timestamps/count, provider message id, safe last-error text, creator identity, and created/updated/sent timestamps.\n- `dflow.sample_shipment_notice_recipient`: named recipients for that notice, each linked to `dflow.users`, classified as `sales`, `design`, or `both`, with name/email snapshots and uniqueness preventing duplicate delivery to the same user.\n- Foreign keys must preserve shipment and user integrity; no cascade may erase shipment history.\n- The claim/send/retry transition must be concurrency-safe so duplicate API requests cannot send a second email. Prefer a narrow database function if row-lock/state rules cannot be enforced safely with ordinary transactional writes.\n- `dflow.claim_sample_shipment_notice` must return the notice's immutable `provider_idempotency_key` with its immutable content and recipient snapshots. The application passes that UUID unchanged as Brevo transactional `headers.idempotencyKey` on every attempt.\n- Service access must follow the existing DesignFlow server role; browser roles receive no direct table access.\n\nThe application will create the outbox records atomically with the canonical NYO-to-customer shipment, attempt delivery after commit through the existing Brevo configuration, record the provider result, and expose a bounded retry when delivery remains pending/failed. The email snapshot includes carrier, tracking link, customer, quantity, SKU where present, and the sample photo when SKU is absent. The server resolves the application `customer_id` against `dflow.customers.customers_id`; the immutable email stores the `customers_name` snapshot so later customer changes cannot rewrite the notice.\n\nRetries are capped at five attempts separated by at least five minutes. That bounded schedule remains within the provider's current 30-minute idempotency TTL; reusing the immutable provider key prevents a duplicate delivery when Brevo accepted the email but the subsequent database success update failed.\n\n## Acceptance\n\n- Replaying the same shipment idempotency key creates neither a second notice nor a second recipient row.\n- Concurrent send claims produce at most one provider send.\n- A failed provider call remains retryable without changing shipment custody.\n- Sent notice and recipients remain auditable even if later item/user data changes.\n- Contract tests prove constraints, grants, idempotency, concurrency, retry, and history preservation on preview before promotion.\n- Contract tests prove `provider_idempotency_key` is generated once, cannot be changed, is returned unchanged by every eligible claim, and that no sixth or sub-five-minute retry can be claimed.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 40\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - table dflow.sample_shipment_notice\n  - table dflow.sample_shipment_notice_recipient\n  - function dflow.claim_sample_shipment_notice\nreads:\n  - table dflow.sample_shipment\n  - table dflow.users\n  - table dflow.customers\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-09T20:08:38Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T15:11:00Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2580,"title":"HANDOVER: Durable Sample Tracking shipment email outbox","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:17:34Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2580"},
{"body":"## Structural outcome (A)\n\nExpose every latest-complete, source-backed Property vocabulary currently missing from DB Data Admin while keeping each Licensor's Creative and Submissions identities separate.\n\nCurrent production was rechecked read-only against `https://qsllyeztdwjgirsysgai.supabase.co` on 2026-09-08. The latest complete captures contain a Coca-Cola asset-library Property-option vocabulary (83 distinct source keys) and a WWE submissions Property vocabulary (1 distinct source identity). The current `api.db_data_admin_scraped_properties(text,text,integer)` definition references neither. It exposes Paramount Creative Library but has no TrackerPlus Submissions arm. No TrackerPlus landing tables exist.\n\nThe private Paramount evidence proves that TrackerPlus's authenticated submission picker is the canonical Submissions vocabulary and exposes exact labels without stable portal record IDs. Creative Library stays a separate Creative vocabulary. No licensed label, row, URL, contract, or raw evidence belongs in this public issue or repository.\n\n## All-licensor coverage inventory (mandatory acceptance scope)\n\nThe implementation must account for every licensor/source family currently loaded in production Supabase, not only the three missing sections. Reconcile the final API against this full inventory and fail acceptance if any eligible source is absent or silently combined with another business purpose.\n\n| Licensor / source family | Production source shape | Current Data Admin disposition | Required #2579 disposition |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Disney Submissions (OPA) | `plm.opa_property` plus studio/scope authority | Exposed | Preserve as Submissions, with studio/licensor authority intact |\n| Disney Creative (DCP Vault) | `plm.dcp_property` | Exposed | Preserve |\n| Marvel Creative (DCP Vault) | `plm.marvel_dcp_property` | Exposed | Preserve authority/conflict handling |\n| Marvel Creative (ASGARD) | `plm.marvel_asgard_style_guide`-derived Property context | Exposed | Preserve separately from OPA/DCP |\n| Lucasfilm / Star Wars Creative (DCP Vault) | `plm.lucasfilm_dcp_property` | Exposed | Preserve source provenance and Star Wars presentation |\n| 20th Century Creative (DCP Vault) | `plm.twentieth_century_dcp_property` | Exposed | Preserve |\n| Pixar Creative (DCP Vault authority arm) | DCP authority resolution | Exposed when supported by row authority | Preserve |\n| Paramount Creative (Creative Library) | `plm.pmt_property` | Exposed | Preserve separately |\n| Paramount Submissions (TrackerPlus) | Private capture exists; no production landing shape | Missing | Add dedicated capture/property shape, load successor, and expose separately |\n| Warner Bros. Creative (STARLABS) | `plm.wb_property` | Exposed | Preserve namespaces and normalized identity |\n| NBCUniversal Creative (Creative Asset Factory) | `plm.nbcu_property` | Exposed | Preserve |\n| Strawberry Shortcake / WildBrain Creative | `plm.wildbrain_era` | Exposed | Preserve |\n| Sega Creative (DSI) | `plm.sega_property` | Exposed | Preserve |\n| Sega Submissions (Product Approval) | `plm.sega_submission_property` | Exposed | Preserve separately |\n| Coca-Cola Creative Property Choices | `plm.coke_asset_property_option`, latest complete `plm.coke_capture` | Missing | Expose with the source-supported purpose; never relabel as Submissions |\n| WWE Submissions | `plm.wwe_property`, latest complete `plm.wwe_submission_capture` | Missing | Expose as Submissions; do not derive a Creative vocabulary from inferred links |\n| Peanuts Creative | Asset, character, style-guide, program and relationship tables; no source Property vocabulary | Not eligible for Scraped Properties | Record explicit `not_applicable_no_source_property_vocabulary`; do not invent a section |\n| Sesame Workshop Creative | Asset, brand, character, style-guide, category and relationship tables; no source Property vocabulary | Not eligible for Scraped Properties | Record explicit `not_applicable_no_source_property_vocabulary`; do not invent a section |\n| ColdLion | Operational/canonical application data, not a licensor portal Property scrape | Not eligible for Scraped Properties | Keep outside this source-vocabulary screen |\n| Other application/shared tables | Not licensor portal Property vocabularies | Not eligible | Exclude by documented classification, never by unnoticed omission |\n\nAcceptance must produce `config/db-data-admin-property-source-coverage.json` as the machine-readable authority and `scripts/check-db-data-admin-property-source-coverage.mjs` plus focused tests as its fail-closed validator. Each manifest entry must use exact source-system/table or catalog-prefix selectors, one business purpose, and exactly one disposition: `exposed`, `not_applicable_no_source_property_vocabulary`, or `blocked_missing_landing_shape`. The validator must compare the manifest to both `api.source_capture_inventory` and the live catalog's source-family prefixes, refuse duplicate/unclassified families and unknown dispositions, and prove that every `exposed` arm is present in the current RPC definition. No licensed value may enter the manifest or validator output.\n\nThe inventory repair must explicitly classify the post-inventory `plm.marvel_asgard_*` and `plm.wwe_*` families and the new `plm.pmt_trackerplus_submission_*` family. None may remain under `source_system = 'other'`. Other `plm.*` application/shared families must receive an explicit manifest disposition instead of being silently ignored.\n## Exact structural contract\n\n1. Add `plm.pmt_trackerplus_submission_capture` as an append-only capture root with private source commit/hash, capture time, expected/observed counts, terminal status, and fail-closed completeness evidence.\n2. Add `plm.pmt_trackerplus_submission_property` under that root. Its durable source-local key is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 label, explicitly marked `exact-label-sha256`; it is not a Paramount source ID. Store the exact source label privately at runtime and never merge it into `plm.pmt_property`.\n3. Add guarded begin/chunk/finalize functions named below. Repeated identical chunks are idempotent; changed chunks, duplicate local keys, count/hash mismatch, incomplete capture, and fabricated source IDs are refused.\n4. Extend both source-inventory contracts named below so the TrackerPlus capture is classified and latest-complete truth is available without exposing licensed values.\n5. Extend the DB Data Admin RPC with these source-purpose groups only:\n   - Paramount Submissions from the new latest-complete TrackerPlus capture;\n   - Coca-Cola Creative from the latest complete `plm.coke_capture` plus `plm.coke_asset_property_option`;\n   - WWE Submissions from the latest complete `plm.wwe_submission_capture` plus `plm.wwe_property`.\n6. Preserve Paramount Creative as a separate group. Do not manufacture a Coca-Cola Submissions Property vocabulary or a WWE Creative Property vocabulary from secondary, free-text, inferred, folder, tag, guide, or asset evidence.\n7. Preserve the existing licensing-manager gate, privacy-safe response, stable source identity/provenance, mapping/contract status, cursor pagination, and unresolved Creative highlighting.\n\nImplementation may not add another database object without amending this exact scope before claim acquisition.\n\n## Structural acceptance\n\n- From-empty and upgrade tests cover capture success/refusal/idempotency, latest-complete selection, deterministic local identity, and no invented source ID.\n- The API returns four distinct business-purpose arms where applicable: existing Paramount Creative, new Paramount Submissions, Coca-Cola Creative, and WWE Submissions.\n- Latest-complete aggregation does not combine separate captures or count retained duplicates as current vocabulary.\n- No licensed fixture/value and no application row load ships in the migration.\n- Preview, independent exact-head review, guarded merge, and catalog proof pass.\n- Applying the exact merged structure to production requires separate explicit owner authorization; intake and preview do not authorize that production mutation.\n\n## Successors (B and C, not orchestrator work)\n\n- Private source-data load after production structure is authorized/applied: https://github.com/u2giants/licensor-source-data/issues/68\n- Authenticated `data.designflow.app` verification after the private load: https://github.com/u2giants/licensor-source-data/issues/69\n\nThose successors own rows and end-to-end verification respectively. They do not authorize or claim shared database structure, and neither may report completion back here until its dependencies are proven.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 124\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - table plm.pmt_trackerplus_submission_capture\n  - table plm.pmt_trackerplus_submission_property\n  - function plm.begin_pmt_trackerplus_submission_capture\n  - function plm.load_pmt_trackerplus_submission_capture_chunk\n  - function plm.finalize_pmt_trackerplus_submission_capture\n  - function api.source_capture_inventory_exact\n  - view api.source_capture_inventory\n  - function api.db_data_admin_scraped_properties\nreads:\n  - function app.require_licensing_manager_access\n  - table plm.opa_property\n  - table plm.opa_property_scope_membership\n  - table plm.opa_property_studio_resolution\n  - table plm.dcp_property\n  - table plm.marvel_dcp_property\n  - table plm.marvel_asgard_style_guide\n  - table plm.lucasfilm_dcp_property\n  - table plm.twentieth_century_dcp_property\n  - table plm.dcp_opa_property_resolution\n  - table plm.dcp_opa_property_resolution_member\n  - table plm.pmt_capture\n  - table plm.pmt_property\n  - table plm.wb_property\n  - table plm.nbcu_capture\n  - table plm.nbcu_property\n  - table plm.wildbrain_capture\n  - table plm.wildbrain_era\n  - table plm.sega_capture\n  - table plm.sega_property\n  - table plm.sega_submission_capture\n  - table plm.sega_submission_property\n  - table plm.coke_capture\n  - table plm.coke_asset_property_option\n  - table plm.wwe_submission_capture\n  - table plm.wwe_property\n```","closedAt":"2026-09-14T10:51:18Z","createdAt":"2026-09-08T14:29:53Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"The historical preview selector conflates the commit containing the dispatched workflow with the commit that the workflow actually checked out and rehearsed. These identities must be verified separately. This issue is repository maintenance, not structural orchestrator implementation authority.\n\n## Correction and scope\n\nThe original intake incorrectly treated the production gate's rejection of a rebased claim-preview commit as a defect and omitted the documented replacement route. That ancestry refusal is intentional. This issue does NOT request accepting a discarded PR commit solely because its SQL matches, relaxing current source-PR/main provenance, or inventing immutable association after the fact.\n\nThe narrow defect to reproduce and repair is `validateOriginalPreviewApplyEvidence` in `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs`: it requires `binding.appliedCommit === run.head_sha` and an artifact name derived from `run.head_sha`. GitHub's `run.head_sha` identifies the workflow dispatch source; the artifact and instance binding identify the applied checkout. A supported merged-main rehearsal may dispatch its workflow from current main while checking out an earlier merged commit. Both commits can legitimately be on main, with trusted producer equivalence and all required source-merge bindings intact, yet these equality checks reject the evidence.\n\n## Required supported-case reproduction\n\nConstruct a regression using the existing supported merged-main rehearsal contract: source PR merged at A; workflow dispatched from later main B; actual applied checkout A; B contains A; trusted producer files equivalent; binding rehearsalMode `merged-main-rehearsal`, exact source PR/source merge SHA/preview target/allowlist; artifact named for A, workflow_run.head_sha B; valid immutable artifact/download digest and exact ledger delta. Verify the actual workflow and producer contracts permit this tuple before treating it as positive evidence. Repair only the identity conflation if this supported tuple is established. Keep both workflow-source and checkout producer checks, merged-source lineage, and every other refusal.\n\n`production_business_risk_gate.py` already distinguishes these identities: its direct evidence path reads the applied checkout from the artifact and independently verifies the workflow dispatch producer. Its `source_pr_commits` and main-ancestry requirements remain intentional and must not be weakened.\n\n## Observed case, not a qualifying positive fixture\n\n#2509 / PR #2513 exposed the mismatch, but its original run was a pre-merge claim rehearsal whose checkout was later rebased away. Fixing the equality bug alone does NOT make this case promotable or eligible for historical rebinding.\n\n- Original successful attempt 1: https://github.com/u2giants/shared-db/actions/runs/34157812748 ; workflow dispatch head `4f093e3d4c97e4272d147d38e7243ec57d3c08f1`.\n- Applied checkout `bcc2603977678db73b4ca12d3ed1312a1bff64e2`; binding schema `shared-db-preview-instance-binding/v1`, rehearsalMode `claim`, target `mvpkijzfmfcxhnzqogzs`, only allowlisted/added version `20260907131728`, no removals.\n- Artifact 10031592106, `preview-migration-apply-bcc2603977678db73b4ca12d3ed1312a1bff64e2`, digest `sha256:3fcd874602c5c52293448a83fdb27c126a8f0cf78e63e24af0d2a10a03128a6b`. Artifact workflow_run.head_sha is the dispatch head.\n- Original evidence: https://github.com/u2giants/shared-db/issues/2509#issuecomment-5575252231 . Live acceptance: https://github.com/u2giants/shared-db/pull/2513#issuecomment-5575198255 . Neither substitutes for qualifying provenance.\n- Reviewed head `5fec1cee6a2828b127f97031432a2b540a9ad4af`, base `b48f526f87369278e0b173ded6a2d97e729818d6`. Current PR commits at audit: `bc00c471d9e30b4b8ad5f740313e8824261424b6`, `24e38f134407a4a058480ef5041805ddc7bb77c4`, `ff168eb3f65e4e708acf421e693213c717a92c03`, `5fec1cee6a2828b127f97031432a2b540a9ad4af`. Original bcc absent; compare bcc to b48 returned `diverged`.\n- Migration blob `da47d8b3c4dbe61617bbbaf507d8027c5c5724aa` and test bytes preserved. Equal bytes alone do not establish provenance.\n- Fresh preview ledger at 2026-09-07T20:57:27.358Z: 626 versions, affected version present.\n- Protected prepare refused `already-applied versions require exactly one validated immutable preview apply or ledger-reconciliation run; found 0`. A merged source also requires original merged-main rehearsal bindings, which this claim run lacks.\n\n## Existing conditional recovery for #2509\n\n`docs/production-promotion-procedure.md` lines 73-78 and 139-166 document the stranded-version exception: explicit owner ruling, fresh version carrying equivalent executable SQL, production hard-block of the original, then rehearsal from merged main. This route exists; it is not authorized by this issue or by the coordinator's intake action.\n\nAfter the source PR is merged and authority is obtained, the sanctioned merged-stranded-claim reissue can preserve original version reservation and object locks while reserving a fresh version in a fresh owned branch/worktree. It does not itself implement the production hard-block. Preserve the original applied file and ledger, check that later migrations have not superseded the function body, prove executable equivalence, and use all normal review/merge/rehearsal gates. Do not reset or duplicate-apply the old version.\n\n## Acceptance and negative regressions\n\nProve the supported A/B merged-main case before implementing. Preserve exact source claim/version/run bindings where required, source merge ancestry, trusted workflow and checkout producer identity, artifact identity/download digest, SQL/content manifest, exact target/allowlist/ledger delta, and fresh ledger checks. Reject unrelated PR/run, discarded rebased claim provenance, changed SQL, forged checkout or producer, wrong source merge/target/version, changed digest, missing/expired/ambiguous evidence, and unexpected ledger changes. Existing valid same-commit merged-main and governed reconciliation paths must remain valid.\n\nNo structural files, applied migration bytes, claims, verdict refs, or ledger rows may be altered to make this validation pass. No hardcoded #2509 exception, waiver, synthetic provenance, or implementation dispatch from the orchestrator.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 90\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\nreads:\n```\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-25T06:30:17Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T21:21:18Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## Outcome\n\nCreate the missing Disney OPA complete-snapshot contract so #2357 can expose truthful licensing entity and relationship candidates without mixing partial refreshes.\n\nCurrent production evidence, read-only against project `qsllyeztdwjgirsysgai` on 2026-09-07:\n\n- `plm.opa_property` has 1,518 current entities;\n- `plm.opa_property_scope_membership` has two approved branch captures covering 1,518 distinct Properties;\n- `plm.opa_property_character` has 10,262 relationships from one 2026-08-06 scope/date;\n- `api.source_capture_inventory` has no OPA complete-capture row;\n- no OPA capture-root table exists.\n\nThose aggregates prove presence but not one complete, coherent snapshot. The saved private extract is explicitly Home-only and its Lucas relationship coverage is incomplete. Do not reinterpret it as complete.\n\n## Required structure\n\nAdd one logical OPA capture root, its predeclared authorized route/scope coverage, and append-only Property/Character relationship observations tied to that root. Provide guarded begin/load/finalize functions that:\n\n- require every predeclared Disney and Lucas route scope to authenticate and finish;\n- record exact source commit, manifest hash, per-scope counts, duplicate-key counts, failures, and terminal status;\n- refuse zero/short/partial scopes, repeated or missing scope coverage, pair collisions, and finalization when any row is unaccounted for;\n- mark a root `complete` only after aggregate and per-scope hashes/counts reconcile;\n- never delete a source entity or relationship because it is absent;\n- leave failed/partial captures non-authoritative and never mix their timestamps with an older snapshot;\n- expose only sanitized latest-complete aggregate evidence through `api.source_capture_inventory`.\n\nThe private Disney session will perform the fresh capture and ordinary landing rows after this structure is live. This issue authorizes no portal action, licensed rows, curated `core.*` write, preview data load, or production data load.\n\n## Acceptance\n\n- From-empty SQL tests cover two-scope success, one-scope failure, authentication failure, zero/shrink refusal, duplicate pair refusal, hash/count mismatch, idempotent identical chunks, changed-chunk refusal, and incomplete-finalize refusal.\n- Latest-complete selection never combines observations from different capture roots or partial runs.\n- Browser-safe consumers can name one exact completed capture for Property and Property/Character candidates without licensed row leakage.\n- Preview, independent exact-head review, guarded merge, production apply, live catalog proof, then a separately authorized private capture/load.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 123\ndepends_on: 1883\nwrites:\n  - table plm.opa_capture\n  - table plm.opa_capture_scope\n  - table plm.opa_property_character_capture\n  - function plm.begin_opa_capture\n  - function plm.load_opa_capture_chunk\n  - function plm.finalize_opa_capture\n  - function api.source_capture_inventory_exact\n  - view api.source_capture_inventory\nreads:\n  - table plm.opa_property\n  - table plm.opa_character\n  - table plm.opa_property_character\n  - table plm.opa_property_scope_membership\n```\n\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-10T19:54:50Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T19:25:02Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. A separately started repository-maintenance session owns this repair, not the structural orchestrator.\n\n## Proven evidence\nArtifact supabase-contract-test-logs (id 10026391432):\n- migration-logs/20260901142825_popdam_effective_count_performance.sql.log and migration-logs/20260907154630_popdam_tag_totals_cold_plan.sql.log: pass 1 fails because type public.assets does not exist.\n- migration-logs-pass2/20260901142825_popdam_effective_count_performance.sql.log: replacement functions and guard succeed.\n- Its __ORDER_REPAIR.log then restores four functions and settings.\n- Later pass-2 migrations 20260902042548_popdam_unfiltered_facet_count_index_only_path.sql and 20260904121037_popdam_tag_facet_count_index_leading_arm.sql fail and roll back: \"filter count entry points no longer share the implementation\".\n- The final #2501 migration restores public wrappers but does not replace the obsolete private helper.\n\nSource: scripts/check_pass2_routine_supersession.py, later_collisions (line 84) and snapshot_query (line 123), derive newer truth from filenames and the current catalog. .github/workflows/database-contract-tests.yml (lines 376-430) restores that snapshot after a successful pass-2 apply without proof that the later defining migration succeeded. Baseline/older definitions can overwrite a successful forward repair.\n\n## Reproduce\nDownload the retained exact artifact into a new scratch directory:\ngh run download 34142055022 --repo u2giants/shared-db --name supabase-contract-test-logs --dir <new-scratch-directory>\n\nRead the named logs and contract failures. Equivalent copies were inspected on vps2 at /tmp/issue2501-rebase-ci.bWTZd2; the GitHub artifact remains the reference.\n\nPreserve these unchanged failing assertions:\n- popdam_authorized_ranked_search_contracts.sql:251: effective counts must use one narrow five-column direct asset scan.\n- popdam_effective_count_performance_contracts.sql:128: effective count helper is not a narrow index-leading scan.\n\nNew #2501 list-arm/custom-plan assertions passed before these failures. Do not weaken or quarantine assertions.\n\n## Required repair and acceptance\nBind restoration to successful migration/routine provenance in this actual replay, including pass-1 and pass-2 success. A later filename or existing catalog routine alone proves nothing. Preserve genuinely newer routine bodies, security settings and execute grants.\n\nFocused regression cases:\n1. Later migration fails; baseline/older routine exists; earlier pass-2 repair succeeds: obsolete routine must not be restored.\n2. Later migration succeeds: older replay must preserve genuinely newer definition/settings.\n3. Mixed overlapping routine outcomes must be classified individually; missing/ambiguous provenance refuses rather than claiming newer truth.\n4. Existing schema-wide grant restoration still preserves grants without resurrecting unproven definitions.\n\nRun focused tests then repaired ephemeral replay against #2527's migration set. Both unchanged failing contracts must pass, alongside existing ordering/grant-restoration coverage. No new quarantine, applied migration edits, lost capabilities, timeout increases or weakened RLS. An unchanged failed-head rerun is not acceptance.\n\nAfter maintenance lands, structural owner rebases #2527 through normal guarded recovery and reruns relevant CI. Representative-volume authenticated cold/warm preview and production acceptance remain separate gates. Preserve claim #2525 and PR #2527.\n\nDuplicate check: open title inventory plus current replay/supersession/provenance searches; #2366 concerns production historical-supersession mutation coverage, not this ephemeral replay defect.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 80\ndepends_on:\n```\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-07T18:57:04Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T17:52:34Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 5\ndepends_on:\nowner_repo: popcre/designflow-backend\nwrites:\n  - table public.hts_rag_debate_runs\n  - column public.hts_rag_precedents.promotion_basis\n  - column public.hts_rag_precedents.promotion_policy_version\n  - column public.hts_rag_precedents.promotion_source_determination_id\n  - column public.hts_rag_precedents.promotion_debate_run_id\n  - column public.hts_rag_precedents.promotion_gate_result\n  - function public.enforce_hts_rag_precedent_promotion_gate_immutable\n  - trigger hts_rag_precedents_promotion_gate_immutable on public.hts_rag_precedents\n  - trigger set_updated_at on public.hts_rag_debate_runs\n  - index public.hts_rag_debate_runs_claim_idx\n  - index public.hts_rag_debate_runs_source_determination_idx\n  - index public.hts_rag_debate_runs_precedent_idx\n  - policy hts_rag_debate_runs_backend_read on public.hts_rag_debate_runs\n  - policy hts_rag_debate_runs_backend_insert on public.hts_rag_debate_runs\n  - policy hts_rag_debate_runs_backend_update on public.hts_rag_debate_runs\nreads:\n  - table public.hts_rag_determinations\n  - table public.hts_rag_provider_responses\n  - table public.hts_rag_review_events\n  - function app.set_updated_at\n```\n\n### 1. What this is\n\nStep 1 of [`plan_hts-rag-dual-model-debate-promotion.md`](https://github.com/popcre/designflow-backend/blob/sandbox-albert/plan_hts-rag-dual-model-debate-promotion.md) (tracking issue popcre/designflow-backend#79).\n\nDesignFlow is adding automatic, evidence-gated HTS RAG precedent promotion driven by two independent\nproduction reviewers (Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor and GPT-5.6 Luna) that classify the same bounded case\npacket, debate directly, then vote blind. Promotion is deterministic and fail-closed. The audit contract\nfor that workflow is shared structure and therefore originates here, not in the application repository.\n\nBackend application code for Steps 2–6 is being written in parallel against this contract on branch\n`sandbox-albert-hts-debate`; it does not create schema at startup and will not be landed until this\nmigration is merged, promoted and catalog-verified.\n\n### 2. Required additive migration\n\n**New table `public.hts_rag_debate_runs`** — service-only. It joins the existing nine `hts_rag_*` tables\non whichever connection owns them (`models/hts-rag-store.js` selects by `HtsRag*` filename prefix, so a\nnew `HtsRagDebateRun.js` model is picked up automatically). It carries foreign keys to\n`public.hts_rag_determinations` and `public.hts_rag_precedents` and **must live on the same connection as\nthem**; do not place it on the primary connection if the HTS models are split, and do not create a\ncross-database foreign key.\n\nColumns:\n\n| Column | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| `id` | `uuid` PK, default `gen_random_uuid()` | |\n| `source_determination_id` | `uuid` NOT NULL | FK → `public.hts_rag_determinations(id)` |\n| `session_id` | `uuid` NOT NULL | groups the run's turns in `hts_rag_provider_responses` |\n| `policy_version` | `text` NOT NULL | promotion policy version, e.g. `v1` |\n| `case_packet_hash` | `text` NOT NULL | canonical hash of the immutable case packet |\n| `status` | `text` NOT NULL default `'pending'` | see state set below |\n| `claimed_at` | `timestamptz` | |\n| `claimed_by` | `text` | worker identity |\n| `lease_expires_at` | `timestamptz` | |\n| `attempt_count` | `integer` NOT NULL default `0` | |\n| `max_attempts` | `integer` NOT NULL default `3` | |\n| `turn_count` | `integer` NOT NULL default `0` | |\n| `evidence_expansion_count` | `integer` NOT NULL default `0` | |\n| `spark_initial_code` | `text` | normalized 10-digit |\n| `luna_initial_code` | `text` | normalized 10-digit |\n| `spark_final_code` | `text` | normalized 10-digit |\n| `luna_final_code` | `text` | normalized 10-digit |\n| `consensus_code` | `text` | normalized 10-digit; set only on agreement |\n| `stop_reason` | `text` | `converged`/`needs_more_facts`/`deadlocked`/`degraded`/`circuit_breaker` |\n| `evidence_result` | `jsonb` NOT NULL default `'{}'` | verified rulings, statuses, hashes, applicability verdicts |\n| `gate_result` | `jsonb` NOT NULL default `'{}'` | per-condition Promotion Policy v1 outcome |\n| `precedent_id` | `uuid` | FK → `public.hts_rag_precedents(id)` |\n| `error_code` | `text` | |\n| `error_detail` | `text` | no product descriptions, no raw provider payloads |\n| `created_at` | `timestamptz` NOT NULL default `now()` | |\n| `updated_at` | `timestamptz` NOT NULL default `now()` | |\n| `completed_at` | `timestamptz` | |\n\nConstraints:\n\n- `UNIQUE (source_determination_id, policy_version)` — one run per determination per policy version, which\n  is what makes enqueue idempotent.\n- `status` CHECK in\n  `('pending','claimed','initial_opinions','debating','final_votes','gating','promoted','not_proven','failed','dead_letter')`.\n- CHECK: `status = 'promoted'` requires `consensus_code IS NOT NULL`, `precedent_id IS NOT NULL`, and\n  `gate_result ? 'passed'` with `gate_result->>'passed' = 'true'`.\n- CHECK: `status IN ('promoted','not_proven','failed','dead_letter')` requires `completed_at IS NOT NULL`.\n- CHECK: `attempt_count >= 0`, `turn_count >= 0`, `evidence_expansion_count >= 0`.\n- `stop_reason` CHECK constrained to the five values above or NULL.\n- `policy_version` and `case_packet_hash` non-empty.\n\nIndexes:\n\n- partial index on `(status, lease_expires_at)` where `status IN ('pending','claimed')` — the job claim path.\n- index on `(source_determination_id)` — history/status reads.\n- index on `(precedent_id)` where `precedent_id IS NOT NULL` — invalidation path.\n\nGrants/RLS: RLS enabled, **no** `anon` or `authenticated` policy or grant of any kind. Service role gets only\n`SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE` on the columns the worker actually writes. No `DELETE` — the table is an audit record.\n\n**Additive columns on `public.hts_rag_precedents`** (typed promotion provenance):\n\n- `promotion_basis` `text` NOT NULL default `'legacy_unspecified'`, CHECK in\n  `('human_review','dual_model_verified','legacy_unspecified')`.\n- `promotion_policy_version` `text`\n- `promotion_source_determination_id` `uuid` FK → `public.hts_rag_determinations(id)`\n- `promotion_debate_run_id` `uuid` FK → `public.hts_rag_debate_runs(id)`\n- `promotion_gate_result` `jsonb` — immutable once set; enforce with a trigger that refuses any\n  `UPDATE` changing a non-null `promotion_gate_result`.\n- CHECK: `promotion_basis = 'dual_model_verified'` requires `promotion_debate_run_id`,\n  `promotion_policy_version` and `promotion_gate_result` all NOT NULL.\n\n**Existing rows must NOT be rewritten as `human_review`.** They default to `legacy_unspecified` unless the\norchestrator finds durable evidence in `hts_rag_review_events` proving a specific row was human-reviewed; a\nguess here would misrepresent audit history and would also silently grant those rows the human-review\nscoring bonus.\n\n### 3. Verification asked for\n\nDirect catalog proof in the exact promoted target of: table existence and column types, every CHECK and FK,\nthe three indexes, RLS enabled, zero anon/authenticated grants, the immutability trigger on\n`promotion_gate_result`, and FK locality (all FKs resolve within one connection). Plus the count parity note\nbelow.\n\n### 4. Known downstream count change\n\npopcre/designflow-backend#88 (HTS RAG secondary-database pilot) asserts \"nine `hts_rag_*` tables\" and an\nacceptance gate of `hts_rag_store_ready ... models: 9`. This migration makes that **ten**. That issue is being\nupdated from the DesignFlow side; flagging it here so the parity check in that pilot is not failed by a stale\nnumber. This request does not unblock or bypass #88, which remains blocked on its own isolated-schema\ndependency (u2giants/shared-db#2403).\n\n### 5. Return address\n\n`popcre/designflow-backend`\n\n### 6. Exact claimed objects\n\nThe authoritative scope above reserves every named object written by this change. The new table claim covers its primary key, foreign keys, UNIQUE and CHECK constraints; the three explicitly-created indexes, three service-role policies, timestamp trigger, and the precedent promotion-gate immutability function/trigger are separately named because they are independently addressable objects. `public.hts_rag_determinations`, `public.hts_rag_provider_responses`, `public.hts_rag_review_events`, and `app.set_updated_at` are read dependencies only.\n\nExisting precedent rows remain `legacy_unspecified`. No row is inferred to be `human_review`, and this migration performs no human-review backfill.","closedAt":"2026-09-09T06:18:03Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T17:21:34Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":2535,"title":"HANDOVER: hts_rag_debate_runs table + hts_rag_precedents promotion provenance (DesignFlow dual-model debate promotion, Step 1)","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:18:05Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/2535"},
{"body":"## Handover: accidental cross-session orchestrator inheritance\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: documentation\nroute: repo-maintenance\n```\n\n### 1. What I was doing and why\n\nThis Codex task was opened in `/worksp/popdam` to resolve PopDAM GitHub issues. It received cross-session `<codex_delegation>` messages asserting that it owned live shared-db marker #2517 and should take over existing shared-db PRs. I mistakenly treated those delegated messages as authority to operate the shared-db orchestrator even though Albert had not explicitly started an orchestrator in this task. Albert corrected that on 2026-09-07. This task is stopping all shared-db work now.\n\n### 2. What I actually did\n\n- Continued coordination under marker #2517 and route id `01a07bca-4662-7323-9a55-1f6499864bd1`.\n- Completed governed review/merge handling for PR #2514 (issue #1322). PR #2514 merged; main became `85015041f660bdebc5474751e63e12618d275b03` at that point.\n- Dispatched DB Data Admin production run `34144596689`; it succeeded and deployed the exact then-current main application image. This was an application deployment, not a database migration apply.\n- Accepted the already-merged PR #2512 / issue #2506 recovery problem and created PR #2528, branch `codex/issue-2506-preview-rehearsal-reset`, to authorize a narrow same-version rehearsal-ledger reset for migration `20260907131610`.\n- Rebasing after maintenance main moved produced current PR #2528 head `acd7f70410df278363f34eca13368ca2be675bc7`, based on main `6040f00e96a660a4eee3efdb9f99168be58aa9fa`; I force-pushed only that owned recovery branch with lease.\n- Current PR #2528 CI is fully green, including disposable-database contracts.\n- Kimi review assignment sequence 1678 failed with confirmed quota exhaustion and was released with immutable failure evidence.\n- Gemini assignment sequence 1680 produced substantive findings but the installed wrapper misparsed the governed-verdict flag. No Gemini verdict was recorded. Reviewer incident `20260907T170741Z-hetz-gemini-3.8-flash-high-2659837` records the failure; the reviewer lease was released as `wrapper_terminal_failure`.\n- Replacement GLM assignment sequence 1682 completed an exact-head review and recorded APPROVE at create-only ref `refs/db-review-verdict-replacements/2506-2528-acd7f70410df278363f34eca13368ca2be675bc7-1680`, object `d48ffa7466f05b440c99829ceecabbe5e5d090ed`.\n\n### 3. Preview and production database state\n\n- I did not dispatch any shared-db preview migration, preview ledger reconciliation, production migration dry-run, production migration review, or production migration apply.\n- PR #2512's earlier pre-merge preview run `34141000463` is the evidence behind #2528, but I did not create that preview state during the stopping phase.\n- The only production action I dispatched was DB Data Admin application deployment run `34144596689`; it did not apply a database migration.\n\n### 4. Half-finished work\n\n- PR #2528 is open, mergeable, fully green, and exact-head approved, but must NOT be merged by this task. A temporary main hold requested for PR #2518 began at main `6040f00e96a660a4eee3efdb9f99168be58aa9fa` and remains the last instruction received here.\n- After #2528 eventually merges, the authorized orchestrator must perform the exact preview-ledger reconciliation, then a merged-main rehearsal of migration `20260907131610`, then the governed production path and live acceptance before closing issue #2506 / claim #2510.\n- Other inherited PRs/issues remain open and are described in marker #2517 and existing issues; this task will not continue them.\n\n### 5. What I own right now\n\n- Open PR #2528 and branch `codex/issue-2506-preview-rehearsal-reset`.\n- Worktree `/tmp/shared-db-2506-recovery-2x07Rm`, clean at the current PR head.\n- Coordinator clone `/tmp/shared-db-orch-popdam-fPHgeW/repo` may still exist from inherited coordination; it must be audited before reuse or removal.\n- Canonical `/worksp/shared-db` was checked clean at stop time.\n- No dispatched sub-agent is still running for this task.\n\n### 6. Very next action for the authorized orchestrator\n\nRe-check live marker ownership, current main, PR #2518 state, and the temporary merge hold. If the hold has been released and main has moved, rebase #2528 again and obtain a new exact-head review; otherwise, if main remains `6040f00e...`, the current green CI and GLM approval are present. Do not rely on this sentence without live verification.\n\n### 7. Blockers\n\nThe blocker is authority and coordination: this PopDAM task was never explicitly opened by Albert as the shared-db orchestrator. It must not perform more shared-db mutations. PR #2518 also requested a temporary main merge hold.\n\n### 8. What did not work, and why\n\n- Kimi could not review because its five-hour provider quota was exhausted; no verdict/artifact was produced.\n- Gemini completed a useful review, but `scripts/run-governed-review.mjs` injected `--governed-verdict <head>` immediately after `new`, while installed `ai-gemini` 0.2.2 expects `new <name>`. It created a session literally named `--governed-verdict` and emitted no terminal governed verdict, so the gate correctly rejected it.\n- A direct `ai-gemini qualify-live` canary passed but did not write the qualification certificate. The correct `ai-review-preflight qualify gemini` command wrote it. This did not fix the separate argument-contract incompatibility.\n- A first GLM invocation included unsupported `--review-kind diff` and exited before creating a session. Retrying without that unsupported option succeeded.\n\n### 9. Facts that may already be stale\n\nAll GitHub state can change immediately. At the last check on 2026-09-07 around 17:12 UTC: main was `6040f00e96a660a4eee3efdb9f99168be58aa9fa`; PR #2528 was open at `acd7f70410df278363f34eca13368ca2be675bc7`; PR #2518 was open at `e18799156842f4ca7d25bb4693f396aeb5e1243e` (newer than the earlier delegated head); and #2528 CI was fully green. Re-derive every value before acting.\n\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-07T17:33:56Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T17:14:55Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"PopDAM issue: https://github.com/u2giants/popdam3/issues/107\nPlan: `u2giants/popdam3/plan_popsg_production_readiness.md` sections 9.8 and 9.11.\n\n## Outcome\n\nRepair the production timeout in `public.get_sg_preview_stats()`. Signed-in PopSG Settings QA on 2026-09-07 observed repeated HTTP 500 responses; Virginia Postgres logs recorded `canceling statement due to statement timeout`. The function scans active preview/error state in `style_guide_files` plus current queue state in `style_guide_render_queue`. Do not raise timeouts.\n\nNo licensed paths, filenames, or row exports are included.\n\n## Required contract\n\n- Preserve the current JSON response fields and authenticated caller compatibility.\n- Make the aggregate reliably complete under the normal production statement timeout at current and representative larger volume.\n- Add stable preview categories needed by #107 if they can be returned without breaking existing callers: has preview, waiting/queued, recoverable error, reviewed terminal exception, and unexplained.\n- Use the fewest justified indexes or an incrementally maintained aggregate; no full-corpus rebuild inside an Edge request.\n- Prove representative-volume execution plans/runtime, exact count parity against fixtures, authorization, and no write side effects in preview.\n- Do not change the statement timeout.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - function public.get_sg_preview_stats\n  - index public.idx_sgf_active_preview_category\nreads:\n  - table public.style_guide_files\n  - table public.style_guide_render_queue\n```\n\nThe migration author may add narrowly justified indexes or an aggregate object after preview-plan evidence, but must update this block atomically through the lane manager and claim every exact final object before authoring.\n\r\n\r\n","closedAt":"2026-09-08T12:46:18Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T13:11:57Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"PopDAM issue: https://github.com/u2giants/popdam3/issues/107\nPredecessor: #2212 (closed and in Virginia production)\nPlan: `u2giants/popdam3/plan_popsg_production_readiness.md` section 9.9.\n\n## Outcome\n\nComplete the terminal-outcome portion of the dedicated PopSG PDF extraction contract. Production #2212 created a `skipped` status but its completion RPC can only write `extracted` or `failed`, and the table does not persist extraction method or a distinct reviewed terminal reason. The application cannot truthfully classify oversized/unsupported/no-text files without either marking null text as extracted or retrying a known terminal exception as a failure.\n\nNo licensed paths, filenames, or row exports are included.\n\n## Required contract\n\n- Add extraction method and a durable terminal reason to `style_guide_pdf_text`.\n- Add a non-ambiguous v2 completion RPC accepting exactly `extracted`, `failed`, or `skipped`, with method, page count, text, and bounded error/reason.\n- Require non-empty text for `extracted`; require a reason for `failed` and `skipped`.\n- Preserve content-identity and active-file refusal semantics.\n- Keep the existing completion RPC for staggered compatibility.\n- Update the one-file search-document refresh exactly as the existing completion path does.\n- Prove idempotency/refusal, terminal non-reclaim, transient retry, content-change invalidation, least privilege, and no bulk backfill in preview.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nwrites:\n  - table public.style_guide_pdf_text\n  - function public.complete_style_guide_pdf_text_v2\n  - table public.style_guide_search_documents\nreads:\n  - table public.style_guide_files\n  - function public.claim_style_guide_pdf_text\n```\n\nThe migration author may refine the new v2 signature before claim acquisition, but must update this block atomically through the lane manager and claim every exact final object before authoring. Preserve all existing rows; no extraction workload or corpus rebuild belongs in the migration.\n\n","closedAt":"2026-09-11T05:01:10Z","createdAt":"2026-09-07T12:56:38Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake.
