{"body":"Found while executing #1198 (promote the Coldlion spine). The predecessor session's rule — **merge first, then rehearse on preview from merged main, then promote** — is correct, and **the tooling cannot execute it.** There is currently NO path that applies a merged-but-unapplied migration to preview.\n\n## Finding A (new, 2026-08-19) — the preview lane cannot be acquired after merge\n\nRun [32203393978](https://github.com/u2giants/shared-db/actions/runs/32203393978), `target=preview mode=apply preview_allowlist=20260818232639 claim_pr=1193 claim_head_sha=203a034…`:\n\n```\ngh: Not Found (HTTP 404)\nREFUSED: exclusive lane requires exactly one live author claim for the pull-request branch\n```\n\n`scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs:990` requires exactly one **live** author claim whose branch equals `pr.head.ref`. After a guarded merge the claim is released and the branch is deleted, so:\n\n- **before merge** the lane can be acquired, but the rehearsal can never satisfy the production gate's provenance requirement;\n- **after merge** the provenance would be right, but the lane refuses.\n\nThe existing `historical_preview_source_pr` path is **not** an escape: the workflow skips the bounded apply for it (`.github/workflows/shared-supabase-migrations.yml:473`) and then *requires* the versions to already be in preview's ledger (line 531). It recovers evidence for what preview already has; it cannot apply anything.\n\nNet effect: every migration merged from now on is stranded exactly the way `20260818203751` is, and #1198 cannot be completed as written.\n\n## Finding B — the production gate provenance defects (#1194, parked)\n\nThe four points from the independent review of #1194 stand and must be satisfied by the same change:\n\n1. Pin provenance **and** the producer files to the commit the rehearsal actually checked out (already in the artifact name), not `run.head_sha`.\n2. Require that commit to be a source-PR commit **or** a strict ancestor whose tree is what actually ran.\n3. Assert the compare **URL argument order** in the tests.\n4. Bind the **preview project ref** into the evidence, so the rebuilt preview (`mvpkijzfmfcxhnzqogzs`) cannot inherit the deleted one's (`rjyboqwcdzcocqgmsyel`) proof.\n\n## Outcome needed\n\nOne coherent change that makes the merge-first order executable end to end:\n\n- a post-merge preview rehearsal path whose lock is authorised by **merge-commit ancestry of the current `main` tip**, not by a live branch claim (strictly stronger provenance than a branch head, and it must fail closed if the PR is not merged or its merge commit is not an ancestor);\n- that path must actually run the bounded apply, not skip it;\n- the evidence it emits must carry the checked-out commit and the preview project ref;\n- the production gate updated to consume exactly that, satisfying all four points above;\n- tests that would fail if the compare arguments were inverted or the instance binding removed.\n\nDo **not** merge #1194 as-is. Supersede or rewrite it.\n\nBlocks #1198 and #1196. {"body":"Full context: `HANDOFF.d/2026-08-19T0050Z-al8960ofc-claude-orchestrator-closeout.md` (section 8, Reviewers).\n\nIndependent review caught **five real defects** tonight that the automated tests passed — including one that could have cornered production and one that would have let a second worker orphan a paid provider job. It is the highest-value check this repo has, and it came close to being unavailable.\n\n## What happened to each reviewer\n\n- **Grok 4.6** — worked every time. Carried the session. But `ai-grok-review` holds a **per-repository in-flight lock**, so it cannot review two pull requests here at once.\n- **Kimi K3** — worked, intermittently. One run took ~12 minutes; one produced nothing at all; one hit a billing-quota `403` mid-afternoon.\n- **GLM 5.3** — three consecutive failures, each creating a session that never produced a turn. **Paused in #1189.**\n- **Qwen 3.8 Max** — paused by owner instruction, unchanged.\n- **Gemini 3.7 Flash** — newly wrapped as `ai-gemini`, and good: it approved #1176 round 5 with an exhaustive write-path enumeration and returned a correct REVISE on #1194. **It is NOT registered in the rotation.**\n\n## Why this matters more than it looks\n\n`ACTIVE_REVIEWERS` is currently **two names**. With an even rotation, a replacement after a failure can land back on the **same** failed provider, which `replaceFailedReviewer` correctly refuses — so **the replacement path can dead-end**. That is asserted by a test added in #1189 so it is not discovered mid-incident.\n\n## Outcome needed\n\n1. **Register `gemini-3.7-flash` / `ai-gemini` in `REVIEWERS`.** That restores three, removes the two-name dead end, and gives genuine parallelism across models rather than fighting Grok's per-repo lock. Note the rotation-order tests must be updated in the same change — see #1189 for the pattern.\n2. **Fix the `ai-gemini` precondition for this repo:** it refuses unless `.ai/reviews/` is git-ignored, but that directory is **committed here**, so the check can never pass. Kimi and Grok warn and continue; Gemini treats it as fatal. Workaround in use: `git rm -r --cached .ai/reviews` inside the disposable review clone. The wrapper lives in `u2giants/ai-devops`.\n3. Probe GLM before unpausing.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 800\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-08-20T03:08:50Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:55:55Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"Full context: `HANDOFF.d/2026-08-19T0050Z-al8960ofc-claude-orchestrator-closeout.md` (section 0 and the #1184 comment thread).\n\nTwo decisions Albert made tonight are recorded on #1184 but **not yet reflected in the design document that phases 2-6 will be built from**, and one of them will otherwise produce a table he explicitly said he does not want.\n\n## 1. No image bytes — supersede the spec\n\n`docs/coldlion-raw-landing-schema-design.md` §3.3 still models `coldlion.item_image_content` for base64 image bytes.\n\n**Owner ruling 2026-08-18: no image bytes at all.** Thumbnails are matched from PopDAM by **SKU / item number**. Coldlion is not the image source and the database is not an image store.\n\nConsequence: `item_image_content` is dropped from the plan entirely, and `coldlion.item_image` (metadata only) must **re-justify itself on its own merits** in phase 6 rather than be inherited from the original table list — if the match is by item number and PopDAM holds the asset, it may have no reader at all.\n\nAdd a dated supersession pointer at the old claim. **Supersede, do not rewrite** — the original is the audit trail.\n\n## 2. Forward-only versioning — the backfill and the sync are different jobs\n\n**Owner ruling 2026-08-18:** retention keeps the three most recent versions, and **version history is FORWARD-ONLY.**\n\nThe 2019-to-today backfill lands **one** version per row and writes **no** `change_log` rows. It must not attempt to reconstruct history from successive window pulls — Coldlion's history endpoints return current state per window, not a change feed, so any \"versions\" derived that way would be fabricated.\n\nVersioning begins at the first ongoing sync after the backfill. A row untouched since 2019 has exactly one version forever, and that is correct.\n\n**Design consequences to write into the spec before phase 2 is built:**\n\n- the backfill loader and the ongoing sync loader are **not** one code path with different date ranges\n- `change_log` will be **empty** immediately after the backfill — that is the expected, correct state, not a failed backfill\n- the roll-off is a separate provable job that must never delete the newest version and must refuse rather than guess\n\n## 3. Also settled, for completeness\n\nHistory depth is **2019-01-01 to today**, anchored to **one** seven-day grid from that date. That anchoring is what makes the grid-overlap check in #1195 free.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: documentation\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 500\ndepends_on: 1184\nobjects:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-08-28T22:27:18Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:55:37Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1202,"title":"HANDOVER: supersede the Coldlion design doc for the no-images and forward-only-versioning rulings","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:08Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1202"},
{"body":"Full context: `HANDOFF.d/2026-08-19T0050Z-al8960ofc-claude-orchestrator-closeout.md` (section 4 and section 9).\n\n## What happened\n\nPR **#1191** changed `.github/workflows/guarded-migration-merge.yml` — the only path by which a migration pull request may merge — and **I merged it without an independent review**, because it was blocking every migration merge in the repository.\n\nIt fixed a real defect: the workflow posted its own authorization status and called `gh pr merge` back-to-back, GitHub had not recorded the approval yet, the merge was refused, and the revoke step then set that context back to `failure`. A self-inflicted deadlock, observed four times two seconds apart on #1175.\n\n## The review it did not get, obtained afterwards\n\nGemini 3.7 Flash reviewed it retroactively at merged `main` and returned **REVISE**. It confirmed the change is sound and fails closed — no path merges without the authorization reading back `success`, retries cannot merge a stale or force-pushed head, and the status readback is trustworthy because GitHub's combined-status endpoint returns only the latest entry per context.\n\nThree findings remain **unaddressed on `main`**:\n\n- **Medium — swallowed API errors.** `2>/dev/null || echo ''` discards HTTP 401/403 and network failures from `gh api`. An auth outage logs \"authorization not visible yet\" ten times with no actionable cause.\n- **Medium — blind retries on permanent policy failures.** Five merge retries run even when refusal is a static policy violation no retry can fix, holding the repository-wide exclusive merge lock for ~2 minutes. **This is exactly what happened on #1175**, where the real cause was a required check that had never run.\n- **Low — redundant work after the final attempt** (fetch, merge-base check and a 10s sleep before failing).\n\n## The strategic finding, which is the valuable one\n\n> The workflow lacks a **pre-flight verification of required status checks** before posting authorization and entering the merge loop.\n\nAdding that turns tonight's hour of confusion into one clear error message, and stops the exclusive lock being held against a condition no retry can resolve.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 700\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-09-04T03:56:23Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:55:19Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1201,"title":"HANDOVER: address the retroactive review of #1191 (guarded merge) — add a required-checks pre-flight","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:10Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1201"},
{"body":"Full context: `HANDOFF.d/2026-08-19T0050Z-al8960ofc-claude-orchestrator-closeout.md` (section 9).\n\n## The trap\n\n**A migration rehearsed on preview BEFORE its pull request merges can never be promoted to production.** Not \"is awkward\" — never. The gate requires the rehearsal to have run from the promoted commit, and a pre-merge rehearsal never can.\n\n**It is unrecoverable:** an applied version can never be re-applied to preview, the preview lane requires a live author claim that is released at merge, and the branch is deleted. The evidence cannot be regenerated.\n\n**`20260818203751` (mgCategory, #1163, PR #1175) is stranded by this right now** — merged, independently approved, applied and verified on preview (7 categories, 58 links), production dry-run green, and unpromotable.\n\nThe owner-decision exception does **not** cover it: `prove_preview()` runs before the owner-decision branch and raises unconditionally, and that hatch only ever accepted the five derived **business** risks.\n\n## Why the existing attempt is parked, not merged\n\nPR **#1194** is my attempt and it is **wrong**. Independent review (Grok 4.6) found two High defects:\n\n1. **It does not achieve its own purpose.** Ancestry and the producer pin attach to `run.head_sha` (the workflow-file ref), but the preview job applies from `claim_head_sha`, and the artifact is named `preview-migration-apply-{run.head_sha}`. Provenance would pass and the artifact lookup would still fail. Those promotions stay stranded.\n2. **No preview-instance binding.** Preview was deleted and rebuilt today (#1188). Under that change, a rehearsal against the **dead** preview instance would still count as production evidence.\n3. Its five tests stay green through an **inverted compare** that would falsely accept unmerged code — the semantics were asserted, the argument order was not.\n\n## What a correct fix requires\n\n1. Pin provenance **and** producer files to the commit the rehearsal actually checked out — already present in the artifact name — not to `run.head_sha`.\n2. Require that commit to be a source-PR commit **or** a strict ancestor whose tree is what actually ran.\n3. Assert the compare **URL argument order** in the tests.\n4. Bind the **preview project ref** (or equivalent instance identity) into the evidence, so a rebuilt preview cannot inherit the dead one's proof.\n\nThis is the last gate before a production write. It gets an independent review before it merges, no exceptions, and preferably not from whoever wrote it.\n\n## Until then\n\nDocument and follow the ordering rule: **merge first, rehearse from merged `main`, then promote.**\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 970\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-08-28T22:42:29Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:55:02Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1200,"title":"HANDOVER: a pre-merge preview rehearsal permanently strands a migration (mgCategory is stranded now); PR #1194 is the wrong fix","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:11Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1200"},
{"body":"Full context: `HANDOFF.d/2026-08-19T0050Z-al8960ofc-claude-orchestrator-closeout.md` (sections 6, 7 and 8).\n\n## Outcome needed\n\nPR #1176 (issue #1171) is green and has survived **five** independent review rounds, each of which closed a real defect. Last reviewed head `67aba90` was **APPROVED by Gemini 3.7 Flash** with an exhaustive write-path enumeration.\n\nTake it the rest of the way: a rotation reviewer at the **current** head, guarded merge, preview rehearsal **from merged main**, then production.\n\n## What the five rounds closed, so nobody reopens them\n\n1. no proof of ownership at all; the money-losing \"expired lease, no batch id\" rule was on 1 of 4 write paths\n2. \"proof\" meant passing an owner name that anyone can read from `admin_config` and repeat\n3. a claim receipt was introduced, but its stored digest was writable by two paths — plant `md5(own-token)`, then present it\n4. drop-protection was computed from `phase`, which stayed writable — set phase, destroy the pointer, re-claim and be re-minted\n5. current: one definition of proof (`v_proven`), every guard input immutable to anyone unproven, on all four paths\n\n**The pattern worth remembering:** every round, a guard was computed from a value the unproven caller could set.\n\n## Coordination — this is NOT a drop-in\n\n`popdam3#92` must not proceed until this lands, and when it lands **two live PopDAM callers begin failing**:\n\n- `src/hooks/usePersistentOperation.ts` `start()` — \"Start Fresh\". **Should** raise; intended.\n- `src/components/library/AssetDetailPanel.tsx:335` and `StyleGroupDetailPanel.tsx:688` — the `{status:\"idle\"}` cleanup. **Legitimate today, will break.** Must be updated in the same window.\n- The worker must send `lease_token` and key off `lease_receipt_issued`, never off `ok` alone.\n- `types/database.types.ts` still describes the old three-argument form.\n\nClaim **#1174** is still open and holds the lane. Worktree `C:\\repos\\shared-db-worktrees\\issue-1171-bulk-operation-lease` is **LIVE — do not clean it.**\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 950\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n  - function public.update_bulk_operation\n  - function public.update_bulk_operations_batch\n  - table public.admin_config\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-08-20T17:59:18Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:54:44Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"## Outcome required\n\nAdd an append-only, capture-scoped WildBrain DAM landing schema. It must accept the private `u2giants/licensor-source-data` WildBrain scraper output (`wildbrain/scripts/scrape.mjs`) without putting licensed rows in this public repository, normalize every relationship the portal actually declares, deduplicate the licensor's own spelling variants, preserve raw evidence, and keep guide evidence we reconstructed strictly separate from facts the portal states.\n\nThis is schema only. No WildBrain property, era, character, guide, keyword, asset, filename, or raw payload may appear in this public issue, in migrations, in tests, in CI output, or in commit messages. Tests must use invented values.\n\nPer-licensor landing tables, per the standing owner ruling in `AGENTS.md` §6.13.1. Do not extend an existing licensor's tables and do not add a shared multi-licensor table.\n\nThis issue must not write canonical `core.*` or `dam.*` rows. Every reconciliation column ships NULL and unresolved by design.\n\n## Why this portal needs its own shape\n\nThree properties of the source drive the design, and each one has burned a licensor load before:\n\n1. **The portal has no style-guide object.** No ID, no record, no parent link. A guide's identity is free text typed into a keyword field, comma separated, with workflow status words mixed into the same list. Every guide row is therefore *reconstructed by us*, not read. It must live in its own tables and must never be presented as a portal-declared master record.\n\n2. **The licensor's own data contains spelling variants that collide.** The capture holds 37 distinct raw guide spellings that reduce to 34 after case-folding. Deduplication is a requirement of this schema, not a later cleanup. Near-duplicates that differ by more than case are deliberately **not** merged here; that needs a human ruling.\n\n3. **Character IDs appear on assets that do not exist in the portal's own character dictionary** — 9 of the 48 characters in this capture. Several are lowercase or misspelled twins of dictionary entries that do exist, so **the names collide and identity must be the numeric ID**. A schema that requires every asset character to resolve against the dictionary will reject a valid capture.\n\n## Which relationships are portal-declared\n\nRecorded explicitly so this load does not repeat the Disney DCP Vault mistake, where two independent arrays on one asset were paired and fabricated links.\n\n**Declared by the portal, safe to store as fact:** era to parent era; asset to era (single-valued); asset to character; asset to asset-category, creative-group, and file-type.\n\nBecause each asset carries exactly **one** era plus a character list, property-to-character is unambiguous here and is derivable from `plm.wildbrain_asset_character` joined through the asset. That is a real difference from DCP Vault, not a judgement call.\n\n**Reconstructed by us, must stay separated:** guide identity, asset-to-guide, and anything guide-to-character. These come from parsing a free-text field.\n\n## Scope limit that the schema must enforce\n\nThe licensee account sees exactly **one** property. The portal's dictionaries also expose brands, franchises, and characters belonging to unlicensed WildBrain IP with no assets behind them. Those must not be loaded.\n\nThe loader supplies only:\n\n- the era subtree of the licensed property (root plus descendants), and\n- dictionary entries actually referenced by a captured asset.\n\n`plm.wildbrain_era` therefore holds one root and its descendants, and `plm.wildbrain_character` holds only characters evidenced on captured assets. Rows for other franchises are out of scope for this repository and this database.\n\n## Exact schema contract\n\nAll tables are in `plm`. All source tables are append-only snapshots keyed by `capture_id`; a refresh **adds** a snapshot and never overwrites or deletes a previous one. Every raw payload column must enforce `jsonb_typeof(raw) = 'object'`. All text identifiers and labels require `btrim(value) <> ''`. Every count or size is non-negative. All timestamps are `timestamptz`.\n\nImmutability is delivered by **privilege separation**, matching the NBCU landing: `service_role` gets `select` + `insert` and **not** `update`/`delete` on the snapshot tables, and `select` only on `plm.wildbrain_capture`. No triggers. Retry safety is `on conflict do nothing`.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_capture`\n\n- `id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()`\n- `capture_key text not null unique`\n- `source_repository text not null`\n- `source_commit_sha text not null`, exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters\n- `read_commit_sha text null`, same format when present\n- `source_manifest_sha256 text not null`, exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters\n- `portal_base_url text not null`\n- `source_captured_at timestamptz not null`\n- `load_started_at timestamptz not null default now()`\n- `load_completed_at timestamptz null`\n- `status text not null default 'loading'`, limited to `loading`, `complete`, `rejected`, `abandoned`\n- `expected_counts jsonb not null`\n- `observed_counts jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb`\n- `media_downloaded integer not null default 0`, constrained to zero\n- `pagination_verified boolean not null default false`\n- `reported_total integer null check (reported_total >= 0)`\n- `truncated_child_lists integer not null default 0`, constrained to zero\n- `error_summary jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb`\n- `raw_summary jsonb not null`\n- `created_by text not null`\n\n`complete` requires a completion time, `pagination_verified = true`, zero truncated child lists, zero media downloads, and no validation errors. A rejected capture remains immutable evidence and never replaces the latest complete capture.\n\n`pagination_verified` is not ceremony. The portal's API accepts and silently ignores every offset parameter, returning the first page with HTTP 200 forever, so a broken pager produces a plausible-looking short capture. The loader sets this flag only after proving unique row counts against the portal's own reported total.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_era` — the property axis\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null references plm.wildbrain_capture(id) on delete restrict`\n- `era_source_id text not null`\n- `parent_era_source_id text null`\n- `era_label text not null`\n- `normalized_era_label text not null`\n- `is_root boolean not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, era_source_id)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_era_label)`\n- Self-referencing composite foreign key `(capture_id, parent_era_source_id)` to `(capture_id, era_source_id)`, deferrable initially deferred\n- Check that an era cannot parent itself\n- Check `is_root = (parent_era_source_id is null)`\n\nThis is the portal's property field. It is a real declared hierarchy, not a path string.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_creative_group`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `creative_group_source_id text not null`\n- `creative_group_label text not null`\n- `normalized_creative_group_label text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, creative_group_source_id)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_creative_group_label)`\n\nThe *kind* of guide a file belongs to. Distinct from an individual guide, which the portal does not model at all.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_asset_category`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_category_source_id text not null`\n- `asset_category_label text not null`\n- `normalized_asset_category_label text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_category_source_id)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_asset_category_label)`\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_asset_nature`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_nature_source_id text not null`\n- `asset_nature_label text not null`\n- `media_type text null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_nature_source_id)`\n\nFile type as the portal classifies it. `media_type` is the portal's own MIME string where present.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_character`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `character_source_id text not null`\n- `character_label text not null`\n- `normalized_character_label text not null`\n- `in_source_dictionary boolean not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, character_source_id)`\n- Index on `(capture_id, normalized_character_label)`\n\n**No unique constraint on the normalized label, deliberately.** The portal issues distinct IDs to entries whose names differ only by case or spelling, and both are live on assets. A unique label constraint would reject a valid capture. Identity is `character_source_id` and nothing else.\n\n`in_source_dictionary = false` records a character used on an asset that the portal's own dictionary does not contain. That is a licensor defect preserved as evidence, not a loader error, and it must not block `complete`.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_asset`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_source_id text not null`\n- `asset_uuid text not null`\n- `asset_name text not null`\n- `original_file_name text null`\n- `era_source_id text not null`\n- `creative_group_source_id text null`\n- `asset_category_source_id text null`\n- `asset_nature_source_id text null`\n- `universe_label text not null`\n- `raw_keyword_text text null`\n- `source_created_at timestamptz null`\n- `source_modified_at timestamptz null`\n- `file_size_bytes bigint null check (file_size_bytes >= 0)`\n- `page_count integer null check (page_count >= 0)`\n- `source_hash text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_source_id)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, asset_uuid)`\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.wildbrain_era`, `plm.wildbrain_creative_group`, `plm.wildbrain_asset_category`, and `plm.wildbrain_asset_nature`\n\n`era_source_id` is `not null`: every asset in this portal carries exactly one property, and a capture where that is untrue is not loadable. `raw_keyword_text` preserves the unparsed keyword string verbatim so the guide reconstruction can be re-derived or corrected without re-scraping.\n\nNo media byte, base64, or download-path column is allowed.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_asset_character` — portal-declared\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_source_id text not null`\n- `character_source_id text not null`\n- `relationship_truth text not null default 'declared' check (relationship_truth = 'declared')`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_source_id, character_source_id)`\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.wildbrain_asset` and `plm.wildbrain_character`\n\nThe primary key is the deduplication: an asset listing the same character twice collapses to one row.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_guide` — reconstructed, deduplicated\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `guide_key text not null`\n- `guide_label text not null`\n- `normalized_guide_label text not null`\n- `derivation_method text not null default 'keyword_field_split'`\n- `rule_version text not null`\n- `relationship_truth text not null default 'inferred' check (relationship_truth = 'inferred')`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, guide_key)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_guide_label)`\n- Check `derivation_method = 'keyword_field_split'`\n\n`guide_key` is the case-folded, whitespace-collapsed, quote-stripped label. This is where the licensor's case-variant duplicates collapse. `guide_label` is the most frequent raw spelling, chosen deterministically; every spelling is preserved in the alias table below.\n\nTwo hard rules for the loader, both from real defects in the source:\n\n- Workflow status words share the comma list with guide names and must never become a guide row.\n- At least one asset stores its entire keyword string wrapped in double quotes. Wrapping quotes must be stripped before splitting, or one real guide becomes two phantom guides.\n\nGuides that differ by more than case — a genuine typo, or a near-duplicate wording — remain **separate rows**. Merging them is a business ruling and is out of scope here.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_guide_alias`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `guide_key text not null`\n- `alias_label text not null`\n- `asset_count integer not null check (asset_count > 0)`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, guide_key, alias_label)`\n- Composite foreign key to `plm.wildbrain_guide`\n\nEvery raw spelling the licensor used, with how many assets carried it. This is what makes the deduplication auditable and reversible instead of lossy.\n\n### `plm.wildbrain_asset_guide` — reconstructed\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_source_id text not null`\n- `guide_key text not null`\n- `alias_label text not null`\n- `relationship_truth text not null default 'inferred' check (relationship_truth = 'inferred')`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_source_id, guide_key)`\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.wildbrain_asset` and `plm.wildbrain_guide`, and to `plm.wildbrain_guide_alias` on `(capture_id, guide_key, alias_label)`\n\n`alias_label` records which spelling *this* asset used, so the evidence survives the deduplication.\n\nAssets carrying no keyword text produce **no row here**. They are not attributed to a placeholder guide, because the portal offers no way to attribute them at all. In this capture 208 assets are in that position, and that is a correct outcome, not missing data.\n\n## Expected counts for this capture\n\nDrift checks supplied through `expected_counts`, not hard-coded constraints:\n\n| Table | Rows |\n|---|---|\n| `wildbrain_era` | 5 |\n| `wildbrain_creative_group` | 5 |\n| `wildbrain_asset_category` | 23 |\n| `wildbrain_asset_nature` | 7 |\n| `wildbrain_character` | 48, of which 9 have `in_source_dictionary = false` |\n| `wildbrain_asset` | 2287 |\n| `wildbrain_asset_character` | 2725 |\n| `wildbrain_guide` | 34 |\n| `wildbrain_guide_alias` | 37 |\n| `wildbrain_asset_guide` | 2168 |\n\nOnly 2 of the 5 eras are referenced by an asset; the other 3 are licensed siblings with no assets in this portal. That is expected and must not fail validation.\n\n## Functions\n\n### `plm.begin_wildbrain_capture(...) returns uuid`\n\nSecurity definer, fixed `search_path`, executable only by `service_role`. Accepts the capture identity and manifest fields, validates SHA formats and zero-media scope, returns the existing capture ID for the same `capture_key` and identical immutable identity, resumes `loading`, and fails loudly on conflicting identity or terminal status. It must not overwrite a completed or rejected capture.\n\n### `plm.finalize_wildbrain_capture(p_capture_id uuid, p_observed_counts jsonb, p_error_summary jsonb) returns void`\n\nSecurity definer, fixed `search_path`, executable only by `service_role`. Under a row lock it must reject:\n\n- `pagination_verified = false`, or a nonzero truncated-child-list count\n- nonempty errors\n- duplicate source IDs\n- orphaned relationship endpoints\n- any asset with a null or unresolved `era_source_id`\n- any era whose non-null parent does not resolve within the same capture\n- any `wildbrain_guide` row whose `guide_key` is not the normalization of its own `normalized_guide_label`\n- any `wildbrain_asset_guide` row whose `alias_label` is not a known alias of its `guide_key`\n- observed counts that differ from required expected counts\n\nOn success it sets observed counts, `status = 'complete'`, and completion time. On failure it sets `status = 'rejected'`, persists errors, and leaves the prior complete capture current.\n\nA character with `in_source_dictionary = false` is explicitly **not** a rejection condition.\n\n## Out of scope for this issue\n\n- No `api.*` view. Raw portal metadata and file names are licensed material and need an explicit access decision first.\n- No writes to `core.property`, `core.character`, `core.style_guide`, `dam.*`, or any canonical table.\n- No merging of near-duplicate guide labels beyond case folding.\n- No promotion of reconstructed guide rows into a canonical style-guide record.\n- The runtime loader belongs in the private repository, not here.\n\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n  - table plm.wildbrain_capture\n  - table plm.wildbrain_era\n  - table plm.wildbrain_creative_group\n  - table plm.wildbrain_asset_category\n  - table plm.wildbrain_asset_nature\n  - table plm.wildbrain_character\n  - table plm.wildbrain_asset\n  - table plm.wildbrain_asset_character\n  - table plm.wildbrain_guide\n  - table plm.wildbrain_guide_alias\n  - table plm.wildbrain_asset_guide\n  - function plm.begin_wildbrain_capture\n  - function plm.finalize_wildbrain_capture\n  - index plm.wildbrain_era_one_root_per_capture_uk\n  - policy wildbrain_capture_service_read on plm.wildbrain_capture\n  - policy wildbrain_era_service_read on plm.wildbrain_era\n  - policy wildbrain_creative_group_service_read on plm.wildbrain_creative_group\n  - policy wildbrain_asset_category_service_read on plm.wildbrain_asset_category\n  - policy wildbrain_asset_nature_service_read on plm.wildbrain_asset_nature\n  - policy wildbrain_character_service_read on plm.wildbrain_character\n  - policy wildbrain_asset_service_read on plm.wildbrain_asset\n  - policy wildbrain_asset_character_service_read on plm.wildbrain_asset_character\n  - policy wildbrain_guide_service_read on plm.wildbrain_guide\n  - policy wildbrain_guide_alias_service_read on plm.wildbrain_guide_alias\n  - policy wildbrain_asset_guide_service_read on plm.wildbrain_asset_guide\n```\n\n","closedAt":"2026-08-19T08:10:59Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:52:45Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1197,"title":"HANDOVER: Add normalized WildBrain DAM source landing schema","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:16Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1197"},
{"body":"## Outcome required\n\nAdd an append-only, capture-scoped Sega DSI landing schema. It must accept the private `u2giants/licensor-source-data` Sega scraper output without putting licensed rows in this public repository, normalize every explicit many-to-many relationship, deduplicate retries, preserve raw evidence, and keep inferred guide/character evidence separate from portal-declared facts.\n\nThis is schema only. No Sega title, character, folder, asset, filename, path, tag, licensor value, raw payload, or fixture copied from the portal may appear in this public issue, migrations, tests, CI output, or commit messages. Tests must use invented values.\n\nThe current authorized metadata discovery found 110 IP-registry records and 1,488 catalog nodes. These are capture drift checks supplied through `expected_counts`, not hard-coded database constraints.\n\nDepends on #1090 only for later promotion into canonical `core.*` and `dam.*` records. The source landing and capture validation can be implemented independently. This issue must not write canonical rows.\n\n## Exact schema contract\n\nAll tables are in `plm`. All source tables are append-only snapshots keyed by `capture_id`. Every raw payload column must enforce `jsonb_typeof(raw) = 'object'`. All text identifiers and labels require `btrim(value) <> ''`. Every count or size is non-negative. All timestamps are `timestamptz`.\n\n### `plm.sega_capture`\n\n- `id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()`\n- `capture_key text not null unique`\n- `source_repository text not null`\n- `source_commit_sha text not null`, exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters\n- `read_commit_sha text null`, same format when present\n- `source_manifest_sha256 text not null`, exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters\n- `portal_base_url text not null`\n- `source_captured_at timestamptz not null`\n- `load_started_at timestamptz not null default now()`\n- `load_completed_at timestamptz null`\n- `status text not null default 'loading'`, limited to `loading`, `complete`, `rejected`, `abandoned`\n- `expected_counts jsonb not null`\n- `observed_counts jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb`\n- `media_downloaded integer not null default 0`, constrained to zero\n- `is_limited boolean not null default false`\n- `ip_paging_terminal boolean not null default false`\n- `asset_paging_terminal boolean not null default false`\n- `ip_associations_complete boolean not null default false`\n- `error_summary jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb`\n- `raw_summary jsonb not null`\n- `created_by text not null`\n\n`complete` requires a completion time, `is_limited = false`, all three terminal/completeness flags true, zero media downloads, and no validation errors. A rejected capture remains immutable evidence and never replaces the latest complete capture.\n\n### `plm.sega_property`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null references plm.sega_capture(id) on delete restrict`\n- `property_source_id text not null`\n- `property_label text not null`\n- `primary_source_id text null`\n- `property_type text null`\n- `language text null`\n- `source_status text null`\n- `ip_components_text text null`\n- `source_url text not null`\n- `source_hash text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, property_source_id)`\n\n### `plm.sega_property_licensor`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `property_source_id text not null`\n- `licensor_ordinal integer not null check (licensor_ordinal > 0)`\n- `licensor_label text not null`\n- `normalized_licensor_label text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, property_source_id, licensor_ordinal)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, property_source_id, normalized_licensor_label)`\n- Composite foreign key `(capture_id, property_source_id)` to `plm.sega_property`\n\n### `plm.sega_catalog`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `catalog_source_id text not null`\n- `parent_catalog_source_id text null`\n- `catalog_label text not null`\n- `hierarchy_path text not null`\n- `hierarchy_depth integer not null check (hierarchy_depth > 0)`\n- `is_expired boolean null`\n- `can_edit boolean null`\n- `can_delete boolean null`\n- `source_hash text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, catalog_source_id)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, hierarchy_path)`\n- Self-referencing composite foreign key `(capture_id, parent_catalog_source_id)` to `(capture_id, catalog_source_id)`, deferrable initially deferred\n- Check that a node cannot parent itself\n\nThe numeric catalog ID is identity. A leaf label is not identity because the portal repeats the same label in different paths.\n\n### `plm.sega_style_guide_candidate`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `catalog_source_id text not null`\n- `candidate_label text not null`\n- `classification_type text not null`, limited to `style_guide`, `trend_guide`, `text_guide`, `packaging_guide`, `other_guide`\n- `evidence_type text not null default 'catalog_name_rule'`\n- `evidence_value text not null`\n- `rule_version text not null`\n- `confidence numeric(4,3) not null check (confidence between 0 and 1)`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, catalog_source_id)`\n- Composite foreign key to `plm.sega_catalog`\n\nThis table is explicitly derived evidence. It is not a claim that the portal exposes a Style Guide master record.\n\n### `plm.sega_character_candidate`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `character_candidate_key text not null`\n- `candidate_label text not null`\n- `normalized_candidate_label text not null`\n- `inference_method text not null`\n- `rule_version text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, character_candidate_key)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_candidate_label, inference_method)`\n\n### `plm.sega_character_evidence`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `character_candidate_key text not null`\n- `evidence_key text not null`\n- `catalog_source_id text null`\n- `asset_source_id text null`\n- `evidence_type text not null`, limited to `character_branch`, `catalog_path`, `filename`\n- `evidence_value text not null`\n- `confidence numeric(4,3) not null check (confidence between 0 and 1)`\n- `relationship_truth text not null default 'inferred' check (relationship_truth = 'inferred')`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, character_candidate_key, evidence_key)`\n- Composite foreign keys to candidate, catalog, and asset tables\n- Exactly one of `catalog_source_id` and `asset_source_id` must be non-null\n\nNo row from these two character tables may be presented as a direct source relationship or automatically promoted to `core.character`.\n\n### `plm.sega_asset`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `asset_source_id text not null`\n- `file_name text not null`\n- `artist_author text null`\n- `description text null`\n- `source_created_at timestamptz null`\n- `source_expires_at timestamptz null`\n- `file_size_kb bigint null`\n- `width integer null`\n- `height integer null`\n- `thumbnail_path text null`\n- `can_view boolean null`\n- `can_download boolean null`\n- `is_expired boolean null`\n- `source_hash text not null`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, asset_source_id)`\n\nNo media byte or base64 column is allowed.\n\n### `plm.sega_tag`\n\n- `capture_id uuid not null`\n- `tag_source_key text not null`\n- `tag_source_id text null`\n- `tag_label text not null`\n- `normalized_tag_label text not null`\n- `identity_method text not null`, limited to `source_id`, `normalized_label_fallback`\n- `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key `(capture_id, tag_source_key)`\n- Unique `(capture_id, normalized_tag_label)` when `tag_source_id is null`\n- Check that `source_id` identity requires a nonblank `tag_source_id`; fallback identity requires it to be null\n\n### Direct relationship tables\n\n`plm.sega_asset_catalog`\n\n- `capture_id`, `asset_source_id`, `catalog_source_id`, `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key on all three IDs\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.sega_asset` and `plm.sega_catalog`\n\n`plm.sega_asset_tag`\n\n- `capture_id`, `asset_source_id`, `tag_source_key`, `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key on all three IDs\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.sega_asset` and `plm.sega_tag`\n\n`plm.sega_asset_property`\n\n- `capture_id`, `asset_source_id`, `property_source_id`, `evidence_type text not null default 'source_asset_ip_association'`, `raw jsonb not null`\n- Primary key on all three IDs\n- Composite foreign keys to `plm.sega_asset` and `plm.sega_property`\n- Check `evidence_type = 'source_asset_ip_association'`\n\nThese three tables contain direct portal relationships only. Do not infer asset-to-property from catalog containment.\n\n## Functions\n\n### `plm.begin_sega_capture(...) returns uuid`\n\nSecurity definer, fixed `search_path`, executable only by `service_role`. It accepts the capture identity and manifest fields, validates SHA formats and zero-media scope, returns the existing capture ID for the same `capture_key` and identical immutable identity, resumes `loading`, and fails loudly on conflicting identity or terminal status. It must not overwrite a completed or rejected capture.\n\n### `plm.finalize_sega_capture(p_capture_id uuid, p_observed_counts jsonb, p_error_summary jsonb) returns void`\n\nSecurity definer, fixed `search_path`, executable only by `service_role`. Under a row lock it must reject limited or nonterminal captures, nonempty errors, duplicate source IDs, orphaned relationship endpoints, unresolved non-root catalog parents, and observed counts that differ from required expected counts. On success it sets observed counts, `status = 'complete'`, and completion time. On failure it sets `status = 'rejected'`, persists errors, and leaves the prior complete capture current.\n\n## Access, immutability, and indexes\n\n- Enable row-level security on every Sega table.\n- `anon`: no privileges.\n- `authenticated`: read access only under the established administrator, PLM-access, sales, or licensing policy.\n- `service_role`: select and insert on source tables, no update/delete/truncate. Capture status changes only through the two functions.\n- Revoke dangerous default privileges and function execution from `public`.\n- Add indexes for capture status/date, every composite foreign key, `source_hash`, normalized labels, catalog parent/path, asset filename, and all reverse relationship lookups.\n- Add comments stating this is licensed Sega source evidence, not canonical master data, and that inferred tables are non-authoritative.\n\n## Inventory visibility\n\nReplace `api.source_capture_inventory` so table names beginning `sega_` report `source_system = 'sega'`. Do not expose a public view containing Sega row values. If a latest-capture helper is needed, it may expose capture IDs/status/counts only, with the same restricted roles.\n\n## Tests and acceptance\n\n- Migration and rollback-safe contract tests use invented data only.\n- Prove retry idempotency, conflicting-capture rejection, snapshot isolation, composite foreign-key enforcement, direct/inferred separation, tag fallback deduplication, terminal paging requirements, zero-media enforcement, privilege limits, RLS behavior, and failed-finalization preservation.\n- Prove `api.source_capture_inventory` classifies every `plm.sega_*` table as Sega.\n- Run the governed preview workflow before merge. Opening this issue authorizes no production write.\n\nPrivate implementation source: `u2giants/licensor-source-data/sega/README.md` and the Sega scraper output contract. The orchestrator may read the private repository but must not copy licensed values into shared-db.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 100\ndepends_on:\nobjects:\n  - table plm.sega_capture\n  - table plm.sega_property\n  - table plm.sega_property_licensor\n  - table plm.sega_catalog\n  - table plm.sega_style_guide_candidate\n  - table plm.sega_character_candidate\n  - table plm.sega_character_evidence\n  - table plm.sega_asset\n  - table plm.sega_tag\n  - table plm.sega_asset_catalog\n  - table plm.sega_asset_tag\n  - table plm.sega_asset_property\n  - function plm.begin_sega_capture\n  - function plm.finalize_sega_capture\n  - view api.source_capture_inventory\n```\n\n\n","closedAt":"2026-08-19T08:11:01Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:45:22Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1196,"title":"HANDOVER: Add normalized Sega DSI source landing schema","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:17Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1196"},
{"body":"Follow-ups from the sequence-178 independent review (Kimi K3) of PR #1193, the Coldlion landing spine. That review returned **APPROVE** with no Critical and no High, so none of these blocked the merge. Recorded so they are not lost.\n\n**Both Mediums should land in or before phase 2.** One is now free, the other will turn CI red the day phase 2 arrives.\n\n## Medium 1 — the grid-overlap gap is now closable for free\n\n`window_ledger`'s unique key is on `window_from` alone (migration ~240-241), so `Jan 1-7` and `Jan 3-9` can both land. When #1193 was written, closing this needed the `btree_gist` extension and a `daterange EXCLUDE`, which was outside the claim, so it was documented in the table comment instead.\n\n**The owner ruling of the same day changed that.** History is backfilled from `2019-01-01` anchored to a single seven-day grid, which makes this a plain check constraint:\n\n```sql\ncheck ((window_from - date '2019-01-01') % 7 = 0)\n```\n\nNo extension, and it pins ongoing syncs to the same grid as the backfill.\n\n**If left as-is:** a loader bug starts a second grid, both windows are accepted because their `window_from` values differ, every request in the overlap is re-pulled, and `row_count` in the ledger double-counts fetched rows. Landing-table identity-key dedup (spec §2.2) still prevents duplicate rows, so this is wasted requests and misleading evidence rather than corruption — hence Medium.\n\n## Medium 2 — test section B is a time bomb for phase 2\n\n`coldlion_raw_landing_spine_contracts.sql` (~49-57) asserts the schema holds **exactly** `['change_log','sync_run','window_ledger']`. `database-contract-tests.yml` runs every `supabase/tests/*.sql` on every PR, so **the moment any phase-2 migration adds a feed table, this test goes red on every open pull request** until someone edits it.\n\nIf that is a deliberate tripwire forcing a conscious edit, the file must say so — it currently reads as a permanent contract (`B PASSED: exactly … exist`). Otherwise weaken it to a subset assertion.\n\n## Low 1 — `on delete set null` is dead code exactly where it matters\n\n`last_run_id … on delete set null` (~206) contradicts the `loaded` state requiring `last_run_id is not null` (~237-238). The RI-triggered UPDATE re-evaluates the CHECK and the delete aborts with a cryptic `23514` for any run that evidences a loaded window. Fail-closed, so not dangerous, but the declared action misleads and a future `sync_run` retention delete will hit it.\n\n## Low 2 — no default grant to `service_role` for future tables\n\nDefaults are revoked but nothing is granted, and `20260621164759` does not cover the new `coldlion` schema. Correct and fail-closed, but **every phase 2-6 migration must remember an explicit `grant all on coldlion.<table> to service_role` or the loader silently breaks.** Worth one line in the schema comment.\n\n## Low 3 — the hash check constrains format, not correctness\n\nNothing verifies `new_source_hash = sha256(new_raw)`; a loader writing any 64-hex string passes. `pgcrypto` already exists, so a server-side cross-check is possible later. Client-computed hashes are a defensible phase-1 choice, and the constraint does correctly prevent algorithm drift, which was its stated purpose.\n\n## Low 4 — \"three most recent\" ordering is soft\n\n`changed_at` is caller-settable and non-unique; same-transaction writes can tie, and nothing stops duplicate change rows inflating the version count. The owner's three-version ruling is expressible by grouping on `(table_name, natural_key)` over `changed_at desc`, and pruning is legitimately a later phase — flagged so **phase 2 does not assume more than the spine gives**.\n\n## Low 5 — residual exposure route this PR cannot close\n\nA later phase could create a view over `coldlion.*` in another schema owned by `postgres` (BYPASSRLS) and grant it to `anon` — the documented §10.2 view trap. Test C watches only the three tables' own ACLs and policies. PostgREST does not expose `coldlion` today (schema exposure is control-plane config). RLS, revokes and default privileges are otherwise correctly layered.\n\n## Docs debt for phase 6\n\n`docs/coldlion-raw-landing-schema-design.md` §3.3 still models `item_image_content` for image bytes. **Superseded by the owner ruling of 2026-08-18: no image bytes at all — thumbnails are matched from PopDAM by SKU / item number.** The spec must be corrected before phase 6 is designed from it.\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: structural\nroute: shared-db-orchestrator\npriority: 300\ndepends_on: 1184\nobjects:\n  - table coldlion.window_ledger\n  - table coldlion.change_log\n  - table coldlion.sync_run\n```\n","closedAt":"2026-08-26T00:14:44Z","createdAt":"2026-08-19T00:38:23Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. This label never grants orchestrator ownership.","color":"1D76DB"},{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAAC2L_V2g","name":"non-orchestrator","description":"Does not change database structure: not orchestrator work","color":"FBCA04"}],"number":1195,"title":"Coldlion spine follow-ups: close the grid-overlap gap for free, and defuse the phase-2 test tripwire","updatedAt":"2026-09-17T16:37:19Z","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/issues/1195"},
