{"body":"> Migrated from `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md` (WI-03) as of commit `17d25b66ab7d0b7d196b8b2e95a12b2f488b5094`.\n> Source: `## REQUEST QUEUE` line 776, `## REQUEST QUEUE` line 977, `## REQUEST QUEUE` line 1071, `## REQUEST QUEUE` line 1116.\n\n## The request, verbatim\n\nA summary loses the reasoning, and in this queue the reasoning — the traps, the\n\"do NOT re-litigate this\" lines — is the expensive part.\n\n### From `## REQUEST QUEUE`, line 776\n\n### REQUEST — Phase 2: BUILD the OPA lookup table (the original ask, still not built) — 2026-08-07 — requester: Albert Hazan\n\n**1. What outcome is needed, and why.** **Nothing was built this session.**\nEverything produced was design and evidence. The original request — \"Store the\nDisney OPA property→character list as a lookup table\" — remains **unbuilt**, and\nits three source blocks are still live in this queue below.\n\nAuthoritative design: `docs/verification/opa-source-of-truth-20260807/README.md`\n(revised on Albert's \"OPA is the source of truth\" ruling), which **supersedes**\n`docs/verification/opa-characters-20260806/DESIGN.md` (the earlier standalone-\nreference design). Read both, newest first, and re-derive anything they disagree\non from `git`.\n\nSettled and NOT open for re-litigation: Home line-of-business only; one-off\nsnapshot with a manual refresh ritual; raw table keeps Disney's exact string with\nthe likeness split in the **view**; follow the repo's real vendor-landing pattern\n(`plm.erp_*` raw + `api.*` views — **there is no `coldlion` schema**); `bigint`\nIDs left unconstrained because one row carries negative sentinels (`Special\nProjects`, `-9999`/`-9998`); `optionSourceID` is `1007` everywhere and its meaning\nis unknown, so build no logic on it.\n\n⚠️ Albert's \"OPA is the source of truth\" ruling means it now **joins\n`core.property`**, which makes it a **cross-app data contract** (PopCRM and\nDesignFlow both read licensor/property data) and triggers the `AGENTS.md` §4\nreview. It must be **serialised against the ColdLion cutover**, not run alongside.\n\n⚠️ **Do NOT commit the CSV anywhere new until R-SEC-1 is resolved.**\n\n**2. Which application(s) depend on this.** PopDAM primarily; cross-app once\njoined to `core.property`.\n\n**3. Blocking?** No. **4. Deadline.** None.\n\n**5. Current schema knowledge.** Measured on production 2026-08-07:\n`core.character` **0 rows**; `core.property` 256; `core.licensor` 26. Note both\nlegacy shapes exist **twice** (`core.properties_and_characters` 10,122 and\n`core.property_character_associations` 9,622) — a future session will find them\nand try to restart the retracted lineage argument. Do not.\n\n**6. Confirmation of what I have NOT done. [MANDATORY]** No table created, no\nmigration written, no `supabase/` file touched for this, no preview or production\nwrite, no chip.\n\n### From `## REQUEST QUEUE`, line 977\n\n### CLOSING NOTE — all three findings in the block below are now RESOLVED; the OPA request itself is still OPEN — 2026-08-07 — session: opa-scrape (t16)\n\nAppended rather than edited in place, per this file's log rule. Verified against\n`origin/main`, not from memory.\n\n| Finding in the block below | State |\n| --- | --- |\n| (a) `AGENTS.md` §6.7 stale on branch protection | ✅ **FIXED on `main`** by PR #467 (`53bc3f0`). §6.7 now reads `strict: true` and is dated. It was fixed on that branch hours before it reached `main` — this session marked it closed too early on branch-level evidence. Verify against `main`, never a branch. |\n| (b) PR #467 carrying this session's four OPA files | ✅ **RESOLVED.** The other session merged `main` into its branch and took `main`'s version in all three conflicts. **Verified: the retraction in §4 of the OPA README survived — the disproved claim is gone from `main` and the corrected block is present.** ⚠️ Note the prediction in the block below that \"merging #466 first clears #467 automatically\" was **WRONG**: the rescue used `git cherry-pick`, which creates new commit IDs, so git never saw the two copies as the same commits. |\n| (c) Hosted-runner starvation reading as a failed check | ✅ **CLEARED** with the 2026-08-06 GitHub Actions outage. `Cross-PR object collision` later passed in **28 seconds**. Dropped push events were **not** replayed — closing and reopening the PR was what fired fresh runs. The documentation value stands: **check job annotations before believing a red X.** |\n\n**Still OPEN and unstarted: the OPA lookup table itself.** Both the original\nrequest and its supplement remain live below. Nothing has been dispatched, no\ndatabase call has been made, and `HANDOFF.d/` no longer carries an OPA file\nbecause this session's own work is complete — **the queue is now the only record\nof the outstanding work.**\n\n⚠️ **Two sessions independently hit the shared-checkout problem on 2026-08-06**\n(this one had commits land on another branch twice; the other silently inherited\na commit and nearly landed a retracted claim on `main`). That is two findings,\nnot one, and nothing currently guards it. The durable fix is a hard rule: **no\nsession works in the shared checkout `C:/repos/shared-db` directly — worktrees only.** Belongs in\n`AGENTS.md`, which is single-writer and was deliberately not touched here.\n\n### From `## REQUEST QUEUE`, line 1071\n\n### REQUEST — SUPPLEMENT to the OPA lookup-table request below: a full background doc now exists, and it needs a `HANDOFF.md` pointer — 2026-08-06 — requester: Albert Hazan (via session: opa-scrape, t16)\n\n**1. What outcome is needed, and why.** Two things, both small.\n\n(a) The OPA request immediately below was filed before its background document\nexisted, so that block points only at the CSV. The full document is\n`docs/verification/opa-characters-20260806/README.md` — read **that**, not just\nthe request block, before dispatching the OPA work. It carries the data shape,\nthe reproduction snippet, six caveats, six open design questions, and a\nwhat-did-NOT-work table.\n\n(b) **`HANDOFF.md` does not mention this work at all** (verified 2026-08-06:\nzero matches for `OPA` across all 6,280 lines). It should, because `HANDOFF.md`\nis this repo's authoritative record of outstanding work and already references\n`docs/verification/` folders in 43 places. The natural home is the existing\nsection *\"Active workstream — Characters and style guides → canonical\n(2026-07-26)\"* (~line 4269), since the OPA data bears directly on it.\n\n**This requester did not make that edit, deliberately.** `HANDOFF.md` is a\nsingle-writer file owned by the coordinator; a requester writing to it is exactly\nthe uncoordinated write this file exists to prevent. Handing it over rather than\ndoing it.\n\n⚠️ One caveat from the README worth surfacing at dispatch time, because it may\nchange the answer rather than just annotate it: the extract was taken from a URL\nscoped to the **Home** line of business (`lobName=Option.Lob.Home`). Whether other\nlines of business expose a different or larger property set is **unverified**. If\nthey do, 1,445 properties is a subset, not the whole picture.\n\n**2. Which application(s) depend on this.** Same as the block below: PopDAM\nprimarily; cross-app if joined to `core.property`.\n\n**3. Is it blocking anything, and how urgently?** Not blocking.\n\n**4. Deadline, if any.** None.\n\n**5. What I already know about the current schema.** Nothing further. Still zero\ndatabase calls made by this session.\n\n**6. Confirmation of what I have NOT done. [MANDATORY]** No migration file, no\npreview or production push, no `supabase` CLI, no Supabase MCP call, no `psql`,\nno background task chip, no edit to `HANDOFF.md`. Only `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md`\nand the two files under `docs/verification/opa-characters-20260806/`, all on\nbranch `request/opa-character-lookup` (PR #466).\n\n### From `## REQUEST QUEUE`, line 1116\n\n### REQUEST — Store the Disney OPA property→character list as a lookup table — 2026-08-06 — requester: Albert Hazan (via session: opa-scrape, t16)\n\n**1. What outcome is needed, and why.** Albert needs Disney's authoritative\nproperty-and-character list available in the shared database as a lookup, instead\nof living only in the OPA web portal behind MFA. Today the only way to see which\ncharacters are approvable under which Disney property is to open OPA and expand a\ntree by hand. Having it queryable lets the character/style-guide reconciliation\nwork stop guessing at Disney's canonical spellings and IDs, and lets apps validate\na character against the licensor's own list.\n\nThe extract is attached in this same PR as a source artifact so it cannot be lost:\n`docs/verification/opa-characters-20260806/opa-characters.csv` — 10,262 rows,\n1,445 Disney properties, 9,591 distinct character names. Columns as OPA supplies\nthem: `property`, `licensedPropertyID`, `optionSourceID`, `character`,\n`characterID`, `brandPropertyID`. The IDs are Disney's own keys, not ours.\n\n**Design is the coordinator's to choose, not the requester's.** Two points worth\nweighing: (a) OPA scopes characters *per property*, so the same character name\nrecurs across properties — the natural key is the pair, not the name, and 670-odd\nnames appear under more than one property; (b) this is **vendor source data from\nDisney**, so it likely belongs alongside the other vendor/source-owned material\nrather than being merged into `core.property` / character identities directly.\nWhether it becomes a raw landing table plus a view, or is reconciled against the\nexisting character identity work, is a design call.\n\n**2. Which application(s) depend on this.** PopDAM primarily (character and\nstyle-guide taxonomy). PopCRM and DesignFlow both read licensor/property data, so\nif this is joined to `core.property` in any way it becomes a **cross-app data\ncontract**. Also directly relevant to the DB Data Admin curation screen already in\nthis queue.\n\n**3. Is it blocking anything, and how urgently?** Not blocking. Nobody is idle.\nIt unblocks nothing that is currently stopped, but it is directly useful to the\nin-flight characters / style-guides workstream, which has repeatedly had to ask\nLaura questions that Disney's own list may answer outright.\n\n**4. Deadline, if any.** None.\n\n**5. What I already know about the current schema.** **Almost nothing, and I did\nnot verify any of it live** — I made no database call of any kind. The one schema\nfact I have is second-hand from this very file: `core.property` is declared\n`unique (licensor_id, code)` and licensor→property is parent-child, so property\ncodes are **not** globally unique (recorded at `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md` line ~3000,\nciting `supabase/migrations/20260621150815_app_core.sql:200`). I have **not**\nchecked whether a character table already exists, whether the existing character\nidentity work in `docs/verification/character-identity-rules-20260728/` already\ncovers some of this, or how Disney appears as a licensor. **The coordinator should\nassume overlap with the existing characters / style-guides workstream and dedupe\nbefore dispatching** — see the related blocks in this file for \"Characters /\nstyle-guides Phase 1\" and the Laura round-2/round-3 licensing answers.\n\n**6. Confirmation of what I have NOT done. [MANDATORY]** No migration file\nwritten. No push to preview or production. No `supabase` CLI command run. No\nSupabase MCP call. No `psql`. No background task chip. No schema, RLS, view, RPC,\nfunction, trigger, grant, or seed touched. The only branch created is this one,\n`request/opa-character-lookup`, and it contains exactly two things: this request\nblock and the source CSV. Nothing in `supabase/` is touched.\n\n**Provenance of the CSV, so it can be reproduced or challenged.** Pulled\n2026-08-06 from `opa.disney.com` product-create screen, under Albert's own\nauthenticated OPA session in his Chrome (he completed the MFA himself; no\ncredential passed through the AI session). OPA loads the whole\nproperty-and-character tree into the page at once, so the data was read out of the\npage's own loaded state — no crawling, no pagination, no submitted form, nothing\ncreated in OPA. It reflects **what Albert's licensee account is entitled to see**,\nwhich is not necessarily all of Disney's catalog. Retired and \"No Likeness\"\nvariants were **not** filtered out.\n\n---\n\n*This issue replaces a block in `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md`. Do not re-file work into\nthat file — it is being retired. Open an issue instead.*","closedAt":"2026-08-12T22:00:46Z","createdAt":"2026-08-07T19:03:01Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"> Migrated from `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md` (WI-02) as of commit `17d25b66ab7d0b7d196b8b2e95a12b2f488b5094`.\r\n> Source: `## REQUEST QUEUE` line 743.\r\n\r\n## The request, verbatim\r\n\r\nA summary loses the reasoning, and in this queue the reasoning — the traps, the\r\n\"do NOT re-litigate this\" lines — is the expensive part.\r\n\r\n### ⛔ ALBERT — four owner decisions left open by session 774f5010 — 2026-08-07\r\n\r\nDo not act on any of these without a fresh answer from Albert **in the current\r\nchat**. Prior context is not approval.\r\n\r\n1. **Is the many-to-many property↔character junction still wanted?** Albert ruled\r\n   YES on 2026-08-07 — but he ruled on the coordinator's report that **609**\r\n   Disney characters belong to several properties. **That number did not survive\r\n   measurement.** Of the 609: **561** are the same property written twice\r\n   (`- No Likeness` / `- With Likeness`), and **42** are one Disney data-entry\r\n   error (`Morbius Movie 2020 - No Likeness` holds 30 characters literally named\r\n   `( MS Disney Plus TV Shows )`). **Genuine residual: ~6 of 9,613 identities\r\n   (0.06%).** One property per character survives Disney's own data. Albert has\r\n   been told. The design exists either way in\r\n   `docs/verification/opa-source-of-truth-20260807/README.md`, which recommends\r\n   **not** building it because it would duplicate `core.style_guide_character`.\r\n2. **How far may Disney overwrite our curated names?** Following it destructively\r\n   deletes **58** rows, several of which are defects on our side. Of 208 apparent\r\n   mismatches, **147 are pure surname ordering** (`Arnim Zola` vs `Zola, Arnim`)\r\n   and 250 use a backtick for an apostrophe; only **61** are real misses. Four\r\n   options in §8 of the same doc; it recommends option B (store it, let Disney fix\r\n   the 3 typos, flag the 147, delete nothing).\r\n3. **Does the §6.3 \"follow ColdLion, including deletions\" ruling apply to\r\n   licensors/properties?** That ruling was given about **vendors** (442 bronze\r\n   rows). Here **92,173 `public.assets` rows** carry a `core.licensor` id with\r\n   `ON DELETE SET NULL` — a ColdLion deletion would silently blank them with no\r\n   error and no way to tell which. **Albert was asked on 2026-08-07 and DISMISSED\r\n   the question without answering. It remains open.**\r\n4. **Should the actual asset files be downloaded from the licensor portals?**\r\n   Both scraping sessions were told **names and metadata only** — not the artwork\r\n   or style-guide documents — because they are large, they are the most sensitive\r\n   material on those portals, and no home was agreed. Needs a decision if wanted.\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n*This issue replaces a block in `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md`. Do not re-file work into\r\nthat file — it is being retired. Open an issue instead.*\r\n\n\n\r\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 600\ndepends_on: \nobjects:\n```\r\n\n\r\n","closedAt":"2026-08-16T21:01:47Z","createdAt":"2026-08-07T19:03:00Z","labels":[{"id":"LA_kwDOTAehpM8AAAACvU2Wcw","name":"db-work","description":"Unclassified shared-db intake. {"body":"> Migrated from `COORDINATOR_INTAKE.md` (WI-01). **Retitled and rescoped 2026-08-07** after an owner ruling landed the same day.\n\n## ⛔ Do not rewrite git history for this, and do not make the repo private again\n\n**Owner ruling, Albert Hazan, 2026-08-07** — recorded in [`AGENTS.md` §6.7](../blob/main/AGENTS.md): **the Disney OPA property/character extract is NOT sensitive.** He was told twice, plainly, that making the repo public republishes it. It is his licensee relationship and his call.\n\nThat **supersedes the original R-SEC-1 request**, which asked for the CSV to be scrubbed out of git history before the repo could go public:\n\n| R-SEC-1 part | State |\n|---|---|\n| (a) move the CSV to the private repo | ✅ done — PR #495, now in `u2giants/licensor-source-data/disney-opa` |\n| (b) leave a pointer in `shared-db` | ✅ done — PR #495 and #500 |\n| (c) **scrub the CSV from git history** | ⛔ **CANCELLED by owner ruling. Do not do this.** |\n| (d) restore public visibility | ✅ done 2026-08-07 |\n\n**Why this issue still exists rather than being closed:** it was migrated from the queue with its original title, which invited exactly the trap §6.7 was written to stop — a future session reading \"scrub it from git history\" and doing it. Retitled so the title itself no longer gives that instruction.\n\n*(Raised by Grok 4.5 on review of the migration, 2026-08-07.)*\n\n## What is actually left\n\nNothing blocking. Optional tidying only: the analysis documents under `docs/verification/opa-characters-20260806/` were partly redacted by PR #500 on the now-overruled premise that the names were confidential. If anyone finds those docs hard to read, the examples can be restored. {"body":"## What was broken\n\nThe Cross-PR object collision guard fail-closed-skipped ALL collision checking on stale PRs, with:\n\n```\nERROR: cross-PR object collision guard could not gather complete inputs -- Compare and commit-graph fallback disagree (...huge file list...)\nNo collision checking was performed. This is deliberate: a guard that cannot gather its inputs must fail closed. See B6 in HANDOFF.md.\n```\n\nSeen on PR #2835 at heads 57520a96e and 1a7a7ce58 (CI runs 36177421012, 36181829922). Not a real object collision.\n\n## Root cause\n\nGitHub's Compare REST API **silently truncates** `files` at 300 entries (and `commits` at 250) with no truncation flag. Pagination does not recover the rest (`?page=2` returns 0 files).\n\nLive proof on PR #2835 (`1a7a7ce58...main`, 2026-09-25):\n\n| Source | File count |\n|---|---|\n| `GET /compare/1a7a7ce58...main` `.files` | **300** (exactly the cap) |\n| `git diff --name-only <merge-base> origin/main` | **386** |\n| Compare `total_commits` vs `.commits` length | 418 vs 250 (same silent cap) |\n\n`validateBaseFileAgreement` required the two lists to be identical. A 300-entry truncated list can never equal a 386-entry complete list, so every pull request whose base has moved past the cap — every stale PR — failed closed and performed **no** collision checking at all. That is strictly worse than checking the complete list.\n\n## Fix (preserves the guard; does not weaken it)\n\n`validateBaseFileAgreement` now recognises the documented truncation shape and defers to the proven-complete commit-graph fallback:\n\n- **Compare at its file cap, strict subset of the fallback, fallback has more** → Compare is incomplete; use the fallback (which is already proven: merge-base exactness, tree identity vs GitHub, non-shallow, no duplicates). This *restores* collision checking on the full file list.\n- **Anything else that mismatches** → still fail closed (real disagreement). Error text now names only the files unique to each side, not both full lists.\n\nRegression tests cover: agreement, real mismatch (fail closed), truncated-at-cap subset (use fallback), under-cap subset (still fail closed), at-cap non-subset (still fail closed).\n\n## How blocked PRs unblock\n\n1. **This fix landing** unblocks them permanently — the guard will check the complete base file list instead of skipping. Re-run `Cross-PR Object Collision` after merge (or on next synchronize).\n2. **Merging `origin/main` into a blocked PR** also clears it: that moves the merge-base up to current main, so the \"files landed on base since branch point\" leg drops to ~0 and both sources agree. Verified for #2835 (merge-base `0a086c31`, 386 base-side files today). This is a per-PR workaround only; it does not fix the guard.\n3. **Re-running after other PRs land does NOT clear it** — more merges on main make the base-side file list larger, so truncation stays or worsens.\n\n## Verification\n\n- `node --test scripts/check-pr-object-collisions.test.mjs` — 36/36 pass (includes the new truncation cases).\n- Sibling suites from the same CI job — 825/825 pass.\n- Replayed the real #2835 file lists through the new logic: 300-file Compare prefix + 386-file fallback → returns the complete 386. Old logic threw.\n\nNo database objects, migrations, or policies touched — pure tooling.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3558?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792959296&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3558&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3558&signature=80b004a0cb758cba3696f3cc661b159f858d6a036eb93c80bf2eace9f1599d9f\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"Closes #3383 (non-orchestrator repository maintenance)\n\n## What this is\n\nA true prose-only PR may use a trusted fast CI path and skip the engineering suites. Anything else — code, migrations, executable agent instructions, symlinks, executable modes — retains the full path. The proof is an **exact base/head Git inventory including file modes**, and misclassification **fails closed**.\n\n## How the proof works\n\n\\scripts/check-documents-ci-route.mjs\\ reads \\git diff --raw -z\\ between the base and head and judges every inventory record. A change is pure prose only when **every** path is a non-rulebook prose document \\.md/.markdown/.txt/.rst\\ and **every** mode on both sides is \\100644\\ (regular non-executable blob). Anything else — an empty or unreadable inventory, an unknown status letter, an unknown mode, a truncated parse, a missing git object — refuses the fast route and forces the full engineering path.\n\n## Negative tests (the safety of the route)\n\n\\scripts/check-documents-ci-route.test.mjs\\ asserts, by name, what must **not** be able to skip the suites:\n\n- **mode** — a prose file made executable (\\100644\\→\\100755\\), an already-executable prose file, a symlink whose name looks like prose (\\120000\\), a submodule (\\160000\\), an unknown mode\n- **rename** — a migration or code file renamed to \\.md\\, an instruction-bearing rename in either direction\n- **deletion** — deleting a code file, a migration, or an instruction-bearing file\n- **instruction** — \\AGENTS.md\\, \\CLAUDE.md\\, \\.claude/skills/**\\, \\skills/**\\, \\.claude/agents/**\\, \\.claude/commands/**\\\n- **non-prose** — scripts, tests, workflows, migrations, \\.py\\, \\.json\\\n- **fail-closed shapes** — empty/null inventory, unreadable record, unknown status, record with no usable path, unparsable raw output\n\nPlus real git-inventory integration tests that build a repository and prove a prose-only commit takes the fast route while an executable-bit flip, a code change, an instruction change, a migration rename and a symlink all take the full path.\n\n## Base-trusted workflow integration\n\n\\.github/workflows/documents-fast-ci.yml\\ runs **trusted base code only**. It proves the protected base identity, checks out the base SHA, fetches the head as a **git object** (never checked out, never executed) and diffs. The classifier and its tests are proven before they are trusted. It publishes **no commit status at all**, so it cannot collide with the documents-only merge-authorization context (#3505) and cannot stand in for the guarded migration merge authorization (#3488).\n\n## Engineering-suite skip\n\n\\\tools-offline-tests.yml\\ and \\coldlion-promotion-contract-tests.yml\\ consult the route before running their suites. The classifier is extracted from the **protected base tree** via \\git archive\\ into a scratch directory, so the head cannot rewrite its own grader and the working tree still tests the head. Without a base/head pair, or on any error, they take the full path. Required context names, triggers and job shape are unchanged — no paths filter, no \\continue-on-error\\.\n\n## Safety\n\n- No required check is disabled, renamed, weakened, path-filtered or made optional\n- No branch-protection change\n- No database or production change\n- The existing documents-only rules in \\scripts/lib/documents-only-change.mjs\\ are **unchanged** — the new API is additive\n- The pure-prose route is **stricter** than the documents-only lane (it uses the same non-rulebook prose definition plus a mode check), so it can never grant something the documents-only lane refuses\n\n## Tests run at this head\n\n| command | result |\n| --- | --- |\n| \\\node --test scripts/check-documents-ci-route.test.mjs\\ | 45 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (symlink unavailable on this Windows machine; covered by the 120000 mode test) |\n| \\\node --test scripts/documents-fast-ci-workflow.test.mjs\\ | 11 pass, 0 fail |\n| \\\node --test scripts/lib/documents-only-change.test.mjs scripts/check-documents-only-pull-request.test.mjs scripts/check-documents-only-merge-authorization.test.mjs scripts/documents-only-merge-authorization.test.mjs\\ | 53 pass, 0 fail |\n| \\\node --test scripts/check-merge-queue-workflows.test.mjs\\ | 16 pass, 0 fail |\n| \\\node --test scripts/repository-maintenance-authorization.test.mjs scripts/agent-work-contract.test.mjs\\ | 58 pass, 0 fail |\n\nRelated to #3488 / #3505 — those documents-only rules are not weakened.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a {"body":"## Summary\n\nFixes #3505 (non-orchestrator repository maintenance; no database structure change).\n\n**Root cause:** The #2838 advisory status posted green under context `Documents-only merge authorization` — the same name as the workflow check run — making it indistinguishable from a real documents-only grant. A code PR (observed on merged PR #3311) could merge with only this advisory present, no `Migration guarded merge authorization`, and no exact-head verdicts. The live branch-protection required checks list was also missing `Migration guarded merge authorization`.\n\n**Fix (fail-closed):**\n1. The advisory now posts under its own context `Documents-only merge advisory`, distinct from both the real grant (`Migration guarded merge authorization`) and the workflow check run name.\n2. `Migration guarded merge authorization` added to live branch-protection required status checks via `update-required-checks.mjs --apply`.\n3. `ADVISORY_CONTEXTS` in the preflight covers both the new advisory name and the workflow check-run name.\n\n**Regression tests:**\n- A code PR with only the advisory status is refused at merge-authorization audit (`selectMergeAuthorizationAtMerge`).\n- The advisory context is verified distinct from `MERGE_SELF_CONTEXT`.\n- A disguised advisory description posted under the grant context is also refused.\n- Updated existing tests to match the new advisory context name.\n\nAll 226 affected tests pass.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a {"body":"## What\n\nDeletes \\HANDOFF.d/2026-09-16T1330Z-edge-dev-claude-498-owner-on-record-refusals.md\\ — the parked D12 handoff for #3050. {"body":"## Summary\n\nCloses #3421 (non-orchestrator, documentation — no database structure).\n\nThe queue interlock race itself was fixed in PR #3430 (merge \\5653b760e\\): the \\^Guthorize\\ job acquires the exclusive merge lane, re-reads PR-head authorization and the production interlock under that lock, posts group-SHA success only when both are live and clear, holds the lane until GitHub lands the merge, and revokes on failure. That code and its tests (admission -> freeze/revocation -> authorization) are already on \\main\\.\n\nWhat was missing: \\docs/merge-queue-operation.md\\ never described the interlock. This PR records the authorize job's contract in the safety contract and the failure-recovery notes.\n\n## Verification\n\n- Queue contract + configurator + workflow-coverage tests: 51 pass\n- Lane manager suite: 713 pass\n- Live \\--queue-mode\\ reports \\inactive\\ — the merge queue is not activated\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3514?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792912855&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3514&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3514&signature=b39ed5ffe4388bf42fa6a6b8d717697fd433a6fc458bee2cb3a2f7a69c521c0b\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"## Summary\n\nThe #2491 claim-head evidence fix landed on main via combined PR #3354 (absorbing PR #3322). This PR closes the one gap a Muse review of #3322 identified: the negative-path assertion refused on allowlist mismatch rather than isolating the \rehearsalMode gate, so it did not pin that condition directly.\n\n## Changes\n\n1. **Test hardening** (manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs): the #2491 negative-path now pins the \rehearsalMode gate directly — a binding with the correct allowlist, correct applied commit and proven claim head still refuses when it is not claim-mode. A second assertion pins the head gate: a claim-mode binding at a different head refuses and names the head condition.\n\n2. **Clearer refusal message** (manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs): when the claim-head path rejects a binding, the message now names the specific reason (no head proven / not claim-mode / head mismatch) instead of the ambiguous \\\nor the proven claim head\\. Acceptance behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged.\n\n## Verification\n\n- 713/713 tests pass in manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs\n- 12/12 tests pass in select-preview-route.test.mjs\n- No DB structure, no production, no secrets\n- Evidence matching is not weakened — only strengthened tests and a clearer rejection string\n\nCloses #2491\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev","createdAt":"2026-09-25T07:08:13Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/2491/1/completion.json","additions":39,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/2491/1/contract.json","additions":43,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":8,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":21,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"8e222f6624a2908f1689a0fb6c65a662b100a001","mergedAt":"2026-09-25T16:30:12Z","number":3512,"title":"fix(lanes): isolate #2491 rehearsalMode gate and name the exact refusal reason","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3512"},
{"body":"Closes #3125\n\n## Issue #3125 (non-orchestrator, repo-maintenance tooling)\n\n**State of the defect:** the order-insensitivity repair itself already landed on `main` (commit a990ce74e, absorbed through the combined lane PR #3322): both the pre-mutex check in `requireAdmissionGate` and the post-mutex re-proof in `acquireAuthorLane` now compare SORTED against SORTED, and the regression test `#3125 --claim --objects admits the admitted writes in any order...` has been green on main.\n\n**What was still missing:** the test matrix in the issue asks for three cases -- same set/different order accepts, different set refuses, **empty refuses**. The empty case was enforced only by code (`validateClaimObjects` throws `at least one exact object is required`) with no test guarding it.\n\n**This PR:** adds `[]` to the refusal loop of the existing #3125 test, so an empty object set is asserted to refuse alongside the wrong/missing/duplicate cases, and widens the expected refusal regex accordingly. Test-only change; no script behavior touched; collision detection unchanged (different sets still refuse).\n\n**Proof:** offline `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs` -- 713/713 pass before and after (empty case included after the edit).\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev","createdAt":"2026-09-25T07:06:09Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3125/1/completion.json","additions":27,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3125/1/contract.json","additions":41,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":4,"deletions":3,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"7b2a63e72050db1eb2b58d4146f4a7473c9594f1","mergedAt":"2026-09-25T20:01:58Z","number":3511,"title":"test(lanes): assert empty --claim --objects refuses in the #3125 order matrix","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3511"},

{"body":"## Summary\n\n`reviewerUsability` spawned `ai-review-preflight usable` — the command that reconciles **every** provider in one process — under `REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS`, the budget meant for a **single** wrapper doctor. A real pass through the cmd.exe → Git bash shim chain measures ~39 s and has taken ~80 s under load, so the 60 s default cut the run off before the later providers reported and refused the whole draw with `ai-review-preflight was cut off before reporting qwen`. The manual workaround was `REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS=120000` in the parent shell; no permanent fix had landed.\n\nThis gives the aggregate run its own budget:\n\n- `REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS` stays **60 s** — a hung single wrapper doctor must still fail fast.\n- New `REVIEWER_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS`, default `max(REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS, 240000)` — floor 240 s, the value edge-dev already settled on for this exact command in `ai-devops/config/reviewer-start-watch.json`.\n- An operator-raised `REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS` still widens both; it never shrinks the aggregate below the floor a real pass needs.\n\nNo env override is required for a complete pass to report every provider.\n\n## Verification\n\n- `ai-review-preflight usable` via `cmd /d /s /c` (the allocator's exact spawn path), **no `REVIEWER_*_TIMEOUT_MS` set**, reported **all nine providers including qwen** in **21.4 s**: claude, grok, kimi, glm, muse, gemini, **qwen**, codex, deepseek. Exit 3 reflects real unusable providers (qwen quarantined), not a cut-off.\n- Defaults resolve with no env override: `REVIEWER_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT_MS=60000`, `REVIEWER_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS=240000`.\n- `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs` — **713 pass, 0 fail**.\n- `node --test scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs` — **86 pass, 0 fail** (the `doctor did not answer within` matcher is untouched).\n\n## Scope\n\nNon-orchestrator work — repo maintenance/tooling in `scripts/`. Does not change database structure, contents, or migrations.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3506?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792904285&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3506&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3506&signature=bdc0c666f5ee03ca5de0d57e4f00d78115d25ee09f9e20710cce06be5f6099f7\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"## Summary\n\nRegression tests for issue #3488: the documents-only classifier must refuse any pull request whose changed files include a `.py` or any other non-prose file.\n\n## What the investigation found\n\nMerged PR #3311 carried `scripts/production_catalog_verification.py` and its test file, and the head showed a green `Documents-only merge authorization` status. That green is **not** a documents-only grant.\n\nLive evidence from the PR #3311 workflow run (36032274467):\n\n```\nnot documents-only merge authorization: non-lightweight file(s) changed: .agent/work/2876/11/completion.json, .agent/work/2876/11/contract.json, docs/verification/throughput-guard-truth-baseline-20260828.json, scripts/production_catalog_verification.py, scripts/test_production_catalog_verification.py\n```\n\nThe path classifier (`scripts/lib/documents-only-change.mjs`) already refused the file list correctly. The status posted on the head was the **#2838 advisory \"Not applicable: code change; guarded code checks required\"**, which shares the context name `Documents-only merge authorization` and therefore reads like a documents-only grant to any observer. The `#3311` code fix itself is correct and is not touched here.\n\n## What this PR does\n\nAdds regression tests that lock the fail-closed property in on **both** classifiers:\n\n- `classifyChangedPaths` (strict, reviewer-draw path)\n- `classifyLightweightMergePullRequestFiles` / `classifyLightweightMergePaths` (lightweight merge-authorization path)\n- `check-documents-only-merge-authorization.mjs` adapter\n\nCovered cases: a `.py`-only change, a `.py`+prose change, the exact merged PR #3311 file list, and a set of other non-prose extensions (`.mjs`, `.sh`, `.json`, `.yml`, `.sql`). The true-prose-only path still grants the exemption.\n\nNo production code change: the classifier was already fail-closed. These tests make the property durable.\n\n## Verification\n\n`node --test` on the documents-only suites plus `scripts/repository-maintenance-authorization.test.mjs` and `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs`: **62/62** and **717/717** pass.\n\nFixes #3488\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3503?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792903562&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3503&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3503&signature=0c73a95c330b40c3c37078f7e40b06085a3a72ae446c52b304b96a789228b5f2\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"## Summary\n- Recognize `silent_worker_observed` as a terminal failure code so `--release-failed-reviewer` accepts it instead of refusing with \"not a recognized terminal failure code\".\n- When the lease is already gone (silence-reclaim cleared it), release now accepts the silence-release ref as proof the lease was properly handled, instead of demanding a lease that no longer exists.\n- `--replace-failed-reviewer --failure-code silent_worker_observed` now accepts either silence-release evidence (from reclaim) or failure-release evidence (from release), so the release-then-replace recovery path works without a prior reclaim.\n- Exact-head approval, claims, locks, and refs are untouched. Fail-closed behavior preserved: absent lease + absent silence-release evidence still refuses.\n\n## Tests\n- All 713 tests in `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs` pass.\n- All 23 tests in `scripts/orchestrator-flow/reviewer-start-watch.test.mjs` pass.\n- All 4 tests in `scripts/reviewer-wire-budget.test.mjs` pass.\n- New test: release after reclaim is accepted and replace follows from failure-release evidence.\n\n## Refs\nCloses #3492 (reviewer-tooling, non-orchestrator work — does not change database structure).\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3500?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792901286&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3500&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3500&signature=bdf32ef70c2ce8daed7c0b367e89a28f4f6f04d4889df52466a005e5932f87ff\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"Fixes #3479. Non-orchestrator repository maintenance (reviewer tooling; no database structure change).\n\n`ai-deepseek-agent send` takes its brief as a positional message and has no `--prompt`/`--prompt-file` flag. The governed runner refused the positional form, and forwarded `--prompt-file <path>` verbatim, which the wrapper folds into the message as literal path text. For this wrapper only, `promptHeadContract` now moves the brief (reading `--prompt-file`) into the positional message after `send` / `reply <id>` and appends the same checklist and head-bound VERDICT instruction. Stale-head check and missing-brief refusal unchanged.\n\nDiagnosis of run 6eea639dc93945509759c4eac1296a4b: the reviewer-events record shows exit 1 at phase wrapper-exit with no stderr retained; the wrapper was invoked with a `--prompt-file` token it does not understand, and on that machine the 1Password executable check (fixed in ai-devops 76467900) could also exit 1 before any model call. This PR fixes the runner side.\n\nTests: `node --test scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs` -> 86 pass, 0 fail (new #3479 test covers send positional, send --prompt-file, reply with --file, stale head, missing brief).\n\nPosted by Claude chat 43dbc077-5edc-41f8-b56d-aa871c86ef96 on edge-dev\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3491?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792876778&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3491&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3491&signature=d6f5a8513c70398f2aafaebbde47984ae06fab6b5df24f571a0a399c1d12d2ed\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"Structural orchestrator work for #3464 under protected claim #3486, reserved migration 20260924183947.\n\nWidens `public.reset_bulk_operation_submission_lease` in two ways:\n\n1. Accepts reason `not_submitted` with NULL `p_http_status` and a fixed provider_error category `{\"category\":\"not_submitted\"}` — for when the worker fails before any provider POST.\n2. Widens `provider_definitive_rejection` to HTTP 400/401/402/403/422/429 (was 400/422).\n\nEvery other guard is unchanged: current receipt holder only, matching revision, no bound provider job ID, lease still live, no ambiguity markers, and never after timeout, disconnect or 5xx. A successful reset consumes the receipt without issuing another. The existing bulk-operation writer and its protections are unchanged.\n\nBehavior tests cover each new status/reason resetting once, 5xx/timeout/wrong-reason refusals, bound ID refusal, expired lease refusal, wrong owner/revision refusal, no receipt remint, and privilege checks.\n\nDerived from migration 20260923040630 (PR #3426).\n\nCloses #3464.\n\nPosted by MiMo chat unknown on edge-dev\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3490?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792868143&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3490&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3490&signature=7af0ac2d52e478e6cf9451425485c266a39f3e6ae50cf0acc61cc19e470b3d05\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"Closes #3477\n\nNon-orchestrator repository maintenance: scripts and docs only, no database structure.\n\n## What\n\nA reviewer whose provider account ran out of credit (xAI 403 on PR #3466) failed with \"wrapper stderr was present but its reason was not recognized\", so the session could not tell Albert why. Owner requirement, verbatim from Albert's chat message: \"Going forward i don't want to have to open a separate session to find out we're out of credit. the session that hit that error should A) know that that's why it failed, and B) tell me in that same session.\"\n\n- `scripts/run-governed-review.mjs`: `outOfCreditReason` recognizes the wrappers' anchored `AI_REVIEWER_OUT_OF_CREDIT provider=<grok|muse|qwen|gemini|deepseek> code=insufficient_quota` line and carries the strictly validated `OUT OF CREDIT:` sentence (one line, printable ASCII, 10-300 chars, anchored) verbatim into REFUSED as `insufficient_quota: ...`. Fixed per-provider text when the sentence is absent or invalid. Raw provider billing text from an older wrapper (`used all available credits`, `monthly spending limit`, `Insufficient Balance`, `Arrearage`, `prepayment credits are depleted`) is recognized but never echoed. This is the one deliberate exception to \"never echo wrapper stderr\", and it is limited to that validated line.\n- `scripts/orchestrator-flow/start-reroute.mjs`: `insufficient_quota` joins `NON_VERDICT_TERMINAL_REASONS`, so the runner raises a terminal non-verdict reroute at the same head. `TERMINAL_FAILURE_CODES` in the lanes manager already accepts `--failure-code insufficient_quota`.\n- `docs/agents/section-4-anti-collision-rules.md`: when REFUSED contains `insufficient_quota: OUT OF CREDIT:`, tell Albert in the same reply (quoting the line), then `--replace-failed-reviewer --failure-code insufficient_quota` and continue.\n\n## Tests\n\n- `node --test scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs`: 85 pass, 0 fail (per-provider fixtures, fixed-text fallback, spoof / overlong / non-ASCII / tab / embedded / lowercase negatives, raw-billing fallback without echo)\n- `node --test scripts/orchestrator-flow/start-reroute.test.mjs`: 24 pass, 0 fail\n- `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs`: 712 pass, 0 fail\n- all `scripts/orchestrator-flow/*.test.mjs`: 377 pass, 0 fail\n- `node scripts/check-throughput-truth-audit.mjs` and `node scripts/check-skill-drift.mjs --require-skills`: OK\n\n## Process disclosure\n\nThe work contract `refs/db-contracts/3477/1` was published AFTER the implementation was drafted and committed (implementation commit f711a3627, committed 12:18 PM EDT), not before as `docs/agents/agent-work-contract-repo-maintenance-evidence.md` step 2 requires. Nothing was back-dated; the evidence pair records this order. The contract's scope matches the diff exactly (five files, no database reads or writes).\n\nPosted by Claude chat 43dbc077-5edc-41f8-b56d-aa871c86ef96 on EDGE-DEV\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3478?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792858928&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3478&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3478&signature=c6a96902a984d285c76b65574357b507a10feeba2a86e8290224a7bf6057fbde\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"ColdLion's business contact answered three of the five observed `/proddetails` shapes on 2026-09-24 and referred the rest to their technical team, who have not replied.\n\n**Settled**\n- **A** — two rows identical in every business field: the customer's PO was written that way and entered that way. Not a double-write; do not de-duplicate.\n- **B** — one item's quantity split across two rows of a line: valid as written. **Do not sum.** On the second B example she pasted her own screen, which itself shows the line twice with both quantities — so the shape is visible in ColdLion's UI, not an API artefact.\n- Loader consequence: **nothing may be summed, merged or de-duplicated on `(prodOrderNo, prodLineSeq)`.**\n\n**Not settled**\n- **C** was called a hedged outlier on one order (\"I think these represented other things\"). That is not a rule.\n- **D**, **E** and all five numbered questions — row identity, what `prodLineSeq` means here, per-shape treatment, a possible hidden status/cancellation/revision flag, and whether any of it changes what we owe the factory — are with ColdLion's technical team.\n\nSo **#3351 stays open** and the constraint decision on **#3234 stays held**. The 9 orders remain held out of the load.\n\nDocuments only: register entry 2.36 in `docs/coldlion-open-questions.md` (plus the stale \"BLOCKING — none\" heading, which 2.36 already contradicted) and the `/proddetails` section of the 5b grain proof.\n\nThe customer name, the customer PO number and the pasted screen are deliberately not reproduced — this repository is public (AGENTS.md §6.14) and that is customer transaction evidence.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\n<!-- codesmith:footer -->\n---\n<a href=\"https://app.blacksmith.sh/popcre/codesmith/shared-db/pr/3475?autoLogin=true&ref=codesmith_pr_footer\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-light-v2.svg\"><img alt=\"View with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/view-with-codesmith-dark-v2.svg\"></picture></a> <a href=\"https://backend.blacksmith.sh/track/enable-autofix?expires=1792854674&installation_model_id=436274&pr_number=3475&ref=codesmith_pr_footer&repository=popcre%2Fshared-db&return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpopcre%2Fshared-db%2Fpull%2F3475&signature=6afa3416a37bc03cc72f499dbceb6e215e69efe6b0cec1969234a34c932681d3\"><picture><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"><source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-light.svg\"><img alt=\"Autofix with [code]smith\" src=\"https://pr-comments-assets.blacksmith.sh/codesmith/autofix-with-codesmith-dark.svg\"></picture></a>\n<sup>Need help on this PR? {"body":"Closes #2831\nAlso resolves issue 3348 (closed by hand after merge: the review gate requires exactly one linked work issue).\nAlso resolves issue 2787 (closed by hand after merge, same reason).\n\n- **#2831** — the allocator never draws a reviewer whose wrapper cannot emit the governed `VERDICT:` line (shared list in `scripts/lib/reviewer-capabilities.mjs`, also read by the runner, which refuses `ai-muse review`). Adds terminal code `reviewer_cannot_emit_governed_verdict` and its replacement command.\n- **#3348** — reviewer draw readiness refuses a closed, unmerged pull request.\n- **#2787** — `--queue-audit` lists open issues once and reads each PR's files at most once; output is proven identical to the old path.\n- #3324 was already fixed on main (e5241c262) and is closed separately.\n\nTests: full `scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/lib/*.test.mjs` suite: 2320 pass, 1 fail — `check-issue-505-licensor-code-forward-repair` fails identically on the untouched base `cb517b305` (CRLF checkout), unrelated.\n\nContract note: generation 5 (`refs/db-contracts/2831/5`) is the current contract. Generations 3-5 were published after the work began only to add `scripts/queue-hygiene-report.test.mjs` (hook-completeness classification of the new read-only `openIssueRows` hook), `config/orchestrator-global-invalidators-v1.json` (must list the new `scripts/lib/reviewer-capabilities.mjs`), and to name required checks that can be recorded before review. No other scope change.\n- **Review follow-up** — ai-muse subcommands are an allowlist (`new`/`ask`, option values skipped); record, resume, first draw and replacement all refuse a reviewer that cannot emit the governed verdict line; new test for two issues sharing one merged PR.\n\n\nPosted by Claude chat 7545365a-8132-4fd6-b0a1-f737035df839 on edge-dev\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-24T10:42:51Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/2831/5/completion.json","additions":40,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/2831/5/contract.json","additions":1,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"config/orchestrator-global-invalidators-v1.json","additions":1,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/lib/reviewer-capabilities.mjs","additions":47,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/lib/reviewer-capabilities.test.mjs","additions":30,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":63,"deletions":25,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":98,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/queue-hygiene-report.test.mjs","additions":1,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/run-governed-review.mjs","additions":7,"deletions":5,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs","additions":6,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"495dc03417cc33dc285a6a7db81c8906e11c8556","mergedAt":"2026-09-24T12:16:45Z","number":3472,"title":"fix(lanes): governed-verdict reviewers only, closed-PR readiness, single issue listing (#2831 #3348 #2787)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3472"},

{"body":"Fixes #3443. Unblocks #2995's production owner decision.\n\nSince the transfer to `popcre`, the owner's comments carry `author_association: MEMBER`, so the owner-decision gate (which demanded `OWNER`) could never pass. This binds the decision to the owner's exact login **and** immutable numeric GitHub user id, read from the new `config/production-owner-identity.json`, and accepts OWNER or MEMBER only for that identity.\n\nNot weakened: another member, a matching login with the wrong/missing/string id (renamed or reclaimed login), the right id under another login, COLLABORATOR/CONTRIBUTOR/NONE, and an invalid config all fail closed. The config file is registered as a preview-surface exemption (\"Never read by the preview job\").\n\nTests: `scripts/test_production_owner_decision_evidence.py` and all `test_production_business_risk_gate*.py` — 260 passed.\n\nPosted by Claude chat aa4791e3-535d-47ad-ac32-a4d0b9323273 on edge-dev\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-23T18:29:22Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3443/1/completion.json","additions":37,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3443/1/contract.json","additions":50,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"config/production-owner-identity.json","additions":6,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":9,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/production_owner_decision_evidence.py","additions":24,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/test_production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":2,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/test_production_owner_decision_evidence.py","additions":22,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"26a217c35b2eebba4d0463cd1f28b5f8385cca5d","mergedAt":"2026-09-23T23:01:27Z","number":3444,"title":"Owner-decision gate: bind to owner login + user id, not OWNER association (#3443)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3444"},

{"body":"## Summary\n\nTakes over PR #3279 (merge queue trigger support, dual-mode guarded lane, fail-closed activation — Step 7) and fixes the queue interlock race. **Supersedes #3420** (evidence-pair history there cannot satisfy #2708 without rewriting published commits).\n\nAlbert Hazan authorized this takeover: \"spin up a subagent to takeover PR 3279.\"\n\nCloses #3421\n\n## Queue interlock fix (the known defect)\n\nPR #3279 released its merge lock after queue admission. Its merge-group workflow read authorization once, could wait 25 minutes, then posted synthetic success without re-checking the production interlock.\n\n**The fix (`authorize` job in `merge-queue-gate.yml`):** acquire the exclusive merge lane → re-read PR-head authorization and the production interlock under that lock → post group-SHA success only when both are live and clear → **hold the lane until GitHub lands the merge** → revoke on failure. The `authorize` job is intentionally not a required check-run (avoids deadlock).\n\n## Status-reader class (three governed REVISE answers)\n\nEvery order-trusted authorization reader was replaced by the paginated `/statuses` newest-by-timestamp helper (`latestContextRow`, matching `selectNewestCommitStatus`). Used by merge-queue-gate, guarded-migration-merge, production dispatch, freeze-lift, and configure-merge-queue.\n\n## Verification\n\n- Queue tests 51 pass; lane manager 685 pass; exact-head/sync 65 pass; promotion-source 10 pass; throughput audit 16 pass\n- Governed Muse APPROVE at `ba90a7f98` and at `cd8249c24` (durable verdict artifacts recorded)\n- Agent work contract / git evidence / single pair (#2708) validated locally at `7c0cd0d73`\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- **Queue activation is NOT part of this PR.** Direct guarded merge remains available.\n- No fake migration. No production apply.\n\nAlbert authorized this takeover: \"spin up a subagent to takeover PR 3279.\"\n\nPosted by Claude chat ses_ffe5f3502886afferuQXFHy584 on {"body":"Structural orchestrator work for #3418 under protected claim #3425, reserved migration 20260923040630.\r\n\r\nAdds a narrow receipt-proven reset RPC for a current, unexpired, unbound PopDAM submission after a parsed provider-origin validation rejection. It requires exact current revision, owner, one-time receipt, HTTP 400 or 422, and nonempty JSON error evidence. All other statuses, including retryable 425/429 and routing/proxy-shaped 404/405/431, are refused. Timeouts, disconnects, 5xx, expired or ambiguous leases, bound jobs, and stale or rival callers remain blocked. A successful reset consumes the receipt without issuing another and strips submission lease fields. The existing bulk-operation writer and its protections are unchanged. PopDAM must authenticate and parse the provider response; SQL cannot distinguish provider from proxy origin.\r\n\r\nAfter a valid holder consumes its receipt and the revision advances, a later worker may obtain a new receipt only through the unchanged ordinary guarded claim on that fresh revision. An invalid reset never opens that claim path. The new function uses the same authenticated/service-role grants as the existing writer; anonymous/PUBLIC execution remains denied and exact receipt proof remains mandatory.\r\n\r\nValidation: disposable local PostgreSQL applied the current writer and repaired migration and passed the focused rollback suite, including every non-400/422 4xx refusal, the eight additional explicit status cases, and positive 400/422 cases, ambiguity markers, field stripping and privilege checks. Exact catalog pins, post-reset legacy/batch refusal tests, and live SET ROLE anon/authenticated/service_role calls passed in a disposable PostgreSQL rollback suite. SQL static guard and derivation declaration check passed. Exact immutable gen7 work evidence is published and Git-validated. The completion report names the implementation parent; the two-file sealing commit is bound to this exact PR head by the governed Git-evidence validator. No shared database writes. Preview, independent exact-head review, guarded merge, automatic production apply and PopDAM live proof remain required before the outcome is complete.\r\n\r\nCloses #3418.\r\n\r\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0cc6b-070f-7c32-b31a-827428e36332 on EDGE-DEV\n","createdAt":"2026-09-23T04:21:19Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3418/7/completion.json","additions":46,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3418/7/contract.json","additions":50,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"supabase/migrations/20260923040630_popdam_definitive_rejection_lease_reset.sql","additions":184,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"supabase/tests/popdam_bulk_operation_definitive_rejection_contracts.sql","additions":453,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"}],"headRefOid":"c4b64a985fbe894a61f283ab31c5d889a91a1158","mergedAt":"2026-09-23T17:55:53Z","number":3426,"title":"Add guarded PopDAM definitive-rejection lease reset (#3418)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3426"},

{"body":"Closes #3416.\n\nThe read-only #2870 catalog observer previously refused the Supabase Management API's valid HTTP 201 response in [run 35798848003](https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/actions/runs/35798848003). {"body":"Closes #3411 (non-orchestrator repository-maintenance work).\n\nMerged-main preview preparation compared a merged PR's prior-head APPROVE against the **current main tip**. Main already contains the head, so the diff was empty, and #3146 refused it. This blocked #2995 / PR #3382.\n\nFix: `contentPreservingRefresh` now takes the PR number. A merged PR is judged against the **first parent of its guarded merge commit**, the same rule the CI gate uses in `resolveApprovalMainRef`. It refuses when the merge commit is missing, is not in main, or when the recorded head differs. Open PRs are unchanged.\n\nTests: 682/682 pass, including new regressions.\n\nPosted by Claude chat eb950d03-b829-4d7c-870f-11b1a559a4e5 on edge-dev\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-22T23:18:36Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3411/2/completion.json","additions":53,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3411/2/contract.json","additions":44,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":60,"deletions":7,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":86,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"742b3e50ffad13e3b965838df0c0d07e2e06985e","mergedAt":"2026-09-23T02:48:15Z","number":3414,"title":"Judge merged PR prior-head approval against merge parent (#3411)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3414"},
{"body":"## Summary\nThe merge lane refused any pull request whose base SHA was not the live main tip, even after check-main-tip-freshness --contains already proved the main advance was independent (#2758). Docs PRs landing during the ~7 minute CI window made every code merge lose that race.\n\nThis wires classifyBranchFreshness into --acquire-merge when the tips differ. Unreadable git, file/migration overlap, conflicts, or a changed pull-request diff still refuse.\n\nCloses #3413 (non-orchestrator repository maintenance). Program tracker: #3306.\n\n## Tests\n- \node --test scripts/check-main-tip-freshness.test.mjs — 25 pass\n- #2758 merge lane accepts independently moved main only through classifyBranchFreshness — pass\n- Existing #2758 approval-carry and #2465 documentation-only cases unchanged\n\nPosted by Claude chat ses_ffe5f3502886afferuQXFHy584 on C:/repos/shared-db","createdAt":"2026-09-22T22:13:26Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3413/2/completion.json","additions":41,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3413/2/contract.json","additions":42,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"config/orchestrator-global-invalidators-v1.json","additions":1,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":13,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":74,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"858fa2c6f6033ca47d2c6a70d6fbc9f2991d4b5f","mergedAt":"2026-09-23T00:41:14Z","number":3410,"title":"fix(#2758): allow independently moved main at merge-lane acquisition","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3410"},

{"body":"Documentation only. Two files, both prose.\n\nRe-measured the `/proddetails` population read-only on 2026-09-20 — every `prodOrderNo` 1–60000 for EDGEHOME (the only company code), 3,819 orders returning rows. **11 same-`prodLineSeq` groups across 9 orders**, in five distinct shapes. `pkey` stays unique everywhere.\n\nThe 2026-09-18 supersession note on the 5b grain proof, and the body of #3234, both said the collisions were \"two real distinct lines, not an echo\". Some are. Others are an exact duplicate written 140 ms apart, or one quantity split across two rows — which is why dropping the unique constraint cannot be treated as a safe default.\n\n- `coldlion-unit-5b-grain-proof-20260915.md` — note corrected, falsified verdict marked in the grain table, and what the page may still be used for stated explicitly.\n- `coldlion-open-questions.md` — the question Albert sent ColdLion on 2026-09-20 registered as **2.36**, so it cannot be lost or re-asked.\n\nBlocker ticket: #3351. {"body":"Acceptance probes previously discovered runtime failures only after production execution. This adds bounded qualification helpers and CLI entrypoints using either an authenticated direct connection or the existing approved Management API read-only identity. Existing production behavior remains compatible; the new bounded production flag is opt-in until trusted workflow wiring lands.\n\nThe Management API adapter asserts the exact named role/privilege policy and server timeouts before the probe in one implicit read-only transaction, rolls back, and uses a materialized wrapper to require the original query's sole column to be PostgreSQL boolean passed, exactly one row, true. Its parser dependency is PR3395: lexer v2 and probeStatementText must be present or execution refuses before network access. No duplicate parser or new database role is introduced. Manifests bind exact original probe bytes, source PR/SHA, migration hashes, baseline, target, producer, execution policy and budgets. A manifest digest is not producer authentication.\n\nValidation: 28 Python tests pass, zero skipped. Live read-only calibration on the configured production target accepted a constant boolean probe and refused JSONB true, extra columns, zero rows, multiple rows and duplicate aliases. A deliberately wrong server-role assertion refused with SQLSTATE22012; a 100ms server budget against a 200ms sleep refused with SQLSTATE57014. These were transport fixtures with no application-table reads and no work qualification or production-outcome artifact.\n\nStill required: authenticate trusted rehearsal artifacts in the existing production gate, independently derive all expected bindings/baseline/role policy, wire the workflow, and record a genuine work qualification plus final production-proof pair. Step7 remains partial. Hold merge for ordered integration and new exact-head governed review; the prior approval applies only to earlier1bce8709.\n\nCloses #3367 (non-orchestrator work; no database structure change).\n\n\nPosted by Codex chat 01a0c04c-509a-7721-a6f1-4fc61f39a07e on 916-ALIEN\n\r\n","createdAt":"2026-09-20T19:51:46Z","files":[{"path":".agent/work/3367/1/completion.json","additions":37,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":".agent/work/3367/1/contract.json","additions":35,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/shared_db_live_proof.py","additions":384,"deletions":5,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/test_shared_db_live_proof.py","additions":359,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"6e07478b4a638ca250d4b6f8e585b937ac71dbd3","mergedAt":"2026-09-25T14:44:42Z","number":3371,"title":"feat: prepare bounded runtime acceptance-probe qualification","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3371"},

Regression test added (47 focused tests).\n- **Fixed - evidence binding.** The completion report is rebound to implementation head `3e16ba26c` with every recorded check re-run there, and the evidence pair is again the only commit after the implementation head, which `agent-work-contract-git-evidence` requires; it passes at the tip.\n- **Out of contract scope - manager grammar and sibling callers.** Generation-7 `allowed_paths` excludes `scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs`, and the issue keeps manager consumption as separate ordered work after PR3354. Through today's scope parser the new `issue@stage` token is refused as malformed - fail-closed, nothing releases.\n- **Probed, not defects.** `classifyDependency('10,11', state)` returns `invalid-dependency` (it does not drop `11`); the eleven named checks are the documented caller boundary - failure is carried by throws, not by the booleans; a non-operator stage fence blocking release is required by the acceptance contract (unauthorized evidence blocks).\n- The earlier `HOLD MERGE` above is superseded: the 2026-09-25 workflow-refactor closeout queues PR 3366 for CI-green then guarded merge.\n\nValidation at implementation head `3e16ba26c`: 47/47 focused stage/dependency tests, 790/790 manager/lifecycle tests, zero skipped, `git diff --check` clean; contract and git-evidence guards pass at tip `6cf6c2bba`.
