{"body":"## Outcome\n\nFold case on the prepack code in the ColdLion `/prepackDetail` loader's\nrequest-identity guard, so vendor cross-feed case drift no longer aborts the\nbackfill — while a genuinely different code still refuses, loudly, with both\ncodes named. Fail-closed behaviour is otherwise unchanged.\n\nCloses #3235. Refs #3179 (does NOT close it — the originating session owns\nclosure).\n\n## The live evidence\n\nThe #3229-enriched refusal diagnosed the final backfill slice's abort exactly\n(Actions run 35288752430):\n\n```\n/prepackDetail returned a row for another prepack code: asked PPk133, row answers PPK133\n```\n\nThe harvest asked `PPk133` — a spelling the vendor itself emitted through one\nof the feeds this repository landed verbatim — while `/prepackDetail` echoed\nthe same real key as `PPK133`. One prepack, two spellings, no signal in the\nresponse envelope: the documented `/seasons` defect class, on the request key\nthis time. Nothing was written; the guard held. 1,800 of 2,577 keys had\nalready landed cleanly.\n\n## The change\n\n`assertRowsAnswerRequest` in `tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs`:\n\n- The **prepack** comparison folds case (`asked.toUpperCase() === answers.toUpperCase()`).\n  A blank asked key refuses every row — the guard never invents a match.\n- The **company** comparison stays case-sensitive: no company drift has ever\n  been observed, and a future one must abort loudly with both spellings named\n  (the #3229 message already provides that).\n- The landed `prepack_code` keeps the **row's** own spelling, which is what\n  this feed asserts as its own grain: a replay through either harvest spelling\n  upserts onto the same row (`on conflict (company_code, prepack_code, sequence_no)`),\n  so identities cannot split into two rows.\n\n## Verification\n\n`node --test tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs` — 34/34 pass, with a new\ntest pinning the live drift shape verbatim, the landed-spelling invariant, the\ndifferent-code refusal, the blank-asked refusal, and the case-sensitive\ncompany guard.\n\n## Post-merge\n\nRe-dispatch the final bounded slice (777 pending keys) and reconcile.\n","createdAt":"2026-09-18T00:09:39Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":11,"deletions":23,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":25,"deletions":39,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs","additions":19,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs","additions":15,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"c0a1c6663859f27bf454bb98c92cf2fb05fc6a82","mergedAt":"2026-09-18T01:15:22Z","number":3236,"title":"fix(#3235): fold case on the prepack code in the request-identity guard","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3236"},
{"body":"Closes #3223 (repository lane for #3180; follow-up to #3221 and #3230).\n\nThe 2000-key backfill run (35275308013) landed 269 orders and aborted at live order 20344, whose response carries **two rows with distinct `pkey`s sharing one `prodLineSeq`** — the vendor has falsified the `(prod_order_no, prod_line_seq)` uniqueness that #2863 asserted as a table constraint (`pkey` remains unique). The loader was right to refuse; aborting the whole run was wrong: one key's data must not block the remaining ~3,500 keys.\n\n## The change\n\n- **Feed-shape failures stay fatal** (unknown/omitted fields) — a changed feed shape fails every key the same way.\n- **Per-key data failures become REFUSALS**: a row for another order, a blank identity field, either identity twice in one response. The key is recorded as a FAILED `sync_run` carrying `refused: identity-collision` in flat `request_params` (findable by the selection and reconciliation reads), alerted via `pg_notify`, never re-selected by backfill or refresh while the structural question is open, counted as `refusedKeys`/`exclusions` in every reconciliation — and the run still exits non-zero so NEW collisions stay loud.\n- **Transport failures stay outstanding** and retried by the next run.\n- README documents the refusal semantics and the live 2026-09-17 falsification.\n\nNothing is collapsed, nothing lands for the colliding order, and the constraint itself is untouched: changing it is database **structure**, filed separately for the orchestrator (see the db-work issue referenced on #3180).\n\n## Tests\n\n36 offline tests in the feed suite (169 across the four landing suites; 939 across all 48 tools files), including new coverage: collision errors carry `refused` (not `fatal`); the CLI records the refusal SQL durably, continues the population, reports `refusedKeys=1`, and exits non-zero; the selection SQL treats refused keys as answered; the reconciliation counts refusals as the one named exclusion.\n\nPart of #3180 (do not close it; the originating session owns closure).","createdAt":"2026-09-17T22:43:55Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":23,"deletions":11,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":39,"deletions":22,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-landing-sync.yml","additions":5,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prod-details.test.mjs","additions":111,"deletions":20,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/README.md","additions":12,"deletions":4,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prod-details.mjs","additions":104,"deletions":26,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/sync-prod-details.mjs","additions":24,"deletions":4,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"0a0d3d8ac4b9a199e5a8d86338c56f31650168e3","mergedAt":"2026-09-18T00:04:42Z","number":3233,"title":"fix(#3180): refuse /proddetails identity-collision keys per key instead of aborting the run","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3233"},
{"body":"## Outcome\n\nMake the ColdLion `/prepackDetail` loader's identity-collision refusal\nself-diagnosing. Fail-closed behaviour is unchanged — only the error message\nimproves.\n\nCloses #3229. Refs #3179 (does NOT close it — the originating session owns\nclosure).\n\n## Why\n\nThe final bounded production backfill run for #3179 (Actions run 35268207688)\naborted correctly when the vendor returned a row answering a different prepack\ncode than the one requested:\n\n```\n/prepackDetail returned a row for another prepack code\n```\n\nThe guard worked — nothing was written — but the message names neither the\nrequested key nor the code the row actually answered, and no sanctioned local\nread path exists against production, so the refusal could not be diagnosed\nfrom the run log alone.\n\n## The change\n\n`assertRowsAnswerRequest` in `tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs`\nnow names both sides of each mismatch (company and prepack):\n\n```\n/prepackDetail returned a row for another prepack code: asked PPK0001, row answers PPK4444\n```\n\nShort ERP codes only — never other row values — respecting the public-repo\nprivacy rules. A blank answer is spelled `(blank)`, never `null`. The\nsibling `/proddetails` loader (#3221) has an equivalent guard of its own and\nis untouched.\n\nTests pin both message shapes and the blank spelling.\n\n## Verification\n\n`node --test tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs` — 33/33 pass on this\nhead.\n\n## Post-merge\n\nRe-dispatch the final bounded backfill slice (777 pending keys). If the same\nkey refuses again, the log will now name it, and that key can be probed live\nto classify the vendor behaviour (case drift vs cross-key contamination — the\n`/seasons` defect precedent makes both plausible).\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T20:36:17Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":13,"deletions":21,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":23,"deletions":39,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs","additions":5,"deletions":3,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs","additions":12,"deletions":9,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"3111ec8cf769129932ee5fa2935b3dce96b51367","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T23:07:51Z","number":3231,"title":"fix(#3229): name both codes in the prepack identity-collision refusal","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3231"},
{"body":"Closes #3223 (the repository lane for #3180's loader; this is the follow-up fix to merged PR #3221).\n\nThe 3-key production probe of the new ColdLion Prod Detail Backfill workflow (run 35270886056) failed every key with `null value in column \"company_code\" of relation \"prod_detail\" violates not-null constraint`: the final insert selected only the 21 payload fields, so the leading primary-key column — stamped from the request because `/proddetails` does not carry `companyCode` — was never named and Postgres supplied NULL.\n\n- `company_code` now leads the insert's column and select lists in `buildProdDetailLoadSql`.\n- A regression test asserts the full 27-column insert shape (21 payload fields + company_code + 5 bookkeeping columns).\n\nEverything else on the probe path behaved exactly as designed and is evidence the guards work: the §4.2 target proof ran first, the harvest read the full 3,761-key population, requests were paced, each failed key was isolated and durably recorded, the reconciliation read reported zeros, and the run exited non-zero so nothing silent remained. **No rows were written to `coldlion.prod_detail` by the probe.**\n\nPart of #3180 (do not close it; the originating session owns closure).","createdAt":"2026-09-17T20:31:09Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":9,"deletions":14,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":4,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prod-details.test.mjs","additions":11,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prod-details.mjs","additions":4,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"f24a2437bf4f800268ad50281644499f6fd5379e","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T21:09:43Z","number":3230,"title":"fix(#3180): name the request-stamped company_code in the prod_detail insert","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3230"},
{"body":"Implements Phases B (self-service additive lane) and C (hop table) of [`plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md`](plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md) (issue #3199).\n\n**B1 — the boundary classifier.** `scripts/check-self-service-additive-lane.mjs` decides whether a pull request qualifies for the lane: every statement of every brand-new migration must fullmatch a ported production-`ALLOWLIST` shape restricted to boundary-qualified names, `security invoker` REQUIRED for functions, no `CREATE OR REPLACE`, no data/destructive statements, no `CREATE SCHEMA`, and — through the tokenizer's new `keep_dollar_quoted` view — no schema-qualified reference outside `{crm, pim, dam}` anywhere in a routine or view body (aliases distinguished from schemas). The ONE tokenizer (`sql_top_level_statements`) gains only output views (`spans`, `keep_dollar_quoted`) — pinned by `scripts/test_self_service_boundary_lexing.py`; no third parser. 20 dirty-first fixtures in `check-self-service-additive-lane.test.mjs`, including the Grok-review holes: `REFERENCES core.*`, `SECURITY DEFINER`, browser grants on RLS-less `crm`/`pim` tables, `dflow`/`app` escapes, riding-along workflows, both sides of the `ADD COLUMN` boundary.\n\n**B2 — route admission, never a work-type exit.** `self-service-additive` added to `QUEUE_ROUTES`, `ROUTES_BY_WORK_TYPE.structural` and `STRUCTURAL_ROUTES`; the five hard-coded `route==='shared-db-orchestrator'` checks (legacy admission, renewal, both expand paths, audit scan) accept both structural routes; `buildDynamicQueues` collects the route in its own `selfServiceLane` bucket that NEVER refills the orchestrator, and `--queue-audit` prints its own section. `NON_STRUCTURAL_EXITS` untouched. AGENTS.md banner exception + §0.0-C route paragraph + §4 sentence in the same change.\n\n**B3 — merge-time enforcement + the dispatch right.** `guarded-migration-merge.yml` invokes the classifier PRE-LOCK, route-gated (non-self-service pull requests exit 0 \"not applicable\"). `check-lane-route-sync.test.mjs` refuses any tree that admits the route without the merge-time step — PR #3204 finding 3 made permanent. The §8 merge-dispatch right (any write-authenticated session may dispatch the guarded merge for an approved, green pull request — the workflow is the gate) is recorded in the workflow header.\n\n**C1+C2 — hop table, no code change.** [`docs/agents/ephemeral-route-hop-table.md`](docs/agents/ephemeral-route-hop-table.md) walks every merge→production hop on the #2758 ephemeral route; the only pure-mechanics hop is already automated (`dispatch-production-apply.mjs`), so C2 lands as a justified no-change outcome per plan §9.\n\n**Not changed:** any gate, any required check, `NON_STRUCTURAL_EXITS`, preview/production policy, the serial lanes, the two-reviewer rule, §6.4.\n\n**Verification:** `check-self-service-additive-lane.test.mjs` 20/20; `check-lane-route-sync.test.mjs` 4/4; `test_self_service_boundary_lexing.py` 6/6; lane suite 604/604; orchestrator-flow 323/323; python suite 1184 OK; truth-audit 309 sites green; `check-sql.sh`; transport conformance.\n\nCloses self-service additive lane + ephemeral-route hop table (Phases B, C)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3228"},
{"body":"## Outcome\n\nThe prepack-detail refresh added to the daily ColdLion Landing Sync by #3220\nwould overrun the job's 90-minute budget at the loader's default pace. This PR\npasses an explicit pace on the scheduled step. Repository maintenance only —\none workflow file, seven added lines.\n\nCloses #3224. Refs #3179 (does NOT close it — the originating session owns\nclosure; backfill, reconciliation and the witnessed scheduled refresh remain\ntracked there).\n\n## Why\n\nThe live production dry-run dispatched after #3220 merged (run 35264164570)\nmeasured the harvest at **2,577 distinct prepack codes** (item_detail 2,577;\nprod_history_line 1,943; order_history_line 1,996; inventory and prod_detail\nempty until their loaders exist) and proved five live keys fetch cleanly with\nzero refusals.\n\nAt the loader's 3,000ms default — sized for the heavy paged history endpoints —\nthe daily re-read of 2,577 keys needs ~2h13m, well past the sync job's\n90-minute `timeout-minutes`. The job would die mid-refresh and report red.\n\n## The change\n\n`--pause-ms 1000` on the scheduled prepack step only:\n\n- The vendor agreement is **serialized one-request-at-a-time**; that is kept —\n  only the inter-request pause narrows, for a light keyed-lookup feed.\n- The whole refresh lands in ~45 minutes beside history+masters' ~8, inside\n  the budget with ~35 minutes of headroom for population growth.\n- The backfill workflow needs no change: it already takes `pause_ms` per\n  dispatch, and the bounded production backfill runs pass it explicitly.\n\nEvery existing guard is untouched: offline tests before any write, declared\ntarget beside every credential, missing-secret refusals, dispatch/schedule-only\ntriggers, shared `coldlion-landing-sync` concurrency group, and the\nhistory→masters→prepack ordering.\n\n## Verification\n\n- `node --test tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs` — 33/33 pass on this\n  branch (workflow guard tests included).\n- Live measurement evidence: run 35264164570 (dry run, nothing written).\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T19:22:29Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":10,"deletions":10,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":15,"deletions":16,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-landing-sync.yml","additions":7,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"ee60b98a2a5aa7782f70728a5cd7e084b1b85d4f","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T23:52:04Z","number":3225,"title":"ci(#3224): pace the daily prepack-detail refresh inside the sync job budget","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3225"},
{"body":"## Outcome\n\nCloses #3223 — the repository side of shared-db issue #3180: extend the existing repository-owned coldlion-landing loader with a keyed /proddetails feed landing into `coldlion.prod_detail` (#2863), add synthetic offline tests, and add the bounded resumable backfill plus ongoing scheduled refresh. **Non-orchestrator source-data work** — rows and loader code only, no database-shape change (#3180 `db-work-scope`: `work_type: source-data`, `writes: []`; #3223 carries the `repo-maintenance/workflow` lane for this diff, the precedent being the masters loader PR #2840 closing #2690).\n\nPart of #3180: the source-data outcome — the production backfill, the reconciliation, and the scheduled-refresh witness — stays with #3180, which this pull request does **not** close; the originating session owns its closure.\n\n## What lands\n\n- `tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prod-details.mjs` — the 21-field spec (live union re-derived 2026-09-17, matching the 2026-09-15 grain proof exactly), projection that refuses unknown/omitted fields, rows for another production order, blank identity fields, and either proven identity (`pkey`, `prodOrderNo+prodLineSeq`) appearing twice; one transaction per key carrying `sync_run` (running→succeeded), `change_log`, and the `(company_code, pkey)` upsert — the second identity is deliberately left to the table's unique constraint so a re-keyed vendor row fails visibly instead of merging.\n- `tools/coldlion-landing/sync-prod-details.mjs` — bounded, resumable CLI (`backfill` / `refresh` / `keys`). Harvests the complete approved `prodOrderNo` population from landed `coldlion.prod_history_line` (live reading 2026-09-17: 3,761 distinct orders), skips every key a SUCCEEDED `/proddetails` run already proves fetched, counts zero-row keys explicitly, and reconciles API totals against landed counts with exclusions stated (=0 for this feed, unit 5b ruling).\n- `.github/workflows/coldlion-prod-detail-backfill.yml` — manual dispatch, oldest-first, limit-bounded, resumable by evidence; shares the `coldlion-landing-sync` concurrency lane.\n- `.github/workflows/coldlion-landing-sync.yml` — the nightly scheduled run gains a production-detail refresh step AFTER history+masters (new orders become eligible immediately), offline gate extended to the new test file.\n- `tools/coldlion-landing-prod-details.test.mjs` — 32 offline synthetic tests: projection, replay determinism, duplicate refusal on both identities, empty responses, resumable selection, reconciliation agreement/collapse detection, CLI failure semantics (fatal shape aborts; per-key transport failure recorded + skipped + non-zero exit), and both workflows' target/secret/offline-test-before-write/serialisation rules.\n\n## Privacy and target proof\n\nNo ColdLion row values or credentials appear anywhere in this change; fixtures are synthetic and the loader prints keys/counts/statuses only. Every write path proves the target first: `COLDLION_EXPECTED_PROJECT_REF` + URL check + `proveTarget()` read before any fetch/write, per the §4.2 ruling, and the workflows declare the target beside every credential.\n\n## Follow-through (this session)\n\nAfter merge: dispatch the backfill workflow (the sanctioned production write path) with a 1-key probe run first, then bounded runs until outstanding is 0; capture the reconciliation; witness one successful scheduled refresh. Evidence lands on #3180 as comments; the issue stays open for its originating session.","createdAt":"2026-09-17T18:47:39Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":23,"deletions":38,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":39,"deletions":39,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-landing-sync.yml","additions":17,"deletions":3,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-prod-detail-backfill.yml","additions":88,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prod-details.test.mjs","additions":438,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/README.md","additions":46,"deletions":4,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prod-details.mjs","additions":355,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/sync-prod-details.mjs","additions":190,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"}],"headRefOid":"e2d897915c56a258c75ca12f48778a7fd5f56a97","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T20:22:20Z","number":3221,"title":"ColdLion loader: backfill and refresh production detail landing (#3180)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3221"},
{"body":"## Outcome\n\nLoad and continuously refresh ColdLion `/prepackDetail` data in the live\n`coldlion.prepack_detail` table created by #2863. Source-data work, no schema\nchange: this PR extends the existing repository-owned ColdLion landing loader\nfamily, adds offline tests, and wires the production paths.\n\nCloses #3222. Refs #3179 (does NOT close it — the originating session owns #3179 closure; the production backfill, reconciliation and witnessed scheduled refresh remain tracked there).\nreconciliation and a witnessed scheduled refresh remain).\n\n## What it adds\n\n**`tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs`** — the feed contract and the\nload transaction:\n\n- The eighteen-field spec from the 2026-09-15 grain proof\n  (`docs/coldlion-unit-5b-grain-proof-20260915.md`), including the genuine\n  duplicate-cased pair `itemPrice` / `ItemPrice` → `item_price` /\n  `item_price_capitalized` (both land, neither folds).\n- Projection onto the proven grain `(company_code, prepack_code, sequence_no)`\n  with loud refusal of unknown fields, omitted approved fields, blank natural\n  keys, fractional quantities, and any repeated grain — two source rows are\n  never collapsed.\n- The harvest: the complete `prepackCode` population read from ALREADY-LANDED\n  ColdLion tables (`item_detail`, `prod_history_line`, `order_history_line`;\n  `inventory` and `prod_detail` join automatically once their own loaders\n  exist), probed with `to_regclass`, refusing a target missing a required\n  source or the landing table.\n- One transaction: `sync_run` record, staged upsert, `change_log` for inserts\n  and updates, delete-with-evidence of sequences the current response no longer\n  carries (only for codes this run actually asked), zero-row alert.\n\n**`tools/coldlion-landing/sync-prepack-detail.mjs`** — one entry point:\n\n- `--limit N`: bounded backfill covering N not-yet-covered codes.\n  Resumability is evidence-based: each successful run records the cumulative\n  covered key set in `coldlion.sync_run.request_params`, so an interrupted run\n  resumes exactly where the evidence stops. No schema change was needed.\n- default: full refresh re-asking every harvested code (the scheduled mode).\n- `--reconcile`: read-only report of API totals vs landed counts, coverage\n  backlog, and zero-row keys; states explicitly that this feed has no\n  exclusions (unit 5b ruling).\n- `--dry-run`: harvests, plans, fetches live and validates every response,\n  writes nothing.\n\nZero-row responses are expected, never silent: counted, named on the run's\n`request_params`, and alerted via `pg_notify` — mirroring how the masters\nloader handles orphans.\n\n**Workflows** — the only sanctioned live paths:\n\n- `coldlion-prepack-backfill.yml` (new): dispatch-only production backfill,\n  shares the `coldlion-landing-sync` concurrency group, offline tests before\n  any write, declared target beside every credential, refuses missing secrets.\n- `coldlion-landing-sync.yml`: the daily 05:20 UTC run now refreshes prepack\n  detail after masters, giving the ongoing scheduled refresh.\n\n**`tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs`** — 33 offline tests (no secrets,\nno database, synthetic fixtures only): projection and sentinel normalisation,\nreplay idempotence (byte-identical SQL, no-op upserts), duplicate refusal,\nempty and malformed responses, request-identity guards, resumability, the load\ntransaction's shape, workflow target/secret/serialisation guards, and privacy\n(no real ColdLion value in any committed file).\n\n## Verification\n\n- `node --test tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs` — 33/33 pass.\n- Full offline suite `tools/*.test.mjs` — 903/903 pass (100 existing ColdLion\n  landing tests included, unbroken).\n- `bash scripts/check-sql.sh` — static guards pass (no migration added).\n- Both workflow YAML files parse.\n\n## Safety\n\n- No migration, no schema write: `writes: []` per the issue's scope block.\n- Target is proved before every run (`proveTarget`: declared\n  `COLDLION_EXPECTED_PROJECT_REF` checked against the connection string, plus\n  the `coldlion` schema check); the workflow refuses to start without the\n  declared ref beside every credential.\n- Loads are single transactions; a failed run leaves nothing partial behind.\n- No ColdLion row values or credentials are committed; logs print counts only.\n\n## Post-merge (tracked in #3179, not this PR)\n\n1. Dispatch the backfill dry-run, then bounded runs until `pending 0`.\n2. Run `--reconcile` and record API-vs-landed reconciliation.\n3. Witness one successful scheduled refresh in the daily sync run.","createdAt":"2026-09-17T18:45:54Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":28,"deletions":29,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":36,"deletions":43,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-landing-sync.yml","additions":9,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/coldlion-prepack-backfill.yml","additions":95,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing-prepack.test.mjs","additions":478,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/README.md","additions":28,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/lib/prepack-detail.mjs","additions":366,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"tools/coldlion-landing/sync-prepack-detail.mjs","additions":246,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"}],"headRefOid":"9b5a0184c28f50310944db222d1372ad15ffc6d1","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T19:18:44Z","number":3220,"title":"feat(#3179): ColdLion /prepackDetail loader with resumable backfill and scheduled refresh","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3220"},
{"body":"Closes #2830.\n\n#2830 (non-orchestrator work — it does not change database structure) reported the `Agent work contract` check as unsatisfiable by any honest route for `repo-maintenance` changes to scripts or workflows.\n\nThe premise is refuted by the code:\n\n- `scripts/agent-work-contract-git-evidence.mjs` has no `work_type`/`route` branch, but `--publish-contract` (`scripts/agent-work-contract.mjs:349`) is a plain CLI mode with no lane, orchestrator or route restriction.\n- `repo-maintenance` is a supported `work_type` in `config/agent-work-contract.schema.json`, with a worked example at `docs/examples/agent-work-contract-zero-database.json`.\n- All five pull requests cited as evidence (#2818, #2821, #2823, #2825, #2826) have since merged.\n\nSo no exemption is added and nothing is weakened, exactly as #2830 asked. This documents the four-step path — publish the contract ref **before** the implementation commit, then commit the evidence pair alone on top — states why the guarantee was kept, and records the shared-identity limit the script's own header acknowledges.\n\nDocumentation only: one new Markdown file, no code, test, script, workflow or configuration change.\n\nPosted by Claude chat ca4c7ff0-e657-46cc-a78f-7318e11116c0 on edge-dev-2\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)","createdAt":"2026-09-17T18:14:01Z","files":[{"path":"docs/agents/agent-work-contract-repo-maintenance-evidence.md","additions":76,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"}],"headRefOid":"afe89595624439c3f3d63b9f53cc1859c7c5b87a","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T18:15:07Z","number":3219,"title":"docs(#2830): define the repo-maintenance evidence path for the work contract","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3219"},
{"body":"## What\n\nIssue #2828 (secondary ask): the governed reviewer-preflight refusal for a doctor timeout now names the repair instead of a bare \"doctor did not answer within 60s\".\n\n- `doctorTimeoutFailingChecks(wrapper, timeoutMs)` — new exported helper: keeps the load-bearing `doctor did not answer within` prefix (run-governed-review's `DOCTOR_TIMEOUT` regex matches it to drive retry-then-reroute) and appends a wrapper-specific repair hint.\n- For `ai-glm` — the only wrapper in the rotation whose provider runs a local server — the hint names `ai-glm server start` exactly as the issue asks.\n- Other wrappers get `run '<wrapper> doctor' locally to see which check stalls`.\n- Unit test pins both shapes and the prefix contract.\n\n## Why now\n\nThe primary defect in #2828 (the doctor spawn-shape hang) is being fixed in popcre/ai-devops by batching the per-session sweeps out of `ai-glm doctor`; as the issue comment itself notes, the message alone would not have fixed that instance, but once doctor answers again the down-server case still deserves a refusal that names its repair.\n\n## Verification\n\n- `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs` — 605 pass (incl. the new test).\n- `node --test scripts/run-governed-review.test.mjs` — pass (DOCTOR_TIMEOUT contract intact).\n\nCloses #2828 (together with the ai-devops client fix; the exclusion on PR #3201 was correct and is not touched).\n\n```db-work-scope\nstatus: ready\nwork_type: repo-maintenance\nroute: repo-maintenance\npriority: 60\n```\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T18:01:06Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":14,"deletions":10,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":22,"deletions":20,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":13,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":14,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"284156784d2702fd1a9ab97b5b8c74279b6a1b5c","mergedAt":"2026-09-18T04:19:13Z","number":3217,"title":"feat(#2828): name the ai-glm server-start repair in the doctor-timeout preflight refusal","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3217"},
{"body":"Implements Phase A3 of [`plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md`](plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md) (issue #3199), and records the already-executed A1/A2 in the plan STATUS.\n\n**What lands**\n- `--queue-hygiene-report` subcommand: reports ONLY the hygiene sections the interactive audit prints — unlabelled issues, expired author leases, NOT ORCHESTRATOR WORK aging — reusing `buildDynamicQueues` and the audit's own reads.\n- `hygieneReportIo`: every githubIo mutation hook (comment/update/create/delete/push/ref) is stripped to a throwing refusal BEFORE any read begins — the `reportOnlyFlowIo` discipline. A scheduled write becomes a loud error, never a silent success.\n- A backed-up queue exits 0 (it is the normal state this program relieves, not a hygiene failure); an unreadable queue exits 2 and never reads as clean.\n- `.github/workflows/queue-hygiene-report.yml`: daily 04:23 UTC + `workflow_dispatch`, `contents/issues/pull-requests: read` only, writes nothing (no issues, no comments, no labels), modeled on `author-lane-abandonment-audit.yml`.\n- `scripts/queue-hygiene-report.test.mjs`: 6 offline tests — write-refusals first, backed-up-exits-0, unlabelled/expired/aging reporting, unreadable-exits-2 — wired into `tools-offline-tests.yml` in this same PR.\n\n**Not changed:** `--queue-audit` behavior, any gate, any required check, any database object.\n\n**Verification:** `node --test scripts/queue-hygiene-report.test.mjs` (6/6), `node --test scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs` (604/604), `bash scripts/check-sql.sh`, `node scripts/check-github-transport-conformance.mjs`, live smoke run of the subcommand against the live queue (exit 0, findings in sections). {"body":"Documents-only pull request (rule 18: no reviewer required).\n\nAdds `plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md` — the implementation plan for issue #3199, reducing what MUST pass through the orchestrator session without reducing the safety floor (serial lanes, exact-head approvals, two reviewers, collision locks, curated Master Data gate — all untouched):\n\n- **Phase A — queue hygiene:** label unlabelled issues (scope block verified first), close out expired claim #3089 via the guarded release path, add a read-only scheduled Queue Hygiene Report workflow that writes nothing.\n- **Phase B — self-service additive lane:** fail-closed classifier + admitted `self-service-additive` route for additive changes confined to `crm`/`pim`/`dam` (or a brand-new single-app schema); keeps lane claims, version reservation, two reviewers, guarded merge, and existing preview/#2758 policy unchanged.\n- **Phase C — zero-touch wait chain:** written hop table for the #2758 ephemeral route between merge and production; automate pure mechanics only.\n- **Phase D — docs:** AGENTS.md §0.0-C sync, both `shared-db-change` skills, memory.\n\nCompanion (not re-planned here): #2530 keeps the org transfer + native merge queue.\n\nRegisters the paired handoff `HANDOFF.d/2026-09-17T1325Z-zcode-plan-orchestrator-load-reduction.md` (contract block → issue #3199).\n\nNote: the owner also asked for a Muse Spark 1.3 opinion on this plan. `ai-muse` failed twice today with \"Muse returned malformed event output\" (both sessions fenced per protocol, evidence under `.ai/reviews/`); the handoff records that the opinion is still pending — it should be obtained before Phase A starts.\n\nCloses #3210 (the landing issue for this plan PR; the program itself stays tracked in #3199).","createdAt":"2026-09-17T14:07:18Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":13,"deletions":11,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":16,"deletions":18,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"HANDOFF.d/2026-09-17T1325Z-zcode-plan-orchestrator-load-reduction.md","additions":42,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"plan_orchestrator_required_load_reduction.md","additions":259,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"}],"headRefOid":"6e8ce46ec56d68944167468327abfc932e96ef70","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T16:09:36Z","number":3204,"title":"docs(#3199): plan reducing required orchestrator traffic without reducing safety","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3204"},

Documents only.\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T13:50:41Z","files":[{"path":"docs/business-rules/application-map.md","additions":1,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"docs/business-rules/licensing-master-data.md","additions":8,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"8f190afc788da29c47848424e2bebb6b6b4cf639","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T14:42:25Z","number":3203,"title":"docs(#2827): source_licensor_id is attribution provenance, never current ownership","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3203"},
{"body":"## What\n\nCloses #2837. The exact-head approval gate had no minimum slot count: it demanded an APPROVE for every slot it could *see* from pinned assignments, so a lane that drew slot 1 and never drew slot 2 reached the guarded merge with a green gate on a single review. Proved live on PR #2746 (issue #2478), which merged production-bound `main` with exactly one approval and one pinned assignment — no `-slot2` ref in any namespace across all nine heads.\n\n## Fix\n\n- A required minimum is derived from the pull request's own changed files — the same list the documents-only lane (#2102) already reads, renames carrying their previous name: a change touching `supabase/migrations/` requires **two** slots, every other change **one**. That is exactly the rule AGENTS.md §4 states in prose.\n- A missing slot is a refusal naming the slot number (\"a slot this gate cannot see is a slot it cannot require\"), so a never-drawn slot 2 fails loudly instead of authorizing a single-review merge.\n- `changedFiles` absent entirely keeps the one-slot floor, mirroring the documents-only lane's convention for callers that predate the field.\n- A pinned assignment without an explicit `slot` is normalized to slot 1 — the same default `parseAssignmentRef` applies — so it can no longer register as an `undefined`, invisible slot.\n- Nothing else changes: the returned-slot rule, documents-only lane, carry-forward, non-reading-reviewer rule, and every existing refusal are untouched (the issue's \"What NOT to do\" list is honored; carry-forward is not the bug and is not altered).\n\n## Tests\n\n`node --test scripts/check-exact-head-approval.test.mjs`: 60 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped (5 new tests: migration change refuses naming slot 2; migration rename counts the previous name; both slots approved passes with `required_slots: 2`; scripts-only change keeps the one-slot floor; absent changed-file list unchanged for legacy callers). The wider offline battery (`check-exact-head-approval`, `manage-migration-author-lanes`, `coordination-scenarios`, `record-review-verdict`, `run-governed-review`, `agent-work-contract*`, `documents-only-change`, `pr-content-equivalence`) passes 864/864 with this change present.\n\nNo migration, database, workflow, or coordination-ref write.\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T13:47:26Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":16,"deletions":11,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":24,"deletions":24,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/check-exact-head-approval.mjs","additions":36,"deletions":5,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/check-exact-head-approval.test.mjs","additions":59,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"bf8261aa87d0f5fd2d01a583d0166155b66a1b21","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T15:19:34Z","number":3202,"title":"fix(#2837): require the review slot count the change class demands","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3202"},
{"body":"## What\n\nCloses #2730. `prove_pr_and_checks` in `scripts/production_business_risk_gate.py` kept whichever same-name check-run row the API listed last, so an older cancelled run listed after a newer successful one was silently selected (live case: PR #2527, production run 34564942032 refused on the cancelled run 34563998795 while 34563999011 had succeeded).\n\n## Fix\n\n- New `select_newest_check_rows()`: the newest row per check name is the one with the greatest check-run id (ids are unique, assigned at creation; every re-run gets a larger one) — deterministic, independent of API row order.\n- A name with one row needs no ordering evidence (backwards-compatible with existing fixtures). Two or more rows must each carry a unique positive integer id, or the gate refuses (\"newest cannot be selected\") — fail closed, never guess.\n- The same id repeated with different conclusions is refused as ambiguous; a row without a check name is refused as malformed instead of silently dropped.\n- A newer failure or pending run still refuses over an older success (the newest row is authoritative whatever its conclusion).\n- The exact-head pinning of the check-runs read, REQUIRED_CHECKS, and the guarded-merge status recheck are unchanged.\n\n## Tests\n\n`python -m unittest scripts.test_production_business_risk_gate` from the repo root: 187 pass, 0 fail (5 new tests: both API orders select the newest; newer failure/cancelled/timed-out/None refuses over older success; duplicate rows without usable ids refuse; one id with two conclusions refuses; a nameless row refuses as malformed).\n\nNo migration, database, workflow, or coordination-ref write.\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T13:45:30Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":10,"deletions":16,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":14,"deletions":18,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":46,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/test_production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":89,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"fe13e952e66cce360d75a38d2cb766a37e2f9f5e","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T15:33:15Z","number":3201,"title":"fix(#2730): select the newest same-name check run by id, not API order","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3201"},

{"body":"Fixes #3146 (non-orchestrator work: repository tooling; no database structure change).\n\n## Cause\nThe automatic production qualifier re-proves the approval **after** the PR merged, against current `origin/main`. Main then contains the head, so every earlier head's merge base is itself and its PR diff is empty — every prior head, including a superseded REVISE'd one, looked \"identical\". The superseded refusal blocked the carry the guarded merge had accepted.\n\n## Fix\n- `isContentPreservingRefresh` returns not-equivalent for a head already contained in `mainRef` (an empty diff is no proof; fail closed).\n- `check-exact-head-approval` judges a merged PR against its merge commit's first parent (main as the guarded merge saw it). A merged PR with no exact merge commit refuses. The refusal rules themselves are unchanged.\n\n## Proof\n- New test `after the merge, a superseded head is not identical against current main` fails on main, passes here; plus a unit test for the main-ref resolution.\n- Replay on live records (recovery records at the merged head removed): #3118 old = REFUSED, new = carried from approved head `919f70fb`; #2872 old = REFUSED, new = carried from `518e1690`.\n- Author-lease workflow test set: 1430 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)","createdAt":"2026-09-17T10:34:44Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":14,"deletions":39,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":31,"deletions":64,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/check-exact-head-approval.mjs","additions":16,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/check-exact-head-approval.test.mjs","additions":11,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/lib/pr-content-equivalence.mjs","additions":8,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/lib/pr-content-equivalence.test.mjs","additions":21,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"2a9e18d994c8c0e1893c482565699c8535fa467d","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T10:48:41Z","number":3178,"title":"fix(#3146): qualifier judges a merged PR's diff against main before the merge","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3178"},

{"body":"Closes #3165 (repo-maintenance for #2530; not orchestrator work).\n\n`trustedOutcomeComments` trusted any `OWNER` comment with no login check, and would drop every genuine lifecycle event once GitHub reports the operator as `MEMBER` after the transfer. It now uses `isTrustedOperatorComment`: login `u2giants` mandatory, association exactly the one the current owner implies. Trust only narrows. Fixtures gain the operator login; a new test covers both owners, foreign logins, missing login, looser associations, and a forged event.\n\nNo transfer, no GitHub setting change, no database action.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T06:50:43Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":18,"deletions":13,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":26,"deletions":25,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/check-repository-identity-conformance.mjs","additions":1,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":1,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/admission-outcome.test.mjs","additions":14,"deletions":3,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/outcome-lifecycle.mjs","additions":5,"deletions":6,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-snapshot.mjs","additions":4,"deletions":4,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-snapshot.test.mjs","additions":3,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"5ebfccb26800346b973501df9a91855d4a0a94bd","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T07:38:01Z","number":3166,"title":"fix(#3165): outcome lifecycle trusts only the operator with owner-implied association","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3166"},
{"body":"Closes #3163. Refs #2530 (repo-maintenance; not orchestrator work — no database structure change). No transfer, no GitHub setting change, no database action.\n\n- **Operator trust** (`manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs` completion comments, `lib/work-dependencies.mjs`): the check was login `u2giants` AND association `OWNER`. The login is the trust anchor and is unchanged; but once `popcre` owns the repo GitHub reports that same login as `MEMBER`, so every genuine record would be refused. New `isTrustedOperatorComment` in `lib/repository-identity.mjs` keeps the login mandatory and requires exactly the association the *current* owner implies (`OWNER` for the personal account, `MEMBER` for an org). No other login, and no looser association, is admitted.\n- **Outcome evidence** (`githubIo.readOutcomeEvidence`): previously fetched a comment from whatever repository the URL named. {"body":"Closes #3152. {"body":"Closes #3147. Non-orchestrator repository maintenance: no database structure change.\n\nAnswers the four follow-ups the PR #3135 reviewer logged on #3127:\n\n1. **A PR that deletes its own probe no longer passes.** The gate now reads `git diff --name-status -M`; a probe path deleted or renamed away by the PR is refused even though `origin/main` still has it.\n2. **The I/O layer is tested.** `main()` takes injectable git, file, GitHub and log dependencies; a new test drives it offline through tree hit, main fallback, deletion, absence, missing contract and not-applicable paths.\n3. **Shape check matches what the live proof accepts.** Comments and string literals are stripped; the probe must be one `SELECT`/`WITH` statement with no write keyword and an `as passed` output column. {"body":"Closes #3009\n\n## What\nThe unfiltered PopSG v2 landing browse (no query, no filter) recomputed the whole 217k-file corpus on every call (6.35 s on production for Guides, at the 8 s ceiling). This migration (20260917011016, claim #3136):\n\n- adds `public.style_guide_library_default_summary` (files/guides totals + facets) and `public.style_guide_library_default_guides` (every guide result row), built from the exact unfiltered expressions of the current body;\n- refreshes both concurrently every 5 minutes (`public.refresh_style_guide_library_default_snapshot`, pg_cron `refresh-style-guide-library-default-snapshot`);\n- makes `public.search_style_guide_library_v2` read them only when no query and no filter is supplied. Files page rows stay live via the existing stable-page index. Every filtered/queried call, or an absent snapshot, runs the previous body unchanged.\n\nNo timeout, RLS or grant change on existing objects. The new views are unreadable by anon/authenticated. Does not touch PR #3118 objects.\n\n## Trade-off\nUnfiltered totals, facets and guide rows may lag the corpus by up to one 5-minute refresh.\n\n## Verified\n- Local disposable Postgres with synthetic data (NULL/empty folders, null tags, render queue states): 150 combinations of mode x sort (incl. invalid) x offset x limit, snapshot vs full body (via `popsg.library_snapshot_bypass=on`) identical; the only differences were order among guides sharing an identical `guide_key` (NULL vs '' folder), which the previous body already leaves undefined. Staleness and refresh behaviour confirmed.\n- `scripts/check-sql.sh` and the sidecar check pass.\n- Live proof `.github/live-proofs/3009.sql` asserts ledger, populated snapshot, cron job, privileges, and four unfiltered calls under 2 s.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T01:17:25Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":39,"deletions":12,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":40,"deletions":20,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/live-proofs/3009.sql","additions":42,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"supabase/migrations/20260917024050_popsg_search_v2_default_browse_snapshot.sql","additions":792,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"supabase/tests/popsg_search_style_guide_library_v2_contracts.sql","additions":5,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"ac3448df611756c41183c6fcfe18465d03bc3e58","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T04:27:14Z","number":3137,"title":"feat(popsg): unfiltered v2 default browse from refreshed snapshot (#3009)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3137"},

{"body":"Closes #3130. Repository maintenance, not orchestrator work: no database structure change.\n\nOwner ruling (Albert, 2026-09-16): \"remove all limits on work concurrency (subagents, lanes, etc.). remove all limits on using one reviewer simultaneously.\"\n\n## What changes\n- `reviewer-allocation.mjs`: a reservation is keyed by the exact review (provider/wrapper/issue/PR/head/bundle), not by the provider alone. The busy review-wait queue and the waker are removed. Load spreads by a hash of the exact review, with no ceiling. Reservation refs are always legal refnames.\n- `pickReviewer` no longer reads busy state. The `findBusyReviewers` header now says that null means unreadable and every caller fails closed.\n- Tests: one provider holds 20 simultaneous reservations. Each of the six active reviewers holds more than eight live exact-head leases while the busy set is full, and draws still succeed. Distinct reviews spread across providers.\n- AGENTS.md, section 4, and the Phase 2 and API-budget plans now state the new rule, and the old wait-queue text is marked superseded.\n- The author-lane cap was already removed in #2775; its 500-claim test is unchanged.\n\n## Boundary: kept on purpose\nThese are collision and safety isolation, not concurrency caps. Removing them can corrupt production:\n- exact-object collision locks\n- unique migration version reservation\n- the one-at-a-time preview apply, guarded merge, and production promotion lanes\n- a reviewer never reviews its own orchestrator engine\n- the `ai-review-preflight` usable gate\n\nThe legacy short-head test-fixture protocol still stores one lease per reviewer. It is fixture-only; production sets `requiresExactReviewHeadSha: true`.\n\nSkill text and the wrapper-side per-provider locks live in popcre/ai-devops and are changed there under their own PR (plan #401 Step 7A).\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n","createdAt":"2026-09-17T01:01:22Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":15,"deletions":56,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":31,"deletions":94,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"AGENTS.md","additions":3,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"docs/agents/section-4-anti-collision-rules.md","additions":15,"deletions":11,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"plan_orchestrator_throughput_phase_2.md","additions":10,"deletions":8,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"plan_reviewer_assignment_api_budget.md","additions":1,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs","additions":28,"deletions":23,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs","additions":51,"deletions":16,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/reviewer-allocation.mjs","additions":24,"deletions":25,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/reviewer-allocation.test.mjs","additions":33,"deletions":6,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"5bab89e52f247c1f89cf8d78923c67b856643fae","mergedAt":"2026-09-17T05:50:48Z","number":3132,"title":"Remove same-reviewer concurrency ceiling and busy review-wait (#3130)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3132"},

{"body":"Closes #3119. Repository maintenance (not orchestrator work; changes no database structure).\n\nThe production qualifier refused #3036 in run 35163423338 with every risk. {"body":"Closes #3100. Part of #3027 Step 7 (the #3027 issue stays open).\n\nLive finding on #3098: an unstarted reviewer read `keep-active` because CI and the other slot's review counted as its start. {"body":"Closes #3079\n\nThe scheduled no-progress alarm returned `no-orchestrator` and exited 0 whenever no orchestrator marker resolved, so it never checked anything.\n\n- It now reads claims and outcome events without a marker and evaluates stalls the same way.\n- With no marker it posts to one stable fallback issue, titled \"Orchestrator no-progress alarm (no orchestrator marker)\", created only when missing, and still deduped by alarm key. It carries the new `orchestrator-alarm` label, which the queue audit excludes as a coordination issue.\n- An uncreatable fallback issue, an unconfirmed post, or any other read failure makes the run exit 1.\n- Other `gatherLiveInput` callers still refuse without a marker.\n\nA live read-only dry run on main state reports `would-post` for #2866 and #2870 (`dispatched` for over 3,600 minutes). Full suite: 2316 pass, 0 fail. {"body":"Closes #3076. Part of #3027 Step 6.\n\nThe production risk gate can now take a validated migration train. It binds each allowlisted version to its own merged authoring PR and that PR's own preview evidence.\n\n- New `scripts/orchestrator-flow/read-verified-train-record.mjs` re-reads the exact dispatched record from its immutable ref and checks target, main and allowlist.\n- `production_business_risk_gate.py --migration-train-record` proves each entry on its own: merged, required checks and guarded merge at its head, the train's merge SHA, the PR actually added that migration, and the file hash matches. It then runs the preview proof once per authoring PR. A train cannot use the ephemeral route.\n- The workflow runs the reader before both gate runs, but only when `migration_train_ref` is set.\n- With no train ref, today's single source_pr behavior is unchanged, and a test covers it.\n\nKnown gaps:\n- Review v2 evidence carries no train id. It is bound through source_pr and head of one train PR.\n- The lane lock and admitted issue are still single-PR. Changing that needs edits to manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs, which were not made (collides with #3049).\n- The auto-promotion job does not emit train evidence yet.\n\nTests:\n- Risk gate: 160 run, 157 pass, 3 errors. The same 3 errors happen on base, so they are not new.\n- Review evidence: 19 OK. Historical recovery: 15 OK.\n- Node suites (train plus workflow checks): 169 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\n","createdAt":"2026-09-16T16:26:16Z","files":[{"path":".agent/completion.json","additions":16,"deletions":15,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".agent/contract.json","additions":29,"deletions":28,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":".github/workflows/shared-supabase-migrations.yml","additions":44,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"docs/verification/throughput-guard-truth-audit-20260828.json","additions":9,"deletions":2,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/migration-train.test.mjs","additions":17,"deletions":1,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/orchestrator-flow/read-verified-train-record.mjs","additions":33,"deletions":0,"changeType":"ADDED"},{"path":"scripts/production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":148,"deletions":12,"changeType":"MODIFIED"},{"path":"scripts/test_production_business_risk_gate.py","additions":144,"deletions":0,"changeType":"MODIFIED"}],"headRefOid":"83b545d1d26018dc5f8c36fad972c476f88108a2","mergedAt":"2026-09-16T18:34:09Z","number":3075,"title":"fix(#3076): production gate proves each migration train entry against its own authoring PR (#3027 Step 6)","url":"https://github.com/popcre/shared-db/pull/3075"},
